Arms researchers at the Steel Graves claim this Soulum to be the greatest of the Grave Guardian series. Haru Estia fights with this Soulum.

I'll just borrow this for a day, okay? No, of course I won't break it!
- Janice -

111554452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Soulum]<font color='#9D927B'>

I... I'll banish you from this world, you'll see!
- Haru Estia -

111554453.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Soulum]<font color='#9D927B'>

In the face of a life about to end comes the will to save the world.
- ??? -

111554651.Description:

Haru Estia fights with this Soulum.

Gold has been the root of all grief since time immemorial.
Don't sink too deeply into the golden pain.
- Eo -

When you face her, all of your aggression turns to ash. Then you'd rather crawl away in fear...
- ??? -

111604661.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Soulum]<font color='#9D927B'>

- ??? -

- A lively voice that chimes out of nowhere -

113554452.Name: Crimson Lunar Bringer
113554452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Mist Scythe]<font color='#9D927B'>

Those it takes hold of can quickly forget that wearing your heart on your sleeve makes you an easy target. Lily Bloommerchen fights with this Mist Scythe.

Oh, yes, make him sing.
- Lily Bloommerchen -

113554453.Name: The Genesis
113554453.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Mist Scythe]<font color='#9D927B'>

You, wide awake in this destroyed world, will make them wake up.
- ??? -

Lily Bloommerchen fights with this Mist Scythe.

Gold has been the root of all grief since time immemorial.
Don't sink too deeply into the golden pain.
- Eo -

An ancient primaeval power dwells within, with the ability to reveal enemies and bring them to their knees. The more Soul Energy its bearer holds, the more powerful it will become. I have no idea what it is you slaughtered but I think what you

Your soul will be sucked out immediately, but I

A SoulWorker's weapon. And so I stood there, surrounded by creatures from another world and found a powerful weapon in my hand that shone with a searing light.
It was shaped like an arm cannon and gave me this strange feeling that I'd worn it since the beginning of time.
Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

The strength for that which smoulders in your heart.
The strength to use this in your life... this power...
-

Our battle with him yielded valuable findings that allowed us to build these Spirit Arms. The moment I picked up the Spirit Arms, the Soulless seemed to recoil from me.
Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

Dearest Edgar! All yours!
- King Wayangon -

114114451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

- Benjamin -

Valuable findings gleaned from battles with them informed the design of these Spirit Arms. Its blue energy flux is typical of Mad Edgar. Strangely, the Soulless grow stronger whenever the weapon is used.
Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

A spectacular show indeed! The next time will be... on a bigger

114134451.Description:

- Edgar -

Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

Just look, dear coach.
This time: fist beats rock.
- Jin Seipatsu -

114164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

114164451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Soul Junk material has been compressed so much it has produce a weapon with incredible durability.
- Victor -

Hearken, humanity... it is time to meet your doom.
- Junk Knight -

114184451.Name: Polluted Upper
114184451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

... Wash your hands thoroughly.
- Aaron -

Sigh... oh... I knew... knew... you would come. Oh... dear...
- Catherine -

114214451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

There's hundreds of them coming out of it! Is that a side-effect of becoming a Soul Junk too?
- Victor -

114234451.Name: Alchemy Glove
114234451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

I know we're on air but I didn't really want to risk my life.
- Selene, on the air -

Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

I'll give you my power if you swear to fight with me until the end of all time.
Power that will let your soul find rest...
- Strange Child -

114264451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

I'll... smack you... with this... hand...
- ??? -

Jin Seipatsu fights with this weapon.

I haven't been this mad in years!
Kill, kill! Mutant's thrill!
- Scar -

114284451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

- Jin Seipatsu -

Leave air raid Defense to me... My weapon is no boomerang, after all.
- Kane Barrel -

This guilt... I'm happy to bear it!

- Unlucky Victim -

This item only unfurls its true strength in duels with other people. In normal combat its attributes are not so impressive.

I'll just borrow this for a day, okay? No, of course I won't break

114554453.Description:

Please protect what we have built.
- ??? -

114554651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Spirit Arms]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gold has been the root of all grief since time immemorial.
Don't sink too deeply into the golden pain.

It was a Howling Guitar, and I had the strange feeling that I had carried it since the dawn of time.
Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Go ahead. Go and play with the friends you've known for so long.
This is a game that will protect both you and your friends.

A SoulWorker's weapon. Asphalt Golem was encountered and defeated on the coastal roads – the asphalt and concrete that made up this Soul Junk were used to build this humongous Howling Guitar. Just lifting it takes enormous strength.
Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Oops, the gravel pile collapsed. We'll never get that back up again...
- Stella Unibell -

115164351.Name: Heavy Metal
115164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Scientists added a little something here and there during manufacture – but astoundingly, everything fits together. This weapon lets you deal some serious damage.

115164451.Name: Concrete Sound
115164451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. It contains fragments collected from the road by defeated Soul Junks. It can't be played but the Soul Energy within it makes it oscillate.

The Soul Junk material has been compressed so much it has produce a weapon with incredible durability.
- Victor -

115173401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

115183551.Name: Corrupted Knight Guitar
115183551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Hearken, humanity... it is time to meet your doom.
- Junk Knight -

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A weapon that attacks your sense of smell.
- Victor -

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Sigh... oh... I knew... knew... you would come. Oh... dear...
- Catherine -

115214451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

There's hundreds of them coming out of it! Is that a side-effect of becoming a Soul Junk too?
- Victor -

Our battle with him yielded valuable data that allowed us to build this Howling Guitar. This weapon was designed in Beholder's image, equipped with razor-sharp tentacles.

115234451.Name: Bio Wave
115234451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. It uses sound waves to destroy the biorhythms of those who listen to it.

Oh, a Howling Guitar! I wonder if I can play well? No, I'd like to break something!
- Selene, on the air -

115263551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Amaryllis devoured Catherine before we could defeat it. The black of this Howling Guitar, bordered in white, embodies that awful beast. It feels unusually heavy and emanates sadness when wielded.
Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Promise me this. 
Swear by me, and nothing will ever stop you. You will feel a rush of strength and confidence, and your inner child will be free.
- Strange

115264351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

115264451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

... Please... sing me... a lullaby...
- ??? -

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

I haven't been this mad in years!
Kill, kill! Mutant's thrill!
- Scar -

115284451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

That hurt! What're you laughing at?
Oh, so you like this game?
- Stella Unibell -

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

See that killing machine over there... I'm going to have him for breakfast!
- Falcon -

115324451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Leave air raid Defense to me... My weapon is no boomerang, after all.
- Kane Barrel -

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Is that the power you humans possess?
So that's it... Now I understand how your race grew to be so strong.
- Blood

115354452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

There's no such thing as infinite power... It has to reach a limit sometime, right?
- Sedurin -

Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Phantom...!
Not dead yet, I see...
- Senia -

115384451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Be careful! This weapon is bad for the psyche.
- Senia -

Blood Nova! Activate Centurion Sword.
Electrocutes the target with a high voltage charge.
- Raban -

115404351.Name: Soul Bringer
115404351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. This weapon plays with the emotions of its bearer. Thus it develops an almost unspeakable power. Whoever wields this weapon must first bargain with it. In so doing, it constantly radiates a soft blue energy.

115404451.Name: Raban: Bard Form
115404451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. It was made using the research findings about Near SoulWorker Raban. This weapon seems mad, just like Raban. Its performance is awe-inspiring, though.

Hit... Raban... with a Howling Guitar...
- Raban -

Control Room – Activate Defense protocol – Shields at 100%.
Activate Bunker Bot.

My name is Noah!
My power comes from the original – you. Please, allow me to demonstrate.
- Noah -

115454451.Name: Grave Keeper Chord MK.II
115454451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Has it been five years already... since our world came undone?
The first time since Kane Barrel.
- Benjamin -

- Sarah -

Oh, no...! That's not fair! I could have kept this up for hours!
Hey, you! Original! You won't be so lucky next time!
- Enoch -

Massive interference waves... I'm getting really dizzy. Don't get too close to me with that thing!
- Amanda -

Come out, come out, wherever you are! Here comes Super Abel!
We'll show them what we've got!
- Abel -

115494451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

- Abel -

That is my Blood Nova. Behold, the most lethal hologram in existence: Pollenstorm. Beautiful.
- Noah -

115514451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

How gorgeous and tiny. Makes you look like a gentle little cosmos. Hehe.
- Noah -

Can you see them coming, the Infinirings?
You will scream and die a miserable death under a torrent of blows!
- Enoch -

115534451.Description:

Here was the happiest child, also the saddest child...
- Enoch -

What do you say to that, huh?
I'll crush anyone who even thinks of stopping me!
- Sion -

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

May the survivors learn from our death...
- ??? -

115554351.Name: Lost Wanderer
115554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Pictured here is the favorite instrument of a wandering SoulWorker minstrel who travelled across the old world. He became sad when he lost the original. He left instructions behind, though. Thus the instrument became this mighty weapon.

She loved me, she thought of me, she sang for me. But I left her in the lurch. I cannot redeem that act even in death. I leave behind the image of my beloved.
-

115554353.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

This item only unfurls its true strength in duels with other people. In normal combat its attributes are not so impressive. 
Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

115554452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Those it takes hold of can quickly forget that wearing your heart on your sleeve makes you an easy target. Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

I want to get away from here. Far away. 
I never, ever want to see such horror again. never again.
- Stella Unibell

115554453.Name: The Requiem
115554453.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Many things our science cannot explain in its current state are things we simply don't observe and we maintain total silence about them. But despite all this lack of clarity, this weapon seems to be able to destroy the world.

Too many cooks spoil the broth. Sometimes a person also has an obligation to end something.
- ??? -

115554651.Name: Aurith Melos
115554651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. This item is refined by a blinding cloud of gold that comes from a shining sky. Anyone who holds this weapon for long enough loses themselves entirely in its appearance and power. I really want to sink into its shimmer... body... and soul...
Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Gold has been the root of all grief since time immemorial.
Don't sink too deeply into the golden pain.
- Eo -

Our souls will be trapped in this monster for eternity.
- ??? -

115584451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Its nothing but a worn-out dream for others, but in your hand this weapon guides you to your target. Whoever designed this weapon didn't have any sort of good intentions.
- Tenebris -

115594401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

115604661.Name: Voice of Void
115604661.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Crafted from Yorhaka's remains with the aid of all the technologies the SFL possesses. This weapon doesn't contain the full force of those remains, but it's still powerful. Stella Unibell fights with this Howling Guitar.

Is that all you were able to do with this material?]

115604662.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Howling Guitar]<font color='#9D927B'>

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

This power... to escape your destiny.
A medium via which to let your rage run free
- Strange Child -

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

One hell of a self-destruct mechanism. Planetary Defense against Big Puppet: Execute!

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

Dearest Edgar! All yours!
- King Wayangon -

Its blue energy flux is typical of Mad Edgar. Strangely, the Soulless grow stronger whenever the weapon is used.
Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

A spectacular show indeed! The next time will be... on a bigger stage.
- Edgar -

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

Now listen, you lump of rock.
A snowman is tougher than you.
- Iris Yuma -

116164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

- Victor -

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

Hearken, humanity... it is time to meet your doom.
- Junk Knight -

116184451.Description:

Sigh... oh... I knew... knew... you would come. Oh... dear...
- Catherine -

116214451.Description:

There's hundreds of them coming out of it! Is that a side-effect of becoming a Soul Junk too?
- Victor -

Come here, Hel. Here is the human corner.
- Selene, on the air -

Hey, you! Original! You won't be so lucky next time!

We'll show them what we've got!

... What do you say to that, huh?
I'll crush anyone who even thinks of stopping me!
- Sion -

116553651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

116554251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

May the survivors learn from our death...
- ??? -

116554351.Name: Brutal Rage
116554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

I'll put everyone down... There won't even be any dust left!
Either from you or from me!

- Iris Yuma -

116554352.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Anyone of sound mind refuses to use this weapon. Since the sheer existence of this weapon represented a great danger for the Soul Junks

116554353.Name: Fearful Apocalypse
116554353.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon : Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

This item only unfurls its true strength in duels with other people. In normal combat its attributes are not so impressive. 
Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

116554451.Name: Grave Keeper Demolisher MK.III
116554451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Valuable data gleaned from their experience informed the design of these Spirit Arms, which defeat every opponent effectively. Arms researchers at the Steel Graves claim this cannon to be the greatest from the Grave Guardian series.
Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

I'll just borrow this for a day, okay? No, of course I won't break it!
-

116554453.Name: The Liberation
116554453.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Put yourself on top. Free them all!
- ??? -

116554651.Name: Aurith Fury
116554651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon: Hammer Stol]<font color='#9D927B'>

Iris Yuma fights with this weapon.

Gold has been the root of all grief since time immemorial.
Don't sink too deeply into the golden pain.
- Eo -

- ??? -

117113551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. The soulless giant, King Wayangon, appeared in the restricted sector where signals are being received from other dimensions. Our battle with him yielded valuable findings that allowed us to build this Katana. The moment I lifted the Daito, the Soulless seemed to recoil from me.
Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

Edgar! My lord! I am yours!
- King Wayangon -

117114451.Name: Temptation Slasher
117114451.Description:

Don't worry. It's not dangerous any more.
- Benjamin -

117122701.Name: Sorrow Keepsake Single Edge
117122701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. And so I stood there, surrounded by unknown creatures, a gleaming weapon in my hand...
Small and bright, I felt it was strangely connected to me, as if it was part of my body, foot or hand.
Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

117133551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. We encountered Mad Edgar, the crazed puppet master of the Soulless, in abandoned hospitals. Valuable findings gleaned from battles with him informed the design of this Daito. Its blue energy flux is typical of Mad Edgar. Strangely, the Soulless grow stronger whenever the weapon is used.
Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

A spectacular show indeed! The next time will be... on a bigger stage.
- Edgar -

117134451.Name: Lunar Swirl
117134451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

By the Joker, who are you...?
- Edgar -

117163551.Description:

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

Now listen to me. You lump of rock!
A snowman can handle more than you.
- Chii Aruel -

117164351.Name: Cutting Machine
117164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Scientists added a little something here and there during manufacture – but astoundingly, everything fits together. This weapon lets you deal some serious damage.

117164451.Name: Slate Single Edge
117164451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. It contains fragments of defeated Soul Junks collected from the road. Maybe not quite sharp enough so better used for bludgeoning.

The Soul Junk material has been compressed so much it has produced a weapon with incredible durability.
- Victor -

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

Hearken, humanity... it's time to meet your doom.
- Junk Knight -

117184451.Name: Polluted Sharp Tachi Sword
117184451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

You didn't... touch it, did you? *gag*
- Rita -

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

Sigh... oh... I knew... knew... you would come. Oh... dear...
- Catherine -

117214451.Name: Bird Eater
117214451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

There's hundreds of them coming out of it! Is that a side-effect of becoming a Soul Junk too?
- Victor III -

Our battle with him yielded valuable findings that allowed us to build this Daito. This weapon was designed in Beholder's image and equipped with razor-sharp tentacles.

117234451.Name: Physics Single Edge
117234451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. It took countless experiments to craft this Daito. Now, it even slices through dark matter.

Wow! Do you see these glass noodles? Split in the middle. Just like the masters.
- Cynthia, on the air -

She said we'd stay together always... together forever...
- Chii Aruel -

117264351.Description:

Just... wait...
- ??? -

117283551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Worker : Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

A SoulWorker's weapon. Scar, the gargantuan Vessi, was seen near the motorways. This Daito, which excels in close combat just like an axe, resembles his gigantic weapon. When you equip it, you feel driven by a menacing bloodlust.
Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

I haven't been this mad in years!
Kill, kill! Mutant's thrill!
- Scar -

117284451.Description:

- Toru -

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

See that killing machine over there... I'm going to have him for breakfast!
- Falcon -

117324451.Description:

Leave air raid Defense to me... My weapon is no boomerang, after all.
- Kane Barrel -

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

Is that the power you humans possess?
So that's it... Now I understand how your race grew to be so strong.
- Blood Scar -

Chii Aruel fights with the Katana.

117354452.Description:

There's no such thing as infinite power... It's got to reach a limit sometime, right?
- Sedurin -

Is it not a thing of absurdity that a blessing from the gods should have such repercussions?

Can be used by Erwin.

Can be worn by Erwin.

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hat created for sleep, for those who seem very tired. Can help you fall asleep instantly when you wear it.

221641001.Name: Bedtime Doll
221641001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Doll created for those who have tremendous amount of fatigue. Made in the shape of bag, which makes it portable. Can help you fall asleep instantly when you wear it.

221650301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Goggles
221650301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hacking goggles made by Trisha for returning favor, for using Upgrade frequently. Contains the meaning of Trisha's love and friendship. This doesn't have an actual function of hacking.

221661301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Module
221661301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hacking module made by Trisha for returning favor, for using Upgrade frequently. Contains the meaning of Trisha's love and friendship. This doesn't have an actual function of hacking.

221672001.Name: Janice's  Cat Mask
221672001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Cat mask made by Janice as a favor for using Upgrade frequently. Contains the meaning of Trisha's love and friendship.

221681001.Name: Janice's Walking Backpack
221681001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Backpack made by Janice as a favor for using Upgrade frequently. It is a walking backpack but empty inside. Contains the meaning of Trisha's love and friendship.

221691001.Name: [EV] Gruton Backpack
221691001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Backpack designed after Gruton. Seems cute at first, but can feel scary if you look closely. It is like a Gruton alive and moving.

221702001.Name: Marionette Mask
221702001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask would've been looking like this if Edgar's mask was fine. Can effectively hide emotion.

221712001.Name: Spider Queen Mask
221712001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Violet Murderess' Head. It could be a great fit for a suspicious party.

221722001.Name: Phantom Mask
221722001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Phantom's Mask. This has multiple eye holes but doesn't actually expand sight.

221731601.Name: Snow Crystal Earrings
221731601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Earrings that glitter beautifully in the sunlight.
They're icy to the touch, but don't worry – they won't melt.
Can be worn by Erwin Arclight.

221732001.Name: Mono-Eye Mask
221732001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Mono-Eye, which is the symbol of Robot.

221740101.Name: Seed Pot
221740101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for people who love planting plants. Strangely enough, nothing grows here despite the tender watering.

221740201.Name: Red Antlers
221740201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A wearable pair of Rudolph's Antlers. It's as red as blood.
But Halloween is over. So it's not real blood.
Can be worn by Erwin Arclight.

221750101.Name: Sprout Pot
221750101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who are experts at planting. Strangely the shoot doesn't grow, even though it gets enough water.

221750401.Name: Rudolph's Red Nose
221750401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The nose that's always lit up bright.
This nose makes the world so bright, it guides you through the fog at night.
Can be worn by Erwin Arclight.

221760101.Name: Straw Hat
221760101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the hard-working farmers among you. A hat made of straw that's so hard it only suits tough heroes and real scarecrows.

221770101.Name: Bird Egg Straw Hat
221770101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A straw hat that has become hot and crinkly from working in the sun. And there's still a nest on it – full of fresh eggs? A true symbol of recognition.

221780101.Name: Withered Sprout
221780101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who let their plants wither. Shocking yellow. We're equally guilty.

221790101.Name: Trowel above my head
221790101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for everyone whose plants can no longer be saved. The trowel isn't really stuck firmly in the head, so fingers off!

221800501.Name: Silver Hand
221800501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others. Lots of plants owe their lives to you.

221810501.Name: God's Hand
221810501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others as if they were their own. You've got genuine green fingers.

221822001.Name: Golden Mask
221822001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mask made of legendary gold. Can you feel the gold flow from your face into your veins?

221830101.Name: Tower above my head
221830101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tower that rises high above the head. Be careful in narrow tunnels and passages.

221850201.Name: [Freshman] Hat
221850201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Event Reward Fashion<font color='#9D927B'>

Don't be surprised if someone mistakes you for a preschooler.

221871001.Name: Equilibrium Mark
221871001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A symbol for D-Lines. Wearing it also symbolises the power to handle them.

221881901.Name: Eye of Observer
221881901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A helm for those who have distinguished themselves in battle against Gronco. Only a few of them were made in the old world. And the majority disappeared over time.

222010291.Description:

Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Erwin.

222040102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Headphone worn by Elites of NED Company. Brand new. There are no music but makes you hum.

222040301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Scouter worn by Elites of NED Company. Hmm… this increases combat power?

222040701.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Top
222040701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Top worn by Elites of NED Company. Brand new. Keeps your neck warm, because it is covered with fur around neck area.

222040801.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Bottoms
222040801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Pants worn by Elites of NED Company. Slick line is excellent point.

222041001.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Business Bag
222041001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Business Bag worn by Elites of NED Company. Elites are actually different.

222041201.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Boots
222041201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The boots issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. Made from breathable fabric!

222114121.Name: Golden Arbiter Head Gear
222114121.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This newly released head gear for researching the inside of the Vacuum is plated in gold. It's hardly any different than the original black version. Perhaps enemies will find the gleaming gold distracting.

222114171.Name: Golden Arbiter Suit
222114171.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This newly released suit for researching the inside of the Vacuum is plated in gold. It's hardly any different than the original black version. Perhaps enemies will find the gleaming gold distracting.

222154101.Name: Blue Fairy Wings
222154101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Do you know these little dayflowers, that gleam to the high heavens with two blue petals?
You can now attach them as hologram wings and fly your way into the next tale.

222156101.Name: Corrupted Fearful Wing
222156101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Transience transforms even that fear which freezes blood. Having lost their last ounce of courage, these wings have turned a frozen red.
Can be worn by Erwin.

222157101.Name: Corrupted Torment Wing
222157101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Costume PKG]<font color='#9D927B'>

Transience transforms even that pain which pierces the soul. The loss of all joy has left these wings a bruised purple.
Can be worn by Erwin.

222158101.Name: Corrupted Destructive Wing
222158101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This has dark and gold shape of wings, because of lost peace and honor from the past which was caused of unbearable destruction.
Can be worn by Erwin.

222159101.Name: Corrupted Hateful Wing
222159101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

222181101.Name: Mesmerizing Fairy Wing
222181101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Small fairy wings made with hologram. Mesmerizing mood, full of purple lights.
Can create the feeling of a cute fairy, even though you cannot fly around after you equip.

222500021.Name: The Little Restligeist
222500021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A restligeist has nothing to do but laying on the head like a sticky rice cake. This is just a ghost but it feels plumpy if you touch it. Cannot feel much weight since this is just ghost. 
Erwin can wear it.

222501101.Name: The Little Ghost
222501101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Wandering ghost constantly floating around you smiling. Floating next to you. They can get in the way sometime, but let's be nice to them since they don't seem like a naughty kid.
Erwin can wear it.

222502021.Name: The Little Ghost's Silk Hat
222502021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cute Silk Hat, rather than being elegant. Don't misunderstand that the hat size is small. This is not exclusively for dogs or cats, but entirely for humans.
Erwin can wear it.

222503011.Name: Jack-O'-Earrings
222503011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Jack-O'-Lantern's Earrings that represent Halloween. Earrings with Jack-O'-Lantern decoration, and it shines softly. It's perfect for a Halloween party.
Erwin can wear it.

222504911.Name: n. A Mask covered with giant Jack-O'-Lantern, it shines with scary light. It's perfect for a Hallowee

222505021.Name: Undead Charm
222505021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An amulet of Shaman that is used for resurrecting the dead. It feels creepy because this is a token of the undead. There is no problem if a live person wears it. 
Erwin can wear it.

222506201.Name: Pierrot Mask
222506201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Pierrot Mask provokes strange fear. It scares you and makes you panic if you make eye contact. What kind of face is hiding underneath the face of a clown?
Erwin can wear it.

222552031.Name: Flaming Vessi Blindfold
222552031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Erwin can wear it.

222553031.Name: Glasses of Lord
222553031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small pair of glasses that has lost a long time ago. It is forgotten even in the owner's memory.
Erwin can wear it.

222554071.Name: [Refined Modern Casual] Top
222554071.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Top is stylish and perfect for a bright spring day with flower petals beautifully falling all around.
Ephnel's Modern Casual Outfit is refined to fit the body of its wearer and can be dyed to various colors and designs.

241090701.Description:

241097101.Name: [EV] Clingy Otter
241097101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Their only wish is to become human. But that's not going to happen, so they've gone for the next best thing - hanging off a human's back. No matter what, this otter won't let go of you.

Can be used by Jin.

241097201.Name: [EV] Snorkeling Mask
241097201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An essential part of any diving excursion. This immediately makes you feel a lot safer in the water.

Can be used by Jin.

241100101.Name: [EV] Rescue Tube
241100101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tube that anyone can easily carry on their back, those who are not confident swimmers are advised to use it.

Can be worn by Jin.

241100701.Name: Checked Shirt
241100701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A plaid shirt. Depending on the combination with other pieces of clothing or accessories, you'll look either fabulous or frightful.

241101101.Name: [EV] Flopping Tuna
241101101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This tuna is floundering about on its back. Don't worry, it can breathe on land too. Is it a pet or a snack? Your choice.

Can be used by Jin.

241102101.Name: [EV] Beach Straw Hat
241102101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

What's a beach holiday without the right hat?!
This hat is woven from a special material that's as hard as steel, so you can also use it as a Head Gear.

Can be used by Jin.

241103101.Name: [EV] Turtle Shell
241103101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Once used as bulletproof and fire-resistant Defense equipment, this Turtle Tank's size turned out to be a hindrance in combat, so it's just a fashion item now.
Press on the Cube pattern for 30 seconds to open the tank and unlock its functions.

Can be used by Jin.

241104101.Name: [EV] Fishing Rod
241104101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Essential for fishing enthusiasts.
This fishing rod might look completely normal, but it has a special feature: With this, the biggest, angriest fish will bite, even if you don't use a lure.

Can be used by Jin.

241105021.Name: [EV] Crab Above Head
241105021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Apparently this crab used to be a human until it was cursed.
Its eyes look like they're waiting for the curse to claim a new victim.

Can be used by Jin.

241106021.Name: [EV] Starfish Above Head
241106021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This starfish tastes like dried squid. A perfect snack to accompany a cold lemonade in summer.

Can be used by Jin.

241107121.Name: [EV] Swimming Flippers
241107121.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be used by Jin.

241110701.Name: Stripe Shirt
241110701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

241114081.Description:

241117081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Jin.

241118041.Description:

Can be worn by Jin.

Can be worn by Jin.

241120801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

241121041.Name: Pacifier
241121041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Jin.

241122031.Name: Mass Boots Glass
241122031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Jin.

241123031.Name: Punky Sunglasses
241123031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Jin.

241130801.Description:

241180101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A little umbrella that is so tiny it could fit in a cocktail. Brilliant in your hair, useless in the rain.

241190101.Name: Big Ribbon
241190101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A conspicuous bow for your hair, as red as a rose. Only for women and very confident men.

241200301.Name: Heart Shaped Glasses
241200301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these heart-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. You'll either look like a mistake on legs or utterly adorable with this.

241210301.Name: Star Shaped Glasses
241210301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these star-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. Caveat: you might be mistaken for one of the staff.

241220301.Name: Glasses of Conspiracy
241220301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These glasses make you look like an evil genius plotting to take over the world. Wear these and you'll be the villain with your own soundtrack.

241230301.Name: Rectangular Glasses
241230301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Glasses with square lenses. You were wearing them way before they became a thing. Angular faces look even more angular.

241240301.Name: Groucho glasses
241240301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The classic fancy dress article. Nobody looks good in them.

241251301.Name: Brown Leather Crossbody Bag
241251301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This pouch was made from only the finest leather. The kind of quality you can see a mile off too.

241261301.Name: Cylinder Bag
241261301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A brown pouch shaped like a cylinder. It might roll away if you're not careful.

241271301.Name: Soda Can
241271301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag designed to fit exactly one drinks can. If the can isn't empty, you should be careful when standing up.

241281301.Name: Crumpled Paper Ball
241281301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Important-looking documents. The pages are empty, however.

241291301.Name: Knit Crossbody Bag
241291301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A knitwear pouch. Not suited for heavy items.

241300501.Name: Cure Jelly Bracelet
241300501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag with one of those pretty gel bracelets dangling from it. Not just pretty, but healing too.

241311301.Name: Medic Box Crossbody Bag
241311301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag which contains a complete first aid kit: very practical. Ready for use any time, anywhere to tend to injuries.

241320101.Name: Millionaire's Hat
241320101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's pretty hard on the neck. But what did you expect, it's gold!

241330101.Name: VVIP Icon
241330101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Trader Alliance only presents the VVIP Badge to special customers. After all, appreciation is very important to them. It's truly a tremendous honour. Until you think again about the truly enormous amount of gold you've spent so far.

241341301.Name: Nano Kit Crossbody Bag
241341301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Made for transporting stuff. It can be used to repair broken items anywhere at any time.

241351001.Name: XL Monkey Wrench
241351001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This huge wrench is only for people who actually finish their repairs. Makes you look like the king of DIY.

241360501.Name: Resurrector Bracelet
241360501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet with a respawn amulet. It'll save your life some day.

241370101.Name: Angel Ring
241370101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For everyone who has died so many deaths that they have finally made it to a higher plane. Put it on and you'll practically be an angel.

241380101.Name: Junk Knight's Head Gear
241380101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Junk Knight's headgear was designed using data obtained from the defeated Soul Junk. The headgear gives you an inkling of what life as a Junk Knight is like.

241392001.Name: Puppet Mask
241392001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The mask was developed utilising data from the defeated mannequins. It's a very lifelike replica. Make sure you don't get mistaken for one of the Soulless!

241400501.Name: NED Co. Bracelet
241400501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The bracelet was developed based on data from the NED Company. It lets you pass as an NED Company employee undetected.

241410101.Name: Horn of Rapid Flame
241410101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These attachable horns were inspired by countless defeated Rapid Flame Vessi. You could easily pass as a Vessi.

241420101.Name: Air Drone
241420101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Developed based on data gleaned from countless defeated robots. Don't be fooled. Eagle-Eye isn't dangerous, otherwise.

241430301.Name: Raban's Sunglasses
241430301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These sunglasses imitate the glasses worn by Near SoulWorker Raban. This creation is one of the SFL's contributions to the numerous battles.

241440501.Name: Broken Shield Bracelet
241440501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

241451001.Name: Broken Shield Bag
241451001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

241460101.Name: Hit Icon
241460101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

So many combos have been used here that the hit counter has short-circuited and is now burned into the air as a floating, glowing symbol. The Starry Forest research lab converted it into a hairband, making it more cozy to wear. Combos should be so much easier with it.

241470101.Name: Blue Question Mark Icon
241470101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have dealt with certain concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants. Careful, though: if you wear this badge, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident whose concern is being looked into.

241480101.Name: Blue Exclamation Mark Icon
241480101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who devote themselves to handling the concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants around the clock. Careful, though: if you wear this exclamation mark, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident with a new concern.

241490501.Name: Wrist Compass
241490501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who practically live in the quest area. With this you'll never get lost again.

241501001.Name: Explorer's Bag
241501001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have wandered around the quest area a fair bit. You will survive anything.

241510101.Name: Hot Wine Icon
241510101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A glowing glass attached to a hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the sake wine is still warm. If only you could just drink from the glass during the quest!

241520101.Name: Hot Curry Icon
241520101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A steaming rice dish attached to the hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the 3-minute instant curry is still palatable. If only you could actually eat it!

241539021.Description:

241540021.Name: Stripe Cow Hairband
241540021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Stripe Cow Hairband with cute-sized horn. The drooping ear looks sad somehow.

241540101.Name: Premium S+ Icon
241540101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Hair Decoration was created to celebrate achieving Mission Completion Rank S+ multiple times. Fancy wings were added as decoration. And much like the S+ rank, the Icon looks glorious even from miles away.

241541041.Name: Silver Bell Choker
241541041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Choker with silver bell. This can ring with a clear sound.
Jin can wear it.

241542041.Name: Gold Bell Choker
241542041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Choker with gold bell. This can ring with a clear sound.
Jin can wear it.

241550101.Name: F Icon
241550101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. A big, bold F burns in the distance like a stigma.

241560101.Name: Premium F Icon
241560101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. It takes an awful lot of work to get an F rating so often. A shining F and devil's wings reward this impressive feat.

241570501.Name: Coin Pendant Bracelet
241570501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A coin collector's dream: an amulet made from coins. It's an enormous help in collecting coins.

241580101.Name: Piggy Bank Hat
241580101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Headwear for people who keep collecting coins and need somewhere to horde them. Smash in emergencies!

241590501.Name: Ether Bracelet
241590501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Aether band made from refined Aethar. The Aethar Band makes collecting much easier.

241600301.Name: Ether Shaped Glasses
241600301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Aether Glasses made from refined Aethar. You will be able to see Aethar even in places where there isn't any.

241611301.Name: Hourglass Crossbody Bag
241611301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An hourglass created from nothing. It is believed to have appeared when the SoulWorkers first saw the light of the world. It can be used as a normal bag.

241621001.Name: Alarm Clock Bag
241621001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An alarm clock that counts the minutes since the SoulWorkers arrived on Earth. It is rumoured to have popped out of thin air. It can be used like a normal bag.

241630101.Name: Dreamland Hat
241630101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. Works better than any sleeping pill.

241641001.Name: Bedtime Doll
241641001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. This cute cuddly doll comes as a bag for easier transport. Works better than any sleeping pill.

241650301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Goggles
241650301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of hacking goggles, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, these goggles don't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

241661301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Module
241661301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hacking module, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, this module doesn't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

241672001.Name: Janice's Cat Mask
241672001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Cat mask made by Janice as a favor for using Upgrade frequently. Contains the meaning of Trisha's love and friendship.

241681001.Name: Janice's Walking Backpack
241681001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A roomy bag, presented to you as thanks for using Janice's crafting skills so often. It is completely empty. Janice's gratitude and loyalty are what make this item valuable.

241691001.Name: [EV] Gruton Walking Backpack
241691001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a Gruton. It seems quite cute at first glance, but on closer inspection looks like a real Gruton. Creepy...

241702001.Name: Marionette Mask
241702001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask would've been looking like this if Edgar's mask was fine. Can effectively hide emotion.

241712001.Name: Spider Queen Mask
241712001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Violet Murderess' Head. It could be a great fit for a suspicious party.

241722001.Name: Phantom Mask
241722001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Phantom's Mask. This has multiple eye holes but doesn't actually expand sight.

241731601.Name: Snow Crystal Earrings
241731601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Earrings that glitter beautifully in the sunlight.
They're icy to the touch, but don't worry – they won't melt.
Can be worn by Jin Seipatsu.

241732001.Name: Mono-Eye Mask
241732001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mask made after Mono-Eye, which is the symbol of Robot.

241740101.Name: Seed Pot
241740101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for people who love planting plants. Strangely enough, nothing grows here despite the tender watering.

241740201.Name: Red Antlers
241740201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A wearable pair of Rudolph's Antlers. It's as red as blood.
But Halloween is over. So it's not real blood.
Can be worn by Jin Seipatsu.

241750101.Name: Sprout Pot
241750101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who are experts at planting. Strangely the shoot doesn't grow, even though it gets enough water.

241750401.Name: Rudolph's Red Nose
241750401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The nose that's always lit up bright.
This nose makes the world so bright, it guides you through the fog at night.
Can be worn by Jin Seipatsu.

241760101.Name: Straw Hat
241760101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the hard-working farmers among you. A hat made of straw that's so hard it only suits tough heroes and real scarecrows.

241770101.Name: Bird Egg Straw Hat
241770101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A straw hat that has become hot and crinkly from working in the sun. And there's still a nest on it – full of fresh eggs? A true symbol of recognition.

241780101.Name: Withered Sprout
241780101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who let their plants wither. Shocking yellow. We're equally guilty.

241790101.Name: Trowel above my head
241790101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for everyone whose plants can no longer be saved. The trowel isn't really stuck firmly in the head, so fingers off!

241800501.Name: Silver Hand
241800501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others. Lots of plants owe their lives to you.

241810501.Name: God's Hand
241810501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others as if they were their own. You've got genuine green fingers.

241822001.Name: Golden Mask
241822001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mask made of legendary gold. Can you feel the gold flow from your face into your veins?

241830101.Name: Tower above my head
241830101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tower that rises high above the head. Be careful in narrow tunnels and passages.

241830558.Name: [Spirit Arms of Unity] Gloves
241830558.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

These gloves let Jin use his newly acquired power even more effectively.
In memory of the people who resolved to put their trust in him and to support him.

241830958.Name: [Spirit Arms of Unity] Outfit
241830958.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

This outfit lets Jin use his newly acquired power even more effectively.
In memory of the people who resolved to put their trust in him and to support him.

241831258.Name: [Spirit Arms of Unity] Boots
241831258.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

These boots let Jin use his newly acquired power even more effectively.
In memory of the people who resolved to put their trust in him and to support him.

241831958.Name: [Spirit Arms of Unity] Head Gear
241831958.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Jin Seipatsu's new head protector, modeled on his newly awakened vitality.
In memory of the people who resolved to put their trust in him and to support him.

241850201.Name: [Freshman] Hat
241850201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Event Reward Fashion<font color='#9D927B'>

Don't be surprised if someone mistakes you for a preschooler.

241851001.Name: [Freshman] Satchel
241851001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Event Reward Fashion<font color='#9D927B'>

Don't be surprised if someone mistakes you for a preschooler.

241861001.Name: [EV] Relaxing Gruton Backpack
241861001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event Reward: Costume]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Backpack was designed after a Gruton fell asleep tired of hard work; slumber will overcome anyone who hugs this backpack.

241871001.Name: Equilibrium Mark
241871001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A symbol for D-Lines. Wearing it also symbolises the power to handle them.

241881901.Name: Eye of Observer
241881901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A helm for those who have distinguished themselves in battle against Gronco. Only a few of them were made in the old world. And the majority disappeared over time.

242010201.Name: [Miner] Safety Head Gear
242010201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Head Gear like the kind miners wear.

242010291.Name: [Transparent Costume] Hairstyle
242010291.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Always wanted to wear something only you can see?
Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Jin.

242010292.Name: [Transparent Costume] Outfit
242010292.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Always wanted to wear something only you can see?
Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Jin.

Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Jin.

242010401.Name: [Miner] Dust Mask
242010401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A dust mask like the kind miners wear.

242010501.Name: [Miner] Work Gloves
242010501.Description:

Iris can wear it.✟ဨ5Icon/Item/Costume/PC_G/PC_G_EQ_HaruMask_HairCapEye_195Icon/I

261190101.Name: Big Ribbon
261190101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A conspicuous bow for your hair, as red as a rose. Only for women and very confident men.

261200301.Name: Heart Shaped Glasses
261200301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these heart-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. You'll either look like a mistake on legs or utterly adorable with this.

261210301.Name: Star Shaped Glasses
261210301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these star-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. Caveat: you might be mistaken for one of the staff.

261220301.Name: Glasses of Conspiracy
261220301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These glasses make you look like an evil genius plotting to take over the world. Wear these and you'll be the villain with your own soundtrack.

261230301.Name: Rectangular Glasses
261230301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Glasses with square lenses. You were wearing them way before they became a thing. Angular faces look even more angular.

261240301.Name: Groucho glasses
261240301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The classic fancy dress article. Nobody looks good in them.

261251301.Name: Brown Leather Crossbody Bag
261251301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This pouch was made from only the finest leather. The kind of quality you can see a mile off too.

261261301.Name: Cylinder Bag
261261301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A brown pouch shaped like a cylinder. It might roll away if you're not careful.

261271301.Name: Soda Can
261271301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag designed to fit exactly one drinks can. If the can isn't empty, you should be careful when standing up.

261281301.Name: Crumpled Paper Ball
261281301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Important-looking documents. The pages are empty, however.

261291301.Name: Knit Crossbody Bag
261291301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A knitwear pouch. Not suited for heavy items.

261300501.Name: Cure Jelly Bracelet
261300501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag with one of those pretty gel bracelets dangling from it. Not just pretty, but healing too.

261311301.Name: Medic Box Crossbody Bag
261311301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag which contains a complete first aid kit: very practical. Ready for use any time, anywhere to tend to injuries.

261320101.Name: Millionaire's Hat
261320101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's pretty hard on the neck. But what did you expect, it's gold!

261330101.Name: VVIP Icon
261330101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Trader Alliance only presents the VVIP Badge to special customers. After all, appreciation is very important to them. It's truly a tremendous honour. Until you think again about the truly enormous amount of gold you've spent so far.

261330102.Name: VVIP Icon
261330102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Trader Alliance only presents the VVIP Badge to special customers. After all, appreciation is very important to them. It's truly a tremendous honour. Until you think again about the truly enormous amount of gold you've spent so far.

261341301.Name: Nano Kit Crossbody Bag
261341301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Made for transporting stuff. It can be used to repair broken items anywhere at any time.

261351001.Name: XL Monkey Wrench
261351001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This huge wrench is only for people who actually finish their repairs. Makes you look like the king of DIY.

261360501.Name: Resurrector Bracelet
261360501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet with a respawn amulet. It'll save your life some day.

261370101.Name: Angel Ring
261370101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For everyone who has died so many deaths that they have finally made it to a higher plane. Put it on and you'll practically be an angel.

261380101.Name: Junk Knight's Head Gear
261380101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Junk Knight's headgear was designed using data obtained from the defeated Soul Junk. The headgear gives you an inkling of what life as a Junk Knight is like.

261392001.Name: Puppet Mask
261392001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The mask was developed utilising data from the defeated mannequins. It's a very lifelike replica. Make sure you don't get mistaken for one of the Soulless!

261400501.Name: NED Co. Bracelet
261400501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The bracelet was developed based on data from the NED Company. It lets you pass as an NED Company employee undetected.

261410101.Name: Horn of Rapid Flame
261410101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These attachable horns were inspired by countless defeated Rapid Flame Vessi. You could easily pass as a Vessi.

261420101.Name: Air Drone
261420101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Developed based on data gleaned from countless defeated robots. Don't be fooled. Eagle-Eye isn't dangerous, otherwise.

261430301.Name: Raban's Sunglasses
261430301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These sunglasses imitate the glasses worn by Near SoulWorker Raban. This creation is one of the SFL's contributions to the numerous battles.

261440501.Name: Broken Shield Bracelet
261440501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

261451001.Name: Broken Shield Bag
261451001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

261460101.Name: Combo Icon
261460101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

So many combos have been used here that the combo counter has short-circuited and is now burned into the air as a floating, glowing symbol. The Starry Forest research lab converted it into a hairband, making it more cozy to wear. Combos should be so much easier with it.

261470101.Name: Blue Question Mark Icon
261470101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have dealt with certain concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants. Careful, though: if you wear this badge, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident whose concern is being looked into.

261480101.Name: Blue Exclamation Mark Icon
261480101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who devote themselves to handling the concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants around the clock. Careful, though: if you wear this exclamation mark, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident with a new concern.

261490501.Name: Wrist Compass
261490501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who practically live in the quest area. With this you'll never get lost again.

261501001.Name: Explorer's Bag
261501001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have wandered around the quest area a fair bit. You will survive anything.

261510101.Name: Hot Wine Icon
261510101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A glowing glass attached to a hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the sake wine is still warm. If only you could just drink from the glass during the quest!

261520101.Name: Hot Curry Icon
261520101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A steaming rice dish attached to the hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the 3-minute instant curry is still palatable. If only you could actually eat it!

261530101.Name: S+ Icon
261530101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Hair Decoration was created to celebrate achieving Mission Completion Rank S+ multiple times. And much like the S+ rank, the Icon looks glorious even from miles away.

261533061.Name: Cute Underwear Set
261533061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Underwear Set has been designed from precious materials of another world along with an aesthetic that just can't be described. With its soft fabric, this Underwear also has a cute ribbon attached as if it were a cherry on top.

261550101.Name: F Icon
261550101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. A big, bold F burns in the distance like a stigma.

261554021.Name: White Cow Hairband
261554021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

White Cow Hairband with cute-sized horn. The drooping ear looks sad somehow.

261555021.Name: Stripe Cow Hairband
261555021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Stripe Cow Hairband with cute-sized horn. The drooping ear looks sad somehow.

261556041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Choker with silver bell. This can ring with a clear sound.
Iris can wear it.

261557041.Name: Gold Bell Choker
261557041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Choker with gold bell. This can ring with a clear sound.
Iris can wear it.

261560101.Name: Premium F Icon
261560101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. It takes an awful lot of work to get an F rating so often. A shining F and devil's wings reward this impressive feat.

261570501.Name: Coin Pendant Bracelet
261570501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A coin collector's dream: an amulet made from coins. It's an enormous help in collecting coins.

261580101.Name: Piggy Bank Hat
261580101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Headwear for people who keep collecting coins and need somewhere to horde them. Smash in emergencies!

261590501.Name: Ether Bracelet
261590501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Aether band made from refined Aethar. The Aethar Band makes collecting much easier.

261600301.Name: Ether Shaped Glasses
261600301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Ether Glasses made from refined Ethar. You will be able to see Eethar even in places where there isn't any.

261611301.Name: Hourglass Crossbody Bag
261611301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An hourglass created from nothing. It is believed to have appeared when the SoulWorkers first saw the light of the world. It can be used as a normal bag.

261621001.Name: Alarm Clock Bag
261621001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An alarm clock that counts the minutes since the SoulWorkers arrived on Earth. It is rumoured to have popped out of thin air. It can be used like a normal bag.

261630101.Name: Dreamland Hat
261630101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. Works better than any sleeping pill.

261641001.Name: Bedtime Doll
261641001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. This cute cuddly doll comes as a bag for easier transport. Works better than any sleeping pill.

261650301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Goggles
261650301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of hacking goggles, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, these goggles don't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

261661301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Module
261661301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hacking module, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, this module doesn't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

261672001.Name: Janice's Cat Mask
261672001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cat mask, presented to you as thanks for using Janice's crafting skills so often. Janice's gratitude and loyalty are what make this item valuable.

261681001.Name: Janice's Walking Backpack
261681001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A roomy bag, presented to you as thanks for using Janice's crafting skills so often. It is completely empty. Janice's gratitude and loyalty are what make this item valuable.

261691001.Name: Gruton Backpack
261691001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a Gruton. It seems quite cute at first glance, but on closer inspection looks like a real Gruton. Creepy...

261702001.Name: Marionette Mask
261702001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is what Mad Edgar's intact mask would look like. The mask makes it easy to hide your feelings.

261712001.Name: Spider Queen Mask
261712001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The head of a Violet Murder served as inspiration for this mask. Quite fitting for a suspicious team.

261722001.Name: Phantom Mask
261722001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Phantom's mask served as inspiration. It has several holes for the eyes, but you don't see more because of them.

261731601.Name: Snow Crystal Earrings
261731601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Earrings that glitter beautifully in the sunlight.
They're icy to the touch, but don't worry – they won't melt.
Can be worn by Iris Yuma.

261732001.Name: Mono-Eye Mask
261732001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mono-Eye's mask, the king of all robots from the Gundam series. You can't shake the feeling that Mono-Eye is watching you.

261740101.Name: Seed Pot
261740101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for people who love planting plants. Strangely enough, nothing grows here despite the tender watering.

261740201.Name: Red Antlers
261740201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A wearable pair of Rudolph's Antlers. It's as red as blood.
But Halloween is over. So it's not real blood.
Can be worn by Iris Yuma.

261750101.Name: Sprout Pot
261750101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who are experts at planting. Strangely the shoot doesn't grow, even though it gets enough water.

261750401.Name: Rudolph's Red Nose
261750401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The nose that's always lit up bright.
This nose makes the world so bright, it guides you through the fog at night.
Can be worn by Iris Yuma.

261760101.Name: Straw Hat
261760101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the hard-working plant growers. A hat made of straw that's so hard it only suits tough heroes and real scarecrows.

261770101.Name: Bird Egg Straw Hat
261770101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A straw hat that has become hot and crinkly from working in the sun. And there's still a nest on it – full of fresh eggs? A true symbol of recognition.

261780101.Name: Withered Sprout
261780101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who let their plants wither. Shocking yellow. We're equally guilty.

261790101.Name: Trowel above my head
261790101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for everyone whose plants can no longer be saved. The trowel isn't really stuck firmly in the head, so fingers off!

261800501.Name: Silver Hand
261800501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others. Lots of plants owe their lives to you.

261810501.Name: God's Hand
261810501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others as if they were their own. You've got genuine green fingers.

261822001.Name: Golden Mask
261822001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mask made of legendary gold. Can you feel the gold flow from your face into your veins?

261830101.Name: Tower above my head
261830101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tower that rises high above the head. Be careful in narrow tunnels and passages.

261850101.Name: [Freshman] Hat
261850101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event]<font color='#9D927B'>

Don't be surprised if someone mistakes you for a preschooler.

261851001.Name: [Freshman] Satchel
261851001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event]<font color='#9D927B'>

Don't be surprised if someone mistakes you for a preschooler.

261861001.Name: [EV] Relaxing Gruton Backpack
261861001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event Reward: Costume]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Backpack was designed after a Gruton fell asleep tired of hard work; slumber will overcome anyone who hugs this backpack.

261871001.Name: Equilibrium Mark
261871001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A symbol for D-Lines. Wearing it also symbolises the power to handle them.

261880101.Name: Eye of Observer
261880101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A helm for those who have distinguished themselves in battle against Gronco. Only a few of them were made in the old world. And the majority disappeared over time.

262010101.Name: [Miner] Safety Head Gear
262010101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Head Gear like the kind miners wear.

262010291.Name: [Transparent Costume] Hairstyle
262010291.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Always wanted to wear something only you can see?
Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Iris.

A dust mask like the kind miners wear.

262010501.Description:

Work gloves like the kind miners wear.

262010901.Description:

262021021.Description:

262021141.Name: [Youth and Passion] Sports Bag

[I'm Chloe, your operator!]

271075101.Description:
