271090701.Name: White T-Shirt
271090701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A t-shirt, rather white and plain. If you look good in a white t-shirt, you'll look good in anything. Who'll be the next Miss Cloudream?

271100301.Name: Heart Shaped Glasses
271100301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these heart-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. You'll either look like a mistake on legs or utterly adorable.

271100601.Name: Pure Pink Underwear
271100601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Chii's pure pink underwear. Only Can be worn by Chii. I wonder why that is...?

A skirt is a must to really show off the design.
Of course, they can also be showcased in the bath or shower at home.

271100701.Name: Checked Shirt
271100701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A plaid shirt. Depending on the combination with other pieces of clothing or accessories, you'll look either fabulous or frightful.

271110301.Name: Star Shaped Glasses
271110301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Absolutely wear these star-shaped glasses next time you go to an amusement park. Caveat: you might be mistaken for one of the staff.

271110601.Name: Pure Sky Underwear
271110601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

271110701.Name: Stripe Shirt
271110701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A plain t-shirt with unspectacular stripes. Everyone should have one. Perhaps... its appeal is its minimalist simplicity. Yeah, that's probably it.

271117081.Name: Star Earring
271117081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Earrings that sparkle brightly when they catch the light.
Can be worn by Chii.

271118081.Name: Heart Earring
271118081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

271119081.Name: Sakura Earring
271119081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Chii.

271120081.Name: Circle Earring
271120081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Chii.

271120301.Name: Glasses of Conspiracy
271120301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

These glasses make you look like an evil genius plotting to take over the world. Wear these and you'll be the villain with your own soundtrack.

271120601.Name: Stripe Underwear
271120601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Of course, they can also be showcased in the bath or shower at home.

271120801.Name: Ivory Skinny Jean
271120801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Skinny jeans in fashionable ivory... or is it banana? Absolutely do not wear these if your skin is the same Color. People have been charged with public indecency because of it.

271121041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Chii.

Can be worn by Chii.

271124041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Chii.

271125031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can be worn by Chii.

271126031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

They hamper your vision. But your face will be chosen amongst the hundred fairest in all the land.
Can be worn by Chii.

271130301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

271150101.Description:

271160101.Description:

271180101.Name: Mini Umbrella
271180101.Description:

A little umbrella that's so tiny it could fit in a cocktail. Brilliant in your hair, useless in the rain.

271181301.Name: Crumpled Paper Ball
271181301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

271190101.Description:

A conspicuous bow for your hair, as red as a rose. Only for women and very confident men.

271191301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A knitwear pouch. Not suited for heavy items.

271231061.Name: Cute Underwear Set
271231061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Underwear Set has been designed from precious materials of another world along with an aesthetic that just can't be described. With its soft fabric, this Underwear also has a cute ribbon attached as if it were a cherry on top.

271253021.Description:

Stripe Cow Hairband with cute-sized horn. The drooping ear looks sad somehow.

271254041.Description:

271255041.Description:

Choker with gold bell. This can ring with a clear sound.
Chii can wear it.

271279061.Name: Pure White Underwear
271279061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Chii's Pure White Underwear Can only be worn by Chii.

Underwear appearance can be checked when wearing a Skirt type piece of clothing.
Can also be checked in the bathtub or shower booth in My Room.

271300501.Name: Cure Jelly Bracelet
271300501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

One of those stylish gel bracelets with an amulet. Not just pretty, but healing too.

271311301.Name: Medic Box Crossbody Bag
271311301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hip bag which contains a complete first aid kit: very practical. Ready for use any time, anywhere to tend to injuries.

271320101.Name: Millionaire's Hat
271320101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's pretty hard on the neck. But what did you expect: it's gold!

271330101.Name: VVIP Icon
271330101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Trader Alliance only presents the VVIP Badge to special customers. After all, appreciation is very important to them. It's truly a tremendous honour. Until it occurs to you, the truly enormous amount of gold you've spent so far.

271341301.Name: Nano Kit Crossbody Bag
271341301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Made for transporting stuff. It can be used to repair broken items anywhere at any time.

271351001.Name: XL Monkey Wrench
271351001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

This excessively large wrench is only for people who actually finish their repairs. Makes you look like the king of DIY.

271360501.Name: Resurrector Bracelet
271360501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet with a respawn amulet. It'll save your life some day.

271370101.Name: Angel Ring
271370101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

For those who have died so many deaths that they have finally made it to a higher plane. Put it on and you'll practically be an angel.

271380101.Name: Junk Knight's Head Gear
271380101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Junk Knight's headgear was designed using data obtained from the defeated Soul Junk. The headgear gives you an inkling of what life as a Junk Knight is like.

271392001.Name: Puppet Mask
271392001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The mask was developed utilising data from the defeated mannequins. It's a very lifelike replica. Make sure you don't get mistaken for one of the Soulless!

271400501.Name: NED Co. Bracelet
271400501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The bracelet was developed based on data from the NED Company. It lets you pass undetected as an NED Company employee.

271410101.Name: Horn of Rapid Flame
271410101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

These attachable horns were inspired by countless defeated Rapid Flame Vessi. You could easily pass as a Vessi.

271420101.Name: Air Drone
271420101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Developed based on data gleaned from countless defeated robots. Don't be fooled. Eagle-Eye isn't dangerous otherwise.

271430301.Name: Raban's Sunglasses
271430301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

These sunglasses imitate the glasses worn by Near SoulWorker Raban. This creation is one of the SFL's contributions to the numerous battles.

271440501.Name: Broken Shield Bracelet
271440501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bracelet shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

271451001.Name: Broken Shield Bag
271451001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a broken shield. But this shattered shield doesn't offer much protection.

271460101.Name: Combo Icon
271460101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

So many combos have been used here that the combo counter has short-circuited and is now burned into the air as a floating, glowing symbol. The Starry Forest research lab converted it into a hairband, making it more cozy to wear. Combos should be so much easier with it.

271470101.Name: Blue Question Mark Icon
271470101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have dealt with certain concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants. Careful, though: if you wear this badge, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident whose concern is being looked into.

271480101.Name: Blue Exclamation Mark Icon
271480101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who devote themselves to handling the concerns of Cloudream's inhabitants around the clock. Careful, though: if you wear this exclamation mark, other SoulWorkers might mistake you for a resident with a new concern.

271490501.Name: Wrist Compass
271490501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who practically live in the quest area. With this you'll never get lost again.

271501001.Name: Explorer's Bag
271501001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A badge of recognition for those who have wandered around the quest area a fair bit. You can survive anything.

271510101.Name: Hot Wine
271510101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A glowing glass attached to a hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the sake wine is still warm. If only you could just drink from the glass during the quest!

271520101.Name: Hot Curry
271520101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A steaming rice dish attached to the hairband. The quest was completed so fast that the 3-minute instant curry is still palatable. If only you could actually eat it!

271530101.Name: S+ Icon
271530101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Hair Decoration was created to celebrate achieving Mission Completion Rank S+ multiple times. And much like the S+ rank, the Icon looks glorious even from miles away.

271540101.Name: Premium S+ Icon
271540101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Hair Decoration was created to celebrate achieving Mission Completion Rank S+ multiple times. Fancy wings were added as decoration. And much like the S+ rank, the Icon looks glorious even from miles away.

271550101.Name: F Icon
271550101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. A big, bold F burns in the distance like a stigma.

271560101.Name: Premium F Icon
271560101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

An accessory for a SoulWorker who frequently completes quests with an F rating. It takes an awful lot of work to get an F rating so often. A shining F and devil's wings reward this impressive feat.

271570501.Name: Coin Pendant Bracelet
271570501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A coin collector's dream: an amulet made from coins. It's an enormous help in collecting coins.

271580101.Name: Piggy Bank Hat
271580101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Headwear for people who keep collecting coins and need somewhere to horde them. Smash in emergencies!

271590501.Name: Ether Bracelet
271590501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Aether band made from refined Aethar. The Aethar Band makes collecting Aethar much easier.

271600301.Name: Ether Shaped Glasses
271600301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Aether Glasses made from refined Aethar. You'll be able to see Aethar even in places where there isn't any.

271611301.Name: Hourglass Crossbody Bag
271611301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

An hourglass created from nothing. It is believed to have appeared when the SoulWorkers first saw the light of the world. It can be used as a normal bag.

271621001.Name: Alarm Clock Bag
271621001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

An alarm clock that counts the minutes since the SoulWorkers arrived on Earth. It is rumoured to have popped out of thin air. It can be used like a normal bag.

271630101.Name: Dreamland Hat
271630101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. Works better than any sleeping pill.

271641001.Name: Bedtime Doll
271641001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the tired adventurer who wants to enjoy a proper night's sleep. This cute cuddly doll comes as a bag for easier transport. Works better than any sleeping pill.

271650301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Goggles
271650301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of hacking goggles, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, these goggles don't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

271661301.Name: Trisha's Hacker Module
271661301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hacking module, presented to you as thanks for using Trisha's services so often. Trisha spared no expense to show her gratitude. However, this module doesn't really have any hacking features. It's just that the design is based on the original.

271672001.Name: Janice's  Cat Mask
271672001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cat mask, presented to you as thanks for using Janice's crafting skills so often. Janice's gratitude and loyalty are what make this item valuable.

271681001.Name: Janice's  Walking Backpack
271681001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A roomy bag, presented to you as thanks for using Janice's crafting skills so often. It is completely empty. Janice's gratitude and loyalty are what make this item valuable.

271691001.Name: [EV] Gruton Backpack
271691001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A rucksack shaped like a Gruton. It seems quite cute at first glance, but on closer inspection looks like a real Gruton. Creepy...

271702001.Name: Marionette Mask
271702001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is what Mad Edgar's intact mask would look like. The mask makes it easy to hide your feelings.

271712001.Name: Spider Queen Mask
271712001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The head of a Violet Murder served as inspiration for this mask. Quite fitting for a suspicious team.

271722001.Name: Phantom Mask
271722001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Phantom's mask served as inspiration. It has several holes for the eyes, but you don't see more because of them.

271732001.Name: Mono-Eye Mask
271732001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mono-Eye's mask, the king of all robots from the Gundam series. You can't shake the feeling that Mono-Eye is watching you.

271740101.Name: Seed Pot
271740101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair decoration for people who love plants. Strangely enough, nothing grows here despite the tender watering.

271750101.Name: Sprout Pot
271750101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who are experts at planting. Strangely, the shoot doesn't grow, even though it gets enough water.

271760101.Name: Straw Hat
271760101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

For the hard-working farmers among you. A hat made of straw that's so hard it only suits tough heroes and real scarecrows.

271770101.Name: Bird Egg Straw Hat
271770101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A straw hat that has become hot and crinkly from working in the sun. And there's still a nest on it – full of fresh eggs? A true symbol of recognition.

271780101.Name: Withered Sprout
271780101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for all those who let their plants wither. Shocking yellow. We're equally guilty.

271790101.Name: Trowel above my head
271790101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A hair accessory for everyone whose plants can no longer be saved. The trowel isn't really stuck firmly in the head, so fingers off!

271800501.Name: Silver Hand
271800501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others. Lots of plants owe their lives to you.

271810501.Name: God's Hand
271810501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gloves to thank all those who care for the plants of others as if they were their own. You've got genuine green fingers.

271822001.Name: Golden Mask
271822001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mask made of legendary gold. Can you feel the gold flow from your face into your veins?

271830101.Name: Tower above my head
271830101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tower that rises high above the head. Be careful in narrow tunnels and passages.

271881901.Name: Eye of Observer
271881901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A helm for those who have distinguished themselves in battle against Gronco. Only a few of them were made in the old world. And the majority disappeared over time.

272000101.Name: Proof of Heaven
272000101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A celestial being left behind these wings as a mark of favor for souls whose power resides in the unseen. The cooling winds of twilight will carry them away, so do not become attached to them.

<font color='#FFFF00'>Only usable until the next season.

272001101.Name: Proof of Dark night
272001101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A celestial being left behind these wings as a mark of favor for souls whose power resides in the unseen. The cooling winds of twilight will carry them away, so do not become attached to them.

<font color='#FFFF00'>Only usable until the next season.

272001141.Name: [Youth and Passion] Shinai
272001141.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Soul Weapon Hologram: Katana]<font color='#9D927B'>

Feel the entirety of youth heavily sweating in the hot sun! It is a hologram form of Youth and Passion Shinai.
This merely takes on the shape of a Soul Weapon, so it doesn't have any powerful performance.
Chii can wear it.

272003041.Name: [Miner] Dust Mask
272003041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A dust mask like the kind miners wear.

272003051.Name: [Miner] Work Gloves

Work gloves like the kind miners wear.

272003121.Name: [Miner] Boots

These officer's glasses were issued by the SFL. Ready, set... fight!

272006011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Headphones issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. The latest version. Makes you hum along... even without music.

272006021.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Military Beret
272006021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The beret issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. You have to hand it to our enemies at the NED Company: they've got style.

272006031.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Scouter
272006031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The radio glasses issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. Wow... does combat strength really increase above 9000?

272006051.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Gloves
272006051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

272006071.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Top
272006071.Description:

The top issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. It is lined around the neck and cosy warm.

272006081.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Bottoms
272006081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The trousers issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. Their crease is immaculate.

272006101.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Business Bag
272006101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

The laptop bag issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. One wouldn't expect anything less from the NED Company's elite.

272006121.Name: [NED Co. Elite Uniform] Boots
272006121.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

The boots issued to the NED Company's jet-set mercenaries. Made from breathable fabric!

272010291.Name: [Transparent Costume] Hairstyle
272010291.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Always wanted to wear something only you can see?
Now's the time to dress the way you always wanted.
Can be worn by Chii.

272021101.Description:
<font color='#FFBB85'>[Costume Package]<font color='#9D927B'>

[Chii's Made in Cafe] This is a package containing a costume and a photo, and only Chii can wear these items.

-Components-
[Made in Cafe] Headband
[Made in Cafe] Costume
[Made in Cafe] Gloves
[Made in Cafe] Stockings
[Made in Cafe] Shoes

272035101.Name: Corrupted Fearful Wing
272035101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Transience transforms even that fear which freezes blood. Having lost their last ounce of courage, these wings have turned a frozen red.
Can be worn by Chii.

272036101.Name: Corrupted Torment Wing
272036101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Costume PKG]<font color='#9D927B'>

Transience transforms even that pain which pierces the soul. The loss of all joy has left these wings a bruised purple.
Can be worn by Chii.

272037101.Name: Corrupted Destructive Wing
272037101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This has dark and gold shape of wings, because of lost peace and honor from the past which was caused of unbearable destruction.
Can be worn by Chii.

272038101.Name: Corrupted Hateful Wing
272038101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This has dark and gold shape of wings, because of lost peace and honor from the past which was caused of unbearable destruction.
Can be worn by Chii.

272039101.Name: Corrupted Agony Wing
272039101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Costume PKG]<font color='#9D927B'>

Transience glorifies memories. The torment over what is lost casts these wings in a gloomy light.
Can be worn by Chii.

272041021.Name: [Detective Acad. Woman] Newsboy Cap
272041021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Newsboy Cap worn by Detective Academy woman. Can help us solve mystery cases easily.

272041091.Name: [Detective Acad. Woman] Uniform
272041091.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Uniform that is worn by Detective Academy woman. Can help us solve mystery cases easily. Can wear Top-Bottom together.

272041111.Name: [Detective Acad. Woman] Over Knee Socks
272041111.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Over Knee Socks worn by Detective Academy woman. Can help us solve mystery cases easily.

272041121.Name: [Detective Acad. Woman] Sandals
272041121.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sandals that is worn by Detective Academy woman. Can help us solve mystery cases easily.

272041911.Name: ഀ䜀爀甀琀漀渀 䴀愀猀焀甀攀
272041911.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Masque was created with the images of Grutons found all over Cloudream.
Because the head can be fully secured, this masque gives one who wears it a warm, comfortable feeling.
Can be worn by Chii.

272042031.Name: 8-Bit Pixel Sunglasses
272042031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

This uniquely shaped pair of 8-Bit Pixel Type Sunglasses doesn't actually do its job quite well but does make one feel like a movie star.
Can be worn by Chii.

272049101.Description:

Erwin Backpack x 1

272053101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

272058051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Warm fur gloves for playing with cold snow.
Chii can wear it.

272077101.Name: Mesmerizing Fairy Wing
272077101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

Small fairy wings made with hologram. Mesmerizing mood, full of purple lights.
Can create the feeling of a cute fairy, even though you cannot fly around after you equip.

272083021.Name: [Nurse Outfit] Nurse Cap
272083021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Nurse cap for nurses. Feels like it fulfills a certain desire.
Can be worn by Chii.

272083091.Name: [Nurse Outfit] Uniform
272083091.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Nurse uniform for nurses. Can wear Top-Bottom together. Feels like it fulfills a certain desire.
Can be worn by Chii.

The nurse’s shoes, worn as part of the nurse outfit, give a sense of fulfilling a unique form of romance.

272085101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Appearance]<font color='#9D927B'>

A suit for researching the interior of the Great Vacuum. Although nothing is yet known about the Great Vacuum, it's possible a blueprint exists for it. Maybe a blueprint was drafted in another timeline...

Chii can wear it.

272208101.Name: The Little Ghost
272208101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Wandering ghost constantly floating around you smiling. Floating next to you. They can get in the way sometime, but let's be nice to them since they don't seem like a naughty kid.
Chii can wear it.

272209021.Name: The Little Ghost's Silk Hat
272209021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cute Silk Hat, rather than being elegant. Don't misunderstand that the hat size is small. This is not exclusively for dogs or cats, but entirely for humans.
Chii can wear it.

272210011.Name: Jack-O'-Earrings
272210011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Jack-O'-Lantern's Earrings that represent Halloween. Earrings with Jack-O'-Lantern decoration, and it shines softly. It's perfect for a Halloween party.
Chii can wear it.

272211911.Name: n. A Mask covered with giant Jack-O'-Lantern, it shines with scary light. It's perfect for a Hallowee

272212021.Name: Undead Charm
272212021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

An amulet of Shaman that is used for resurrecting the dead. It feels creepy because this is a token of the undead. There is no problem if a live person wears it. 
Chii can wear it.

272213201.Name: Pierrot Mask
272213201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Pierrot Mask provokes strange fear. It scares you and makes you panic if you make eye contact. What kind of face is hiding underneath the face of a clown?
Chii can wear it.

272226611.Name: Snow Crystal
272226611.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Beautiful snow crystal makes Christmas mood, above SoulWorker's head.
Chii can wear it.

272227611.Name: Twinkle Star
272227611.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Cute twinkle star crystal makes Christmas mood, above SoulWorker's head.
Chii can wear it.

272245101.Name: Fancy Emergence Wing
272245101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Wings with fancy purple light, hiding vibrating energy within the wings.
Shines brightly everywhere, but much more beautiful in the dark.
Chii can wear it.

272246101.Name: Brilliant Emergence Wing
272246101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Wings with fancy red light, hiding vibrating energy within the wings.
Shines brightly everywhere, but much more beautiful in the dark.
Chii can wear it.

272247101.Name: Mesmerizing Emergence Wing
272247101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Wings with fancy blue light, hiding vibrating energy within the wings.
Shines brightly everywhere, but much more beautiful in the dark.
Chii can wear it.

272259011.Name: [Dancing Scarlet Butterfly] Earrings
272259011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

These Earrings are made by referring to the clothes worn by Flaming Vessi bayadères full of passion and desire.
Dance and show off your charms with fancy choreography.
Chii can wear it.
