360010102.Name: Old Armband
360010102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

An old brassard bearing the Fortune Corps. mark of the SFL Med Squad. 
Miriam has worn it for a long time, so it looks a bit used and dirty.

360010103.Name: Neat Armband
360010103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

An old brassard bearing the Fortune Corps. mark of the SFL Med Squad.
It is very new, which also means it is stiff and uncomfortable. Is that why it needs readjusting almost constantly?

360010104.Name: Glittering Armband
360010104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

An old brassard bearing the Fortune Corps. mark of the SFL Med Squad.
It looks so valuable and is so bright it hurts the eyes.

360010105.Name: Dazzling Armband
360010105.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

An old brassard bearing the Fortune Corps. mark of the SFL Med Squad.
Miriam's Soul Energy had such an impact on it that it now gleams in stunning white. Simply owning it imparts healing.

360010201.Name: Old Hairband
360010201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

A hairband for tying or pleating your hair.
It is very ordinary and seen a lot. Miriam has worn it for a very long time, which is why it looks a bit used and dirty.

360010202.Name: Neat Hairband
360010202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

A hairband for tying or pleating your hair.
It is very ordinary and seen a lot. You bought it off Yomi just recently.

360010203.Name: Glittering Hairband
360010203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

A hairband for tying or pleating your hair.
It glitters so brightly it hurts the eyes.

360010204.Name: Dazzling Hairband
360010204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Miriam<font color='#9D927B'>

A hairband for tying or pleating your hair.
Miriam's Soul Energy called forth its snowy glow. Simply owning it imparts healing.

360020102.Name: Scruffy Gloves
360020102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

White gloves issued by the SFL. 
They are clean, but have been worn for so long that they have become threadbare and holey.

360020103.Name: Clean Gloves
360020103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

White gloves issued by the SFL.
They were taken straight out of the package. Rumour has it that there are thousands of these gloves.

360020104.Name: Burnishing Gloves
360020104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

White gloves issued by the SFL.
Soft as cotton, these gloves have been dermatologically tested and approved.

360020105.Name: Flawless Gloves
360020105.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>


White gloves issued by the SFL.
Wilba only wears them in combat. When he has activated all his Soul Energy, he won't permit even a speck of dust to blemish them.

360020201.Name: Foggy Glasses
360020201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

Black horn-rimmed glasses, quite common.
They are slightly bent from wear and tear. They require frequent readjusting, which may make them uncozy to wear.

360020202.Name: Clear Glasses
360020202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

Black horn-rimmed glasses, quite common.
They were taken straight out of the package. Rumour has it there are thousands of these glasses.

360020203.Name: Smooth Glasses
360020203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

Black horn-rimmed glasses, quite common.
These specially coated glasses were custom-made for Wilba. No matter how dirty they get, tap them once and they will look as good as new.

360020204.Name: Flawless Glasses
360020204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Wilba<font color='#9D927B'>

Black horn-rimmed glasses, quite common.
Wilba only wears them in combat. When he has activated all his Soul Energy, he won't permit even a speck of dust to blemish them.

360030101.Name: Wet Bullet
360030101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A bullet, soaked in sweat. It's unserviceable. It is suspended from a military-looking chain to serve as a talisman.
Allegedly, the metal of the cartridge was used to make a ring for Leona. She rejected him , so he wears it on a chain.

360030102.Name: Basic Bullet
360030102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

This bullet has been made to standard.
It's used at the NED Company and the SFL. The bullet is slightly larger than the 5.56 NATO in use before the Great Vacuum.

360030103.Name: Pierce Bullet
360030103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A shell that busts through even steel and concrete.
Ever since the Soul Junks stepped up their onslaught after the Great Vacuum, this ammo has seen more frequent use than normal projectiles.

360030104.Name: Napalm Bullet
360030104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A projectile designed specifically for fighting Soul Junks.
The description says it explodes on contact and burns the target to a cinder. A highly dangerous bullet. Even so, a fearless mercenary is said to take these bullets with his bare hands and literally smash them into the Soul Junks.

360030202.Name: Battered Magazine
360030202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A magazine that has seen a lot of use and is dented on one side.
It is probably older than its current owner.

360030203.Name: Basic Magazine
360030203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A magazine for ordinary rounds. 
It holds up to 30 bullets. It has been manufactured to standard and fits in all small firearms.

360030204.Name: Pierce Magazine
360030204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A specialised magazine which holds steel tank ammo.
It holds up to 30 bullets. It has been manufactured to standard and fits in all small firearms.

360030205.Name: Napalm Magazine
360030205.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Ralph<font color='#9D927B'>

A specialised magazine which holds explosive bullets.
The hazardous nature of explosive bullets makes the magazine more expensive than the ammo. The magazine is made from titanium. A special mechanism seals heat within, ensuring there is no risk of explosion.

360040101.Name: Rusty Hinge
360040101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

It is old and emits an eerie squeak whenever it is moved.
The hinge is probably what has got Trashbert on edge.

360040102.Name: Smooth Hinge
360040102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A smooth hinge made by the Trader Alliance.
It is not clear what materials were used to make it. Thankfully, it moves smoothly and without squeaking.

360040103.Name: High Quality Hinge
360040103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A high-quality hinge made by the Trader Alliance.
Ornaments have been engraved into the hinge by a masterful hand. It looks so beautiful that just about anybody would buy it.

360040104.Name: Brand Hinge
360040104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A brand hinge made by the Trader Alliance.
Its stunning ornamentation and noiseless movement are out of this world. Hard to believe it is just a hinge. A masterpiece. This is no ordinary dustbin, is it?

360040201.Name: Dirty Water Filter
360040201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A filter that purifies rain water and makes it potable.
It is not working properly yet, which is why the rain water has a peculiar flavour.

360040202.Name: Clean Water Filter
360040202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A filter that purifies rain water and makes it potable.
Improved filtering means the water can be enjoyed without any concern.

360040203.Name: High Quality Water Filter
360040203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A filter that purifies rain water and makes it potable.
Improved filtering means the water can be enjoyed without any concern. The water actually tastes sweet.

360040204.Name: Brand Water Filter
360040204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Trashbert<font color='#9D927B'>

A filter that makes water potable, no matter how dirty it was to begin with.
It goes well beyond what you would expect of a normal filter. This filter is virtually divine and performs miracles. A rubbish bin like that would be worth buying.

360050101.Name: Tattered Heat Cloak
360050101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A coat that Kane Barrel wore for a long time.
It shows signs of heavy combat.

360050102.Name: Heat Cloak
360050102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A coat that Kane Barrel wore for a long time.
It hasn't been worn all that long and is in relatively good condition.

360050103.Name: Custom Heat Cloak
360050103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A coat that Kane Barrel wore for a long time.
It is gear that was custom-made for Kane Barrel and thus is better than a standard issue. It can adjust the internal temperature in accordance to ambient temperatures.

360050104.Name: Limited Heat Cloak
360050104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A coat that Kane Barrel wore for a long time.
The SFL custom-made this gear for Kane Barrel. This unique coat not only protects against heat, it can also deflect bullets if they are not fired point blank.

360050201.Name: Stretched Bracelet
360050201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A thick bracelet that protects the wrists.
It has seen a lot of use and is quite run-down.

360050202.Name: Fit Bracelet
360050202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A thick bracelet that protects the wrists.
This bracelet was custom-fit to Kane Barrel's wrist. It's a bit uncomfortable.

360050203.Name: Custom Bracelet
360050203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A thick bracelet that protects the wrists.
An exclusive piece of Armor for Kane Barrel. It is made from leather and wool. The outer layer consists of specially made macromolecule steel. This type of bracelet is not exactly weightless, which is why only a few have wrists strong enough to wear it.

360050204.Name: Limited Bracelet
360050204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Kane Barrel<font color='#9D927B'>

A thick bracelet that protects the wrists.
A unique bracelet which the SFL had custom-made for Kane Barrel. It consists of a macromolecule steel and titanium alloy. Used with Soul Energy, its size allegedly increases to make it into a shield.

360060101.Name: Tattered Name Tag
360060101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A tag that is attached to a pet's collar.
This one is chewed and dirty, which makes it barely legible. It looks like it says Goldie.

360060102.Name: Name Tag
360060102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A tag that is attached to a pet's collar.
The name tag bears the Heavy Artillery insignia, which is also where it was made. Goldie seems to like it.

360060103.Name: Silver Name Tag
360060103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A tag that is attached to a pet's collar.
The name tag bears the Heavy Artillery insignia, which is also where it was made. Its silver-plated frame lends it an air of supreme quality.

360060104.Name: Golden Name Tag
360060104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A tag that is attached to a pet's collar.
The name tag bears the Heavy Artillery insignia, which is also where it was made. Its gold-plated frame lends it an air of supreme quality.

360060201.Name: Broken Aviator Goggles
360060201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of pilot goggles to protect the eyes.
The lenses are scratched, rendering them almost useless. Goldie doesn't seem to mind.

360060202.Name: Aviator Goggles
360060202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of pilot goggles to protect the eyes.
Even a human would have no trouble using these glasses. However, we don't have anyone who can fly a plane, so Goldie is getting them.

360060203.Name: Silver Aviator Goggles
360060203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of pilot goggles to protect the eyes.
A pair of pilot goggles with silver ornaments. They may be a touch on the ostentatious side. However, we don't have anyone who can fly a plane, so Goldie is getting them.

360060204.Name: Golden Aviator Goggles
360060204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Goldie<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of pilot goggles to protect the eyes.
A pair of pilot goggles with gold ornaments. They may be a touch on the ostentatious side. However, we don't have anyone who can fly a plane, so Goldie is getting them.

360070101.Name: 1T HDD
360070101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

A hard drive that has room for tons of information.
It contains the data for AI Lucy. It also stores basic functions and designs.

360070102.Name: 2T HDD
360070102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

A hard drive that has room for tons of information.
It contains the data for AI Lucy. It also stores basic functions, designs and information about Ruin Fortress.

360070103.Name: 4T HDD
360070103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

A hard drive that has room for tons of information.
It contains the data for AI Lucy. It also stores basic functions, designs and information about Ruin Fortress, as well as other data.

360070104.Name: 8T HDD
360070104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

A hard drive that has room for tons of information.
It contains the data for AI Lucy. All the information about Lucy is on it. In contrast to the time when it was at Ruin Fortress, the hard drive has evolved into an independent object.

360070201.Name: 4G RAM
360070201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

Random access memory that can read data from other memories and write onto other memories.
RAM that was already in use before the Great Vacuum. It offers far too little volume to run modern programs.

360070202.Name: 8G RAM
360070202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

Random access memory that can read data from other memories and write onto other memories.
RAM that was already in use before the Great Vacuum. It offers far too little volume to run modern programs.

360070203.Name: 12G RAM
360070203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

Random access memory that can read data from other memories and write onto other memories.
RAM that has become rather popular since the Great Vacuum. It is entirely adequate for civilian computers. A powerful AI like Lucy is a different matter, however, and it is not quite sufficient to run all operations.

360070204.Name: 16G RAM
360070204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Lucy<font color='#9D927B'>

Random access memory that can read data from other memories and write onto other memories.
RAM that has become rather popular since the Great Vacuum. It is entirely adequate for civilian computers. A powerful AI like Lucy is a different matter, however, and it is not quite sufficient to run all operations.

360080101.Name: One Button Controller
360080101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

A controller used to operate Janice's Uriel.
It consists of just a stick and a button. This means precision control is impossible.

360080102.Name: Cross Controller
360080102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

A controller used to operate Janice's Uriel.
It consists of just a stick and a cross button. Compared to the one-button controller, this device enables greater precision.

360080103.Name: Dual Analog Controller
360080103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

A controller used to operate Janice's Uriel.
It consists of just a stick and analogue buttons. It features more buttons than a cross controller. The controls are a little complicated, but movement is far more precise.

360080104.Name: Gesture Controller
360080104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

A controller used to operate Janice's Uriel.
This device easily surpasses conventional controllers. It detects movements and the Uriel moves in response. Janice's Uriel is operated with finger gestures. This control method may take some time to get used to.

360080201.Name: 2V Battery
360080201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

Batteries for the Uriel's remote control.
The 2 V battery made by the Trader Alliance is low voltage and extremely short-lived.

360080202.Name: 4V Battery
360080202.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

Batteries for the Uriel's remote control.
The 4 V battery made by the Trader Alliance is low voltage and short-lived.

360080203.Name: 8V Battery
360080203.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

Batteries for the Uriel's remote control.
The 8 V battery made by the Trader Alliance is low voltage, but its battery life has been doubled.

360080204.Name: 16V Battery
360080204.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Ally Gear: Janice's Uriel<font color='#9D927B'>

Batteries for the Uriel's remote control.
The 16 V battery made by the Trader Alliance is low voltage, but its battery life has been extended considerably.

379910101.Name: Orb of Attack
379910101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>(Ally Gear: Everyone) Equip allies with it to Upgrade Attack.<font color='#9D927B'>

A shining orb that contains the power of accepting destiny. Allies can equip the orb to increase their attack skills.

379910102.Name: Orb of Defense
379910102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>(Ally Gear: Everyone) Equip allies with it to Upgrade Defense.<font color='#9D927B'>

A shining orb that contains the power of accepting destiny. Allies can equip the orb to increase their Defense skills.

380000001.Name: Ultimate Theft
380000001.Description:
A red and pointy thorn that has the ability to suck the life out of others. One of the creatures made from NED Company, which also largely exists within Dignity Snatcher. If only this was known earlier… 
Can be obtained at Steel Graves. 

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Dignity Snatcher].

380000002.Name: Sound Device
380000002.Description:
Core Part of sonar missile created and designed by senior doctor Sedurin from S.T Lab. It disturbs balance part of target by generating wide range high output ultrasound when activated. It has fancy name, Sound Device, but it is actually giant speaker.
Can be obtained at Steel Graves.

Key Item of [Akashic Record: F-ARIA].

380000003.Name: Piece of Puppet
380000003.Description:
Fragment of temptation stone which can be called the power source of dolls created by Edgar. It gives off force that seems to pressuring down the air, and also it emits subtle blue light. It is called temptation stone because you get mesmerized if you stare it. 
Can be obtained at Casual Raid. 

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Piece of Temptation]

380000004.Name: Rough but Pure Heart
380000004.Description:
Data chip with pure and passionate heart toward Jack The King Edgar. It feels empty-hearted that the source of passionate love was only data, but it is little unfortunate. Misunderstanding artificial emotion with our own emotion… Don't even want to touch.
Can obtain from Jack The King, Tower of Grid EP: 4 Boss

Key item of [Akashic Record: Jack The King]

380000005.Name: Blue Baton
380000005.Description:
Blue wand used by Blue Flame Clown Edgar. There is blue jewelry at the tip of the wand, shine brightly at the tip of the wand. Dolls are controlled by original wavelength which comes out from the jewelry. Perhaps we can play with dolls however we want. Shall we ask them to clean the house first? 
Can be obtained from Edgar, Best Showtime EP:4 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Dancing Dolls]

380000006.Name: Black Helmet Fragment
380000006.Description:
Fragment of Helmet on the head of Junk Knight. Feels like unfortunate energy is fluttering in black. By putting on Head Gear, it makes you scream [Frozen Heart! Bloody Flag! Law of Junk Knight!] regardless of your own will.
Can be obtained from Junk Knight, Junk Pool EP:4 Boss. 

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Junk Knight]

380000007.Name: Tattered Script
380000007.Description:
Tattered script through heavy use. Full of classic comments, and simple greetings. Tightly written with cautions and hand written tones by Cynthia. There are message written to herself [Cheer up, Cynthia] at the bottom of page.
Can be obtained from Duke Spider, The Big Mouse: EP:3 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Cynthia]

380000008.Name: Arachness's Crown
380000008.Description:
Queen of Soul Junk in spider form, crown of Arachness. It is too vague to be called a crown, since it was only tiny body part which was held on the head of Arachness. It is not about whether it is an actual crown, it is about when and where it came from... It was only tiny body part hanging on the head.
Can be obtained from Arachness, The Big Mouse EP:4 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Arachness]

380000009.Name: Snake Fragment
380000009.Description:
Snake fragment of gigantic joint war weapon summoned by green wind witch Poison. According to component analysis, discovered that it is product of overwhelming technology in the middle of life and machinery. Vessi must be real alien.
Can be obtained from Poison, NED Company EP: 4 Boss

Key item of [Akashic Record: Snake]

380000010.Name: Red Blindfold
380000010.Description:
Eye patch worn by Scar. Not sure if it was red, or turned red by blood. What is real is that it contains the fighting spirit of Scar, and it gives you strength to fight just by staring at it.
Can be obtained from Bloody Scar, Cold Rain EP: 4 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Scar]

380000011.Name: Piece of Scarf
380000011.Description:
Piece of scarf from White Fang, the second commander of assassination force. White Fang doesn't actually wear scarf, so we cannot know whether it is piece of scarf, or scraps of underwear.
Can be obtained from White Fang, Flame Breaker EP: 2 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: White Fang]

380000012.Name: Fire Extinguisher
380000012.Description:
Fire extinguisher mounted inside of Skoll. They carry it around in case of fire accident, since it spits fire. But the thing is, it only and always spits fire, so we can not know.
Can be obtained from Domineer Zero, Buster Core EP: 1 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Skoll]

380000013.Name: Warning Light
380000013.Description:
A warning light that announce the danger by spinning with red light. Mounted inside of tracker. But if it is warning light, it should be attached on the outside...
Can be obtained from Heavy Punisher, and Heavy Fire Ruler, Forgotten Armory EP: 1 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Tracker]

380000014.Name: Finger of Gigantic Robot
380000014.Description:
Finger of giant robot Deus Ex Machina. It is so big that it can destroy you if you get hit by finger. Brought only 1 finger because it was not heavy. It's true.
Can be obtained from Deus Ex Machina, Forgotten Armory EP: 4 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Deus Ex Machina]

380000015.Name: Red Core
380000015.Description:
Red core emits thin light as if it is actually alive. It is Wild Stone which make up most of Soul Junk Wild Stone's body. This is Wild Stone.
Can be obtained from Lord Scawn, Concrete Jungle EP: 1 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Wild Stone]

380000016.Name: Martial Arts Manual
380000016.Description:
Impressive Martial Arts manual with a cover of muscular man with fancy pose. It is full of actual fight techniques, and some of techniques can put someone's life at risk. On the side of book, it is stamped with name 'Brooke'.
Can be obtained from Warlike, Concrete Jungle EP: 2 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Brooke]

380000017.Name: Raving Core
380000017.Description:
A beating core looks like about to surge and explode quickly. If leave it alone, it could just disappear. Warlike's core, which very belligerent, makes you angry just by staring at it. Just want to crush everything.
Can be obtained from Land Crasher, Concrete Jungle EP: 3 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Warlike]

380000018.Name: Solid Rock
380000018.Description:
Chunk of rock disassembled and repeatedly fused by Soul Junk slime. Small mass, but in terms of weight and solidity, it seems more solid than any other rocks. If you carry it with you in an elevator, you can use elevator alone because of 'Full Capacity' sign on elevator.
Can be obtained from Asphalt Golem, Concrete Jungle EP: 4 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Asphalt Golem]

380000019.Name: Red Jewelike Furuncle
380000019.Description:
Red furuncle of Sewer Rat dwell in underground waterway. Seems like shining red jewelry from distance. This might be helpful for dieting because if you touch it, you can feel it's own unique squishy touch, like full of liquid.
Can be obtained from Crude Cell, Junk Pool EP: 1 Boss

Key Item of [Akashic Record: Sewer Rat]

380000020.Name: Blind Eye
380000020.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Venom Mucus's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Venom Mucus's eye. It has atrophied and no longer functions. Usually, the eye is the organ that enables us to see. But Venom Mucus's eye has gone blind. If it can't see, is it still an eye? It surely is an eye, but one that leaves you in the dark. So what makes an eye, an eye?
Retrieve the eye in Junk Pool Ep. 3.

380000021.Name: Rough Teeth
380000021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Caimanoc's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Giga Soul Junk Caimanoc has jaws that would make the greatest crocodile proud. Strangely enough, his teeth aren't particularly hard, just tough and sticky. Apparently, crocodiles enjoy their daily sunbathing with their mouths wide open. Wouldn't it have been easier to pull the teeth while he's bathing?
Retrieve the tooth in Junk Pool Ep. 2.

380000022.Name: Black Mist
380000022.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Pike's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The Pike is surrounded by black smoke. It is assumed that this smoke is what allows the wingless Pike to float in the air. So far, this theory has not been substantiated. But the question remains: where does the smoke come from?
Retrieve the smoke in The Big Mouth Ep. 1.

380000023.Name: Crimson Core
380000023.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Mangrove Skitter's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A core that is black-red, almost bloody and forms the Mangrove Skitter. Parts of the core are damaged. Is it because it's the core of an object that mutated as a result of crimes against its own race? Does this mean combat is the fastest way to evolve?
Retrieve the core in The Big Mouth Ep. 2.

380000024.Name: Distorted Cell
380000024.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Skitter's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Cells of Soul Junk Skitter, artificially grown. These cells are deformed because they did not develop naturally like they would in the Great Vacuum. Does this mean that whatever natural things mankind touches, it destroys?
Retrieve the cells in N-102 Shelter Ep. 1.

380000025.Name: Shattered Bone
380000025.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: S-01's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

An artificial skeleton of Soul Junk S-01. It acts as a support for the sagging slime, but the slime's toxicity has dissolved some of the bones. Grip it too hard and it's bound to crumble. So fragile.
Retrieve the skeleton in N-102 Shelter Ep. 2.

380000026.Name: Old-Timer's Glasses
380000026.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Mangrove Victor's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of glasses with a seriously ‘old school' design. They make the wearer look a good 20 years older. Despite the awful look, they are made from high-quality materials and are in good shape. The name of their previous owner is engraved on the frame of the glasses. Whoever he was, he deserves our respect for that taste!
Retrieve the glasses in N-102 Shelter Ep. 3.

380000027.Name: Stimulant
380000027.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Beholder's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A substance normally administered to Soul Junks to awaken them as Adv. Soul Junks. The substance penetrates the nucleus, causing destruction and simultaneous regeneration, giving birth to something entirely new. The whole thing sounds spectacular but has little chance of succeeding.
Retrieve the substance in N-102 Shelter Ep. 4.

380000028.Name: Explosives
380000028.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Chokhmah's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

This material is part of a Chokhmah, which can fly through the air and detonate itself whenever it loses the upper hand. It seems the explosives spread throughout Chokhmah bodies detonate all at once shortly before the moment of death. Perhaps carrying these explosives around isn't such a clever idea, after all...
Retrieve the explosives in Breakout Ep. 1.

380000029.Name: Flight Circuit
380000029.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Gallus' Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

An circuit which permits airborne objects to circle instinctively in the sky. It is called a flight circuit even though it has nothing to do with electricity. To be specific, it is a collection of information held together only by the instinct to fly circles in the sky. But where does it originate from?
Retrieve it in Breakout Ep. 2.

380000030.Name: Straight Horn
380000030.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Bone Crasher's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A big, mighty and beautiful horn on Bone Crasher's forehead. If there was some way to process it, it would make a powerful weapon. Sadly, this is beyond the abilities of present technology. Still, carrying the horn around doesn't seem to pose a problem.
Retrieve the horn in Breakout Ep. 3.

380000031.Name: Family Photo
380000031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Aaron's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A photo of Aaron, Catherine and another woman. Probably Aaron's wife. The woman's face is blurry. This photo is clear evidence of the love felt for this family. It makes you feel very sad.
Retrieve the photo in Breakout Ep. 4.

380000032.Name: Steel Gloves
380000032.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Dark Gauntillus' Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Dark Gauntillus used to wear these gloves. These glowing gloves are so heavy that just swinging them through the air would probably cause some serious damage. If you put on two of these gloves, you'd still have two to spare. Feel free to Dominance Rate them with your friends and family.
Retrieve the gloves in Front Line Ep. 1.

380000033.Name: Piece of Steel Armor
380000033.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Steeleron Tank's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of the steel Armor that protected the Steeleron Tank. It may be tiny, but it weighs a ton. Vessi are much stronger than humans. Even so, it is amazing they are able to wear such heavy Armor and even fight in it. If they fought without this Armor, they might be stronger still.
Retrieve the Armor in Front Line Ep. 2.

380000034.Name: Red Seal
380000034.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Hell Inforcer's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The head of Hell Inforcer's hammer. Unfamiliar characters are engraved on the top of the head, making it look a bit like a seal. Maybe it really is a seal? Who knows, perhaps the Vessi use them to seal contracts.
Retrieve the hammer in Front Line Ep. 3.

380000035.Name: Dandy Mustache Medal
380000035.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Toru's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

An insignia showing Toru's favorite dandy beard. Whether or not such an insignia has the desired effect is questionable. I cannot imagine anybody being pleased to be bestowed with an insignia like this one. It even feels like a beard, which makes it doubly unpleasant.
Retrieve the insignia in Front Line Ep. 4.

380000036.Name: Broken Blade
380000036.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Chaser's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment of the blade wielded by the Rapid Flame Chaser. The blade is so sharp that if you dropped a leaf onto it, it would be sliced in half like butter. The blade broke when somebody tried dropping a rock on it. It doesn't seem to be very durable.
Retrieve the blade in NED Company Ep. 1.

380000037.Name: Handmade Pendant
380000037.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Lisbee's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

An amulet that Lisbee made by hand. You can sense how much hard work went into crafting this pendant. The entire surface glitters and gleams, shimmering from a vast array of small embellishments. The pendant would fetch a good price from a valuables dealer, but for one thing: the design is really ugly.
Retrieve the amulet in NED Company Ep. 2.

380000038.Name: Poisonous Blade
380000038.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Venin's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Part of a scythe wielded by Venin, Vice Commander of the Firestream Shock Squad. It is extremely poisonous. In fact, you could say it was forged from poison. Take the utmost care when handling this blade if you don't want your own life brought to an abrupt end.
Retrieve the blade in NED Company Ep. 3.

380000039.Name: Hollow Bone
380000039.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Argus Gaour's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Birds' bones are Vacuum. It minimizes their weight and enables them to fly. This comes at the price of stability, however. Argus Gaour's bones are also Vacuum. Yet they seem to be more solid. 
Retrieve the bone in Wolf Cry Ep. 1.

380000040.Name: Blazing Hair
380000040.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Redmane's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The hair of Redmane, Vice Commander of the Rapid Flame. Straight, fiery red hair. It is probably just a feeling, but the hair is reminiscent of a robot with a lion emblazoned on it, marching forwards.
Retrieve the hair in Wolf Cry Ep. 2.

380000041.Name: Sack of Tears
380000041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Queen Gaour's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Queen Gaour's vocal sac. This vocal sac might be what enables her to screech so loudly. Wearing the sac around the neck could improve your singing. Or tiny devils might show up wanting to buy it.
Retrieve the sac in Wolf Cry Ep. 3.

380000042.Name: Official Note
380000042.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Sedurin's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

An unbelievably thick notebook. All the numbers and weird characters are enough to make your head spin. The writing degenerates progressively into a scrawl. It looks like the author was struggling to stay awake. The notebook smells of alcohol. What does its owner do all day, I wonder?
Retrieve the notebook in Wolf Cry Ep. 4.

380000043.Name: Wooden Crutch
380000043.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Steel Leg's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

These wooden crutches are badly worn and scratched. You can practically feel the sweat and tears of their owner. Whoever they once belonged to, it goes without saying that they tackled every challenge in their lives with gusto.
Retrieve the wooden crutches in Cold Rain Ep. 1.

380000044.Name: Suspicious Magazine
380000044.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Sora's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Narrow chin, piercing eyes. Stunning hair and broad shoulders. The cover of this Colorful magazine features two big, muscular men looking deep into each other's eyes. No one knows why they aren't wearing a shirt. Open the magazine and lose yourself in another world.
Retrieve the wooden crutches in Cold Rain Ep. 2.

380000045.Name: Giant Mainspring
380000045.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Grand Blaze Taifon's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The colossal clockwork was located on the back of Grand Blaze Taifon. No one knows how it works. The clockwork seems to utilise the technologies found in gravitation cannons or black hole clusters, but I could be wrong.
Retrieve the clockwork in Cold Rain Ep. 3.

380000046.Name: Red Scarf
380000046.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Steel Shinobi's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

This scarf is the embodiment of a hero. No doubt everyone, young or old, has imagined standing on the roof of a tall building on a blustery day, a red scarf around their neck fluttering in the wind.
Retrieve the scarf in Flame Breaker Ep. 1.

380000047.Name: Scream of Spirit
380000047.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Nether Collector's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The screams of the ghosts were condensed into a mass of energy in the shape of the Nether Collector. It gives off an unpleasant aura... almost as if you could be poisoned just by looking at it.
Retrieve the mass in Flame Breaker Ep. 3.

380000048.Name: Piece of Gleaming Blade
380000048.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Shadow Dancer's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment of the blade wielded by the Shadow Dancer. It is not known if the blade has always been red or if it was dyed red by the blood of its victims. It is very light and highly flexible. This blade could slice up anything.
Retrieve the blade in Flame Breaker Ep. 4.

380000049.Name: Machine Blueprint
380000049.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Road Buster's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

Blueprint for making mechanized weapon called Road Buster. It looks like a set of instructions for building little model robots. The logos of the SFL and NED Company at the top of the blueprint leave a sour taste in the mouth.
Retrieve the blueprint in Area 9 Ep. 1.

380000050.Name: Lighter
380000050.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Megiddon's Rage MK2's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A lighter. Gas escapes from the chamber at high pressure when you push the button. The flint generates a spark with friction which ignites the gas. That's it. It's a lighter. What else is there to say about it?
Retrieve the lighter in Area 9 Ep. 2.

380000051.Name: Robot Component
380000051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: MinWoo and His Sweetheart's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

High-tech machine parts. They make an ideal toy for children. Probably they are the core components of a machine. They should be handled with care.
Retrieve the parts in Area 9 Ep. 3.

380000052.Name: Hypersonic Generator
380000052.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Senia's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A machine that's ideally suited for torturing humans. At the touch of a button, this simple device can generate such noise that it permanently damages the human ear. The device can silence anyone.
Retrieve the Generator in Area 9 Ep. 4.

380000053.Name: Safe Barricade
380000053.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Sentry Commander's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A safety barrier used as the Sentry Commander's symbol. The item separates safe zones from danger zones. It looks like yellow and black were chosen for better visibility. But the Colors are also perfect as a warning. 
Retrieve the item in Control Base Ep. 1.

380000054.Name: Weight
380000054.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Grava Lithos Quaker's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

These weights maintain the equilibrium of the gigantic Grava Lithos Quaker. This humongous robot's weights are very heavy, of course. They inadvertently enabled analysts to deduce Grava Lithos Quaker's real weight.
Retrieve the weights in Control Base Ep. 2.

380000055.Name: Radio Antenna
380000055.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Amanda's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

The antenna from the walkie-talkie Amanda was using. Amanda is an excellent communicator. Maybe that's why she has a thing for communication devices? Or maybe she just collects them to pick up radio frequencies.
Retrieve the walkie-talkie in Control Base Ep. 3.

380000056.Name: Sieg Proto Blueprint
380000056.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Record: Bunker Bot's Akashic Key<font color='#9D927B'>

A blueprint of the Bunker Bot. Consulting enables an analysis of every aspect of Bunker Bot's inner workings. Its propulsion, for example. But the blueprint wasn't brought here to study Bunker Bot's finer details. No way.
Retrieve the blueprint in Control Base Ep. 4.

380000057.Name: Steel Chew Bone
380000057.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Blade Wolf's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A chew bone for dogs. It's made of iron from the innards of Blade Wolf. It was called Wolf. No doubt about it. Anyway, a dog would lose its teeth chewing on this bone. That's cruelty to animals and a no-no.
Retrieve the bone in Buster Core Ep. 1.

380000058.Name: Piece of Iron Shield
380000058.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Domineer's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of Domineer's iron shield. It is very smooth and inconceivably hard. This shield is almost black, unlike the other shields in the Dominio series. Why it was dyed black is unknown. Perhaps the intention was to make it look stronger.
Retrieve the shield in Buster Core Ep. 3.

380000059.Name: Deactivated Energy Cube
380000059.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Sarah' Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A deactivated energy Cube Sarah uses for energy research. It looks like she feeds her findings into this Cube to test the energy output and tendency. But be careful! Nobody knows what happens when the Cube is activated.
Retrieve the Cube in Buster Core Ep. 4.

380000060.Name: Fan Blade
380000060.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Air Reaper's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A fan propeller which was installed inside Air Reaper. Just how many fans were dismantled to build this propeller is difficult to imagine. Air Reaper seems a lot more brutal when you factor that in.
Retrieve the propeller in Cold Revenge Ep. 1.

380000061.Name: Broken Leg
380000061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Arachna Kill's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of one of Arachna Kill's legs. It is very sharp where it was hacked off, and might cut you if you touch it. The sharp edges of this leg are reminiscent of a crab.
Retrieve the leg in Cold Revenge Ep. 2.

380000062.Name: Piece of Bladetail
380000062.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Invertebrate Steel's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

Invertebrate Steel's tail, curled up like a scorpion tail. The bladetail is poised and deadly. A worm armed with a bladetail. How fitting! The area is pretty hazardous, no doubt about it.
Retrieve the bladetail in Cold Revenge Ep. 3.

380000063.Name: Faded Handkerchief
380000063.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Casen's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A woman's towel. It has seen so much use, its corners have frayed. Over time, the Colors have faded. The towel looks like it has never been washed. Best to hold it with just two fingers.
Retrieve the towel in Cold Revenge Ep. 4.

380000064.Name: Mini Vacuum Cleaner
380000064.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Dusty's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A machine that Dusty uses for cleaning. Dusty claims that this vacuum cleaner is ideal for tight corners, but not for large areas. It's incredible that even robots can sense when you are tearing off their arms.
Retrieve the vacuum cleaner in the Forgotten Armory Ep. 2.

380000065.Name: Link Box
380000065.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Robosteel Brothers' Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A link box installed in the Robosteel Brothers, Heavy Uriel and Flame Tamer. Probably, the Cube connects the two robots, enabling great combos even without a pilot. 
Retrieve the Cube in Forgotten Armory Ep. 3.

380000066.Name: Broken Claw
380000066.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Aggro Gishin's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A broken clothes peg belonging to Aggro Gishin. It is a tool used for fastening things. Strange, that such a tool was found on Aggro Gishin. Maybe its creator was in the process of hanging out the washing.
Retrieve the peg in Deep Core Ep. 1.

380000067.Name: Cable Bundle
380000067.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Betty's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A cable bundle that Betty has on her. She seems to be carrying all sorts of cables. Many of the cables have been with her so long they are broken or frayed in places. It's doubtful whether they would still work.
Retrieve the cable bundle in Deep Core Ep. 2.

380000068.Name: Steel High Heels
380000068.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Pincer's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

High heels made from iron. The heels are made from the material obtained from Steeleron to upgrade the Armor. You'll make holes in people's feet if you step on them in these. For sure. Stay away from people wearing these murderous contraptions.
Retrieve the high heels in Deep Core Ep. 3.

380000069.Name: Flowery Hairpin
380000069.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Pollenstorm's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A flowery hairpin Noah likes to wear. The shimmering blue-violet blossom is particularly inspiring. Her love of flowers and her combat style are an apparent contradiction. Quite surprising, really.
Retrieve the hairpin in Deep Core Ep. 4.

380000070.Name: Rusty Hammer
380000070.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Splatter Brain's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

This hammer is covered in rust. It has seen a lot of use. The odds are extremely high that its head will fly off the first time you swing it, ending any DIY adventures in disaster. Like being hit by a Splatter Brain, literally.
Retrieve the hammer in Acheron Ep. 1.

380000071.Name: Triangular Blade
380000071.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Genozidion X's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A triangular blade found on Genozidion X. Every edge is as sharp as a razor. To aVacuum injury, only touch the flat sides and never hold the blade while running. It would be most unfortunate if you tripped and fell with that in your hand.
Retrieve the blade in Acheron Ep. 2.

380000072.Name: Dusty Trowel
380000072.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Castle Fiend's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

Trowels are normally used for digging things up. This one is for planting shrubbery. But it really depends on the user.
Retrieve the trowel in Acheron Ep. 3.

380000073.Name: Circular Shoe Charm
380000073.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Infinirings' Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A round ornament affixed to Enoch's shoes. Looks like a wheel in the heel. They look a little like roller shoes.  
Retrieve the ornament in Acheron Ep. 4.

380000074.Name: Sub Memory Chip
380000074.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Nomaam's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

An extra memory chip that Nomaam always has on her but prefers not to use. She may dislike using it because it's a memory chip, or maybe because it's a spare.
Retrieve the chip in the Ark Ship Ep. 1.

380000075.Name: Machine Gun Casing
380000075.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Ian's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

Shells used in Ian's machine gun. Ian says the shells are like a medal he won in combat. I don't get it... I suppose an item can serve many different purposes, depending on the owner.
Retrieve the shells in the Ark Ship Ep. 2.

380000076.Name: Blueprint of Sieg Series
380000076.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Battery Bot's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

The blueprint for the Bunker series. It outlines the development and the construction process of the Bunker series, right from the initial model Bunker Bot model. The blueprint ought to have been more helpful in fighting the Bunker series.
Retrieve the blueprint in the Ark Ship Ep. 3.

380000077.Name: Old Covered Comic Book
380000077.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Martin's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

An old and worn comic book. It brings back memories of Martin proudly telling the tale of how his book became a bestseller. Let's crack it open and see if it lives up to the legend.
Retrieve the book in the Ark Ship Ep. 4.

380000078.Name: High Voltage Cable
380000078.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Training Dummy's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A high-voltage line developed by the SFL. It can conduct electricity to the destination without any loss in power. Its efficiency makes it popular with ordinary people too. Plus, it makes changing light bulbs at home easier.
Available in Steel Graves.

380000079.Name: Soul Pipe
380000079.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Suction Tubes' Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

An energy pipe hanging from Grand Blaze Taifon's suction tubes. A product the NED Company developed to store Soul Energy, which would otherwise rapidly dissipate, as energy.
Available in Steel Graves.

380000080.Name: Old Radio
380000080.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Bucker TV's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

A dated radio was purchased from Bucker TV. It can't be tuned, nor can the volume be adjusted. It's also sticky and smells strange. It looks like the trader tricked you.
Available in the BP shop.

380000081.Name: Wet Whistle
380000081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Nael's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

Nael always wore this whistle around his neck. It is a shiny silver and seems robust. It looks like a first-rate whistle. And it's soaked in saliva. Nobody will want to touch it in that state. And yet there's bound to be someone who wants it.
Available in the BP shop.

380000082.Name: Old Broken Wrench
380000082.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Tommy's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

This wrench was probably silver, once upon a time, but now it is covered in rust. It's so badly damaged that it is now useless. ‘Tommy' is engraved into the handle.
Available from quests.

380000083.Name: Joke Book: 150 Hilarious Jokes
380000083.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Akashic Key: Sunny's Akashic Record<font color='#9D927B'>

An old book with a collection of witticisms. Humour changes through the ages. These days you'd be hard pressed to get a reaction with these anecdotes. The book is marred by the occasional stain. I bet somebody spat or cried all over it. Do you think someone laughed till they cried? Reading THAT book?
Available from quests.

511264351.Description:

511404351.Description:

511554351.Name: Assigned Wisdom
511554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Head Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. The ancient SoulWorker's legacy is the future. A strong power slumbers within each piece.

My legacy to you is my wisdom and my knowledge. I have perfected both in combat. I hope you will use your wisdom to build a better life for yourselves.
- Early generation SoulWorker -

511604302.Name: Desire Decider
511604302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Head Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. This Armor embodies the craving for alertness. You can confidently trust this Armor to make your decisions because it serves only one purpose: to keep your synapses firing at maximum speed. But you should be prepared to give up everything else.

Armor made of yawing Desire Energy. Can you even still call it Armor?
Put it on and leave your human existence behind.

- Tenebris -

What I leave to you all are knowledge and gracefulness I found on the battlefield. I hope for you all to create a better world.
-SoulWorker of the past-

519604302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Head Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This SoulWorker-specific piece of armory has been created with the desire to [never stop thinking]. Because this piece of armory solely exists in relations to its wearer's brain, it should be safe to leave it to make the biggest decision while costing everything else.

This is more of a piece of Desire than a piece of armory. Putting on this piece of armory is like saying you've given up living out life as a human, it seems like.

Almost like siblings.

Worn on the body.

530655501.Name: Primacy Pilgrim Body Gear Standard
530655501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. During battle against the god of war RaphaKumba, a substance was harvested and used to craft this Body Gear. RaphaKumba broods and smoulders within, his wrath seeping into the wearer if their Soul Energy isn't strong enough.

What's this, another hazardous material? Oha! The radiation from this thing is too powerful for mere mortals and ordinary Supernaturals! Be careful with it, you hear me?
- Trisha -

530655502.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

530685501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Body Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

I will find you and come to you even if my name, soul and my heart gets abandoned.
-Someone for that one person-

530725501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

Although it seems like an ethereal wisp of dying embers, it somehow seems as if it will erupt into a roaring fire. It has been created from the powerful Desire Energy of Rapid Flame Vessi, its powers too much to fully control.

Strong power and unfaltering strong minds!
-Rapid Flame-

This is a SoulWorker-specific Weapon.
Although it seems like an ethereal wisp of dying embers, it somehow seems as if it will erupt into a roaring fire. It has been created from Flemma's powerful Desire Energy, emitting quite destructive Energy.

Yes, come at me all at once instead of taking turns; it's more fun that way.
-Flemma-

530733351.Description:

530735502.Name: Supportive Primacy Pilgrim Body Extend
530735502.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a SoulWorker-specific Defense Gear. It was crafted from materials obtained after the battle of RaphaKumba. RaphaKumba's obsession, madness, and spirit of trust are buried, so those with weak Soul Energy are eroded by the energy and go crazy when equipped. It has a dark red color because it is made of materials with high Soul Energy. The stability of performance is poor because the energy output is increased using unstable

530735601.Name: Supportive Disorder's Fanatic Body I
530735601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a SoulWorker-specific Defense Gear. It was crafted from the fragments of Yorhaka's madness that is forced into the form of a Body Gear. The spirit and greed of Yorhaka try to creep into the spirit of the user that wears them and destroy their soul. Whoever resists it receives a portion of its power.

Using this power is great, but be on your guard. If it breaks your resolve, nothing of your soul will remain.
- Tenebris -

530744351.Name: Struggle Body Gear
530744351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a SoulWorker-specific Defense Gear. As the gear bestowed upon a noble warrior who fights to protect precious ones on the edge of the battlefield, it contains an unbreakable will to slay any obstacles at all costs.
Can equip on the chest.

531164351.Name: Machine Gear Body Gear
531164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. Scientists added a little something here and there during manufacture – but astoundingly, everything fits together. This Armor lets you achieve great things.

531264351.Name: Evolving Shell
531264351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. The bones of a wild beast served as the template for this Armor. The mere look of it is off-putting to opponents.

531404351.Name: Spirit Body Gear
531404351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. This Armor plays with the emotions of its bearer. Thus it develops an almost unspeakable power. It constantly radiates a soft blue energy.

531554351.Name: Assigned Force
531554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. The ancient SoulWorker's legacy is the future. A strong power slumbers within each piece.

What I shall leave you with is power and might! Use this power to protect those things that mean something to you!
- Early generation SoulWorker -

531604351.Name: Desire Defender
531604351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. This Armor embodies the will to survive. You can confidently trust this Armor with your life because it serves only one purpose: to keep you alive. But you should be prepared to give up everything else.

Armor made of yawing Desire Energy. Can you even still call it Armor?
Put it on and leave your human existence behind.

- Tenebris -

Equipping this means that you give up on being a human anymore.

-Tenebris-

539554351.Name: Assigned Force
539554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This SoulWorker-specific piece of armory is one handed down by SoulWorkers from the past; it is both an inheritance and the future. Every single of of these parts possess a great power within. 

What I can leave to you, fellow comrades, are power and strength! Use as much of my strength as you need to protect what you must protect!
-SoulWorker of the past-

539604351.Name: Desire Defender
539604351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Body Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This SoulWorker-specific piece of armory has been created with the desire to [survive]. Because this piece of armory solely exists in relations to its wearer's will to exist, it should be safe to leave it to make the biggest decision while costing everything else.

This is more of a piece of Desire than a piece of armory. Putting on this piece of armory is like saying you've given up living out life as a human, it seems like.

Now what was his name... Asura something or other! Right?
- Janice -

I am a human and will die here. But humanity isn't beaten yet!
- ??? -

540554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

You're the exploiter here. I don't let anyone interrupt me.
- ??? -

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Valuable data gleaned from their experience informed this gear's design. Arms researchers at the Steel Graves claim this equipment to be the greatest from the Grave Guardian series. Worn on the legs.

Ha! I could make an item of this class myself too! 
That is... if I had the blueprint!
- Janice -

540554452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Right from the start, the creatures of darkness feel hate as well as love for the creatures of light. 
Almost like siblings.
- ??? -

Don't forget. Wearing god's halo means god stands with you.
- Eo -

540554653.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

<font color='#FFBA85'>This item can be upgraded without fear of destruction to +6.<font color='#9D927B'>
A special Armor piece for SoulWorker novices, with kind regards from the SFL. It can be upgraded to +6 without any preventative measures and without any fear of destruction. It also demands a lower cost than usual.

540555351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hmm... when I look at it like that, it doesn't seem like it was made for people.
- Janice -

540604461.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a piece of the monster. Its power is dangerous, but it would be helpful to use it for your own purposes.
- Tenebris -

540604462.Name: Supportive Tendon of Void +6 [60 Days]
540604462.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Defense kit for SoulWorker. Made with debris from Yorhaka. This still has strong power even though the original power which seems like it could destroy everything. This is just simply processed materials around body. Can be worn on head.

Pieces from the monster. It was threatening power but could be useful if you make it yours.
-Tenebris-

Using this power is great, but be on your guard. If it breaks your resolve, nothing of your soul will remain.
- Tenebris -

<font color='#FFBA85'>[profile picture]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a photo that can be posted on the profile of the Star Forest League, and is attracting great interest from many people with special abilities. A popular item that allows talented players in the Star Forest League to express their own tastes and individuality in the bleak profiles they check every day.
<font color='#3162F5'>Can be used for 1 day<font color='#9D927B'>.

540655501.Name: Primacy Exodus Leg Gears Standard
540655501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. During battle against the god of war RaphaKumba, a substance was harvested and used to craft these Leg Gears. RaphaKumba broods and smoulders within, his wrath seeping into the wearer if their Soul Energy isn't strong enough.

What's this, another hazardous material? Oha! The radiation from this thing is too powerful for mere mortals and ordinary Supernaturals! Be careful with it, you hear me?
- Trisha

540655502.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

540685501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Defense Armor of SoulWorker. Made with materials that can process amorphous energy which have been accumulated during battle with Junk Queen. It is Leg Gears which resembles the footsteps of the past, which have been faded now.

Therefore, I will follow forever… forever.
-Someone for that one person-

Therefore, I will follow forever… forever.
-Someone for that one person-

540725501.Name: Pale Ashes Bellicose Leg Standard
540725501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

Although it seems like an ethereal wisp of dying embers, it somehow seems as if it will erupt into a roaring fire. It has been created from the powerful Desire Energy of Rapid Flame Vessi, its powers too much to fully control.

A plan? Plans are for the weak! Wouldn't everything be solved if it was all destroyed anyway? It's not like you'll all be fighting over who did better, so what's the point?
-Rapid

540735502.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Leg Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a SoulWorker-specific Defense Gear. It was crafted from materials obtained after the battle of RaphaKumba. RaphaKumba's obsession, madness, and spirit of trust are buried, so those with weak Soul Energy are eroded by the energy and go crazy when equipped. It has a dark red color because it is made of materials with high Soul Energy. The stability of performance is poor because the energy output is increased using unstable

540735601.Name: Supportive Disorder's Fanatic Leg I
540735601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear: Leg Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a SoulWorker-specific Defense Gear. It was crafted from the fragments of Yorhaka's madness that is forced into the form of a Leg Gear. The spirit and greed of Yorhaka try to creep into the spirit of the user that wears them and destroy their soul. Whoever resists it receives a portion of its power.

Using this power is great, but be on your guard. If it breaks your resolve, nothing of your soul will remain.
- Tenebris -

540744351.Name: [EV] Erwin’s birthday commemorative title package
540744351.Description:

- Acquired title -
[Title: Prefix] All-out fire! x 1

541164351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. Scientists added a little something here and there during manufacture – but astoundingly, everything fits together. This Armor lets you achieve great things.

541264351.Name: Rapid Foot
541264351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

541404351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. This Armor plays with the emotions of its bearer. Thus it develops an almost unspeakable power. It constantly radiates a soft blue energy.

541554351.Name: Assigned Road
541554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. The ancient SoulWorker's legacy is the future. A strong power slumbers within each piece.

My legacy to you is the path and the future of the SoulWorkers. Please don't stray from the right path and walk towards the right future.
- Early generation SoulWorker -

541604351.Name: Desire Seeker
541604351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Equipment: Leg Gears]<font color='#9D927B'>

The gear of a SoulWorker. This Armor embodies the urge to move. You can confidently trust this Armor with your life because it was made to serve only one purpose: to keep you alive. But you should be prepared to give up everything else.

Armor made of yawing Desire Energy. Can you even still call it Armor?
Put it on and leave your human existence behind.

- Tenebris -

-Tenebris-

549554351.Name: Assigned Lord
549554351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Leg Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This SoulWorker-specific piece of armory is one handed down by SoulWorkers from the past; it is both an inheritance and the future. Every single of of these parts possess a great power within. 

What I leave to you all are knowledge and gracefulness I found on the battlefield. I hope for you all to create a better world.
-SoulWorker of the past-

549604351.Name: Desire Seeker
549604351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Gear : Leg Gear]<font color='#9D927B'>

This SoulWorker-specific piece of armory has been created with the desire to [act]. Because this piece of armory solely exists in relations to its wearer's destination, it should be safe to leave it to make the biggest decision while costing everything else.

This is more of a piece of Desire than a piece of armory. Putting on this piece of armory is like saying you've given up living out life as a human, it seems like. 

-Tenebris-

600000001.Name: [Social Item] Mat [12M]
600000001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Social Item] Can be used in the city limits. You sit comfortably on the floor to rest. Recover 5 FP per minute. Duration: 12min<font color='#9D927B'>

People have always sat or laid down so they can rest. People often do this on the ground, which is normally dirty. It's not terribly nice, of course. That's why this mat was invented which you can sit on anywhere and thus rest with no issues. You can't lie down, though.

600000002.Name: [Social Item] Radio
600000002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Social Item] Can be used in the city limits. Makes you dance with joy. Regenerates 1 FP per minute. Duration: 120min<font color='#9D927B'>

The music possesses infinite energy. It heals hearts and makes people dance with joy. Even though it isn't live, the sounds from the radio count as music too. The most important part remains unchanged. Music should play for you who are weary from battle, because I want to tell you: fighting is not worth the effort! Soak up my music

600000003.Name: [Social Item] Mat [6M]
600000003.Description:

The most important part remains unchanged. Music should play for you who are weary from battle, because I want to tell you: fighting is not worth the effort! Soak up my music instead!

600000006.Description:

Take break while sit around together and enjoy Christmas.

600000007.Name: [Social Item] Ocean Mat [12M]
600000007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Social Item] Can be used within the city limits. You sit comfortably on the floor to rest. Recover 5 FP per minute. Duration: 12min<font color='#9D927B'>

A summer item for people who also like to sunbathe where you won't find a trace of a beach. Anyone who lies on it feels like they can hear the crashing of the waves and feel the warmth of the sun.

[Crafting Materials]

710100101.Name: Metal Stone
710100101.Description:
An ore commonly collectible in South Cloudream, it's a stone containing highly concentrated iron. Solely the iron is extracted and used as crafting materials for weaponry. You can obtain these through fighting in [Rocco Town] or [Candus City]. 

[Crafting Material]

710100102.Name: Meteor Piece
710100102.Description:
This meteor fragment has come flying in having naturally acclimatized leading it to be easily handled. It sounds like a difficult item to obtain because of its name but it is easier to find than one would think. You can obtain these through fighting in [Candus City] or [Grace City]. 

[Crafting Material]

710100103.Name: Geo Stream
710100103.Description:
An ore said to be the branch of the earth, it gives off a natural green glow. Due to it being a natural nutrient, it pairs very well with Soul Energy. You can obtain these through fighting in [Grace City] or [Ruin Fortress]. 

[Crafting Material]

710100104.Name: Star Platinum
710100104.Description:
A stone known to crumble as the stars do, it's said to contain the story of a star. The strength and flexibility all make up for the compatibility with Soul Energy. It is a glowing white. You can obtain these through fighting in [Ruin Fortress]. 

[Crafting Material]

710100105.Name: Tritanium
710100105.Description:
This ore can be fused with Soul Energy. It is not an overstatement to say this ore was created to interact with Soul Energy. Nothing in existence can beat the compatibility of Tritanium and Soul Energy.  

[Crafting Material]

710100106.Name: Full Tritanium
710100106.Description:
Not being fused with anything else, it is 100% pure Tritanium. Because it is so rare, it is known to be something of a legendary ore in some places. 

[Crafting Material]

710100201.Name: Melting Matter: Purification
710100201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

You need this item to purify the debris you received in the Great Vacuum. This item purifies materials that have been polluted by the various energies of the Great Vacuum. You'll only get thoroughly purified material when you use an awful lot of debris.
I don't know why he's carrying them either, but you can get these items from Zyte.

710100301.Name: The Primal's Crystal Fragment
710100301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Cube of crystals that hung on Primal's head. They got damaged so they've lost some of their sparkle and power.
Maybe it's better that way. Who knows what happens when people come into contact with such power?

710100302.Name: Black Chunk Tentacles
710100302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A clump of tentacles that came from Primal's arms. They may have been sliced off some time ago but they're still wriggling. Revolting! You'd better not touch them.

710100303.Name: Burned Steel
710100303.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

The steel that made up Primal's body. The incredible heat of Primal's collapse turned the steel black. You can almost still feel the heat.

710100304.Name: Purified Violet Crystal
710100304.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

This crystal was formed when Primal's crystal fragments were purified. Since the crystal was purified of the polluting energy of the Alternate Vacuum, it shines clear and bright.

710100305.Name: Purified Organic Fiber
710100305.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

This organic material was formed when Primal's tentacles were purified. It still seems to be moving.

710100306.Name: Purified Carbon Fiber
710100306.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

This carbon was formed when Primal's steel was purified. The fusion of steel and energy from the Alternate Vacuum formed a material that's even harder than steel.

710101001.Name: Tarnished Weapon Core
710101001.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. As much as Soul Weapon usability depends on the Soul Weapon core, it is not an overstatement to call this the most important part of a Soul Weapon. This Weapon Core is so worn out it cannot carry out its role properly. You can obtain these through fighting in [Rocco Town] or [Candus City]. 

[Crafting Material: Soul Weapon]

710101002.Name: Low Class Weapon Core
710101002.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. This Weapon Core is so worn out it cannot carry out its role properly. You can obtain these through fighting in [Candus City] or [Grace City].

710101003.Name: Mid Class Weapon Core
710101003.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. As much as Soul Weapon usability depends on the Soul Weapon core, it is not an overstatement to call this the most important part of a Soul Weapon. This Weapon Core is so worn out it cannot carry out its role properly. This is a middle-class Weapon Core and has not yet been able to go to its full lengths. You can obtain these through fighting in [Grace City] or [Ruin Fortress]. 

[Crafting Material: Soul Weapon]

710101004.Name: Greater Weapon Core
710101004.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. As much as Soul Weapon usability depends on the Soul Weapon core, it is not an overstatement to call this the most important part of a Soul Weapon. This Weapon Core is so worn out it cannot carry out its role properly. Being a stable Weapon Core, it carries over all the SoulWorker's power and strength into the Soul Weapon. You can obtain these through fighting in [Ruin Fortress]. 

[Crafting Material: Soul Weapon]

710101005.Name: Ultimate Weapon Core
710101005.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. As much as Soul Weapon usability depends on the Soul Weapon core, it is not an overstatement to call this the most important part of a Soul Weapon. This Weapon Core is only granted to special SoulWorkers and its abilities are world-class.  
[Crafting Material: Soul Weapon]

710101006.Name: Vacuum Weapon Core
710101006.Description:
The core of Soul Weapons, it protects and spreads Soul Energy. As much as Soul Weapon usability depends on the Soul Weapon core, it is not an overstatement to call this the most important part of a Soul Weapon. This Weapon Core contains Vacuum Energy and shows phenomenal strength.  

[Crafting Material: Soul Weapon]

710102001.Name: Tarnished Gear Core
710102001.Description:
Central power department of gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. This weapon core cannot perform properly because the condition is heavily damaged. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Candus City], [Rocco Town].

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

710102002.Name: Low Class Gear Core
710102002.Description:
Central power department of gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. This weapon core has the lowest quality among weapon cores, you cannot expect a lot in terms of performance. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Candus City], [Grace City]. 

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

710102003.Name: Mid Class Gear Core
710102003.Description:
Central power department of gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. This gear core has medium level performance, so it cannot perfom properly. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Ruin Fortress], [Grace City].

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

710102004.Name: Greater Gear Core
710102004.Description:
Central power department of Gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. This is a gear core with complete stability, and project the power of SoulWorker into Soul weapon. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Ruin Fortress], [Grace City].

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

710102005.Name: Ultimate Gear Core
710102005.Description:
Central power department of Gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. It is special gear core only supplied to special SoulWorkers, and the performance is one of the best. 

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

710102006.Name: Vacuum Gear Core
710102006.Description:
Central power department of Gear. It has a role of correcting and amplifying Soul energy. The most important parts, since it makes a difference for basic performance of gear, depend on which gear core is used. It is a gear core containing lots of Vacuum Energy, can outperform much better than Ultimate Gear Core. 

[Crafting Materials: Gear]
