710200001.Name: Sticky Slime
710200001.Description:
Very sticky slime. Touched it once, and it really sticks on my hand. And it smells terrible too. What is this? Can be obtained in [Control Zone 43].

[Crafting Materials]

710200002.Name: Broken Component
710200002.Description:
Seriously broken component. Tried various ways to fix for usage but it didn't work. Melt it, or sell it at antique shop. Can be obtained at [R Square].

[Crafting Materials]

710200003.Name: Frayed Wire
710200003.Description:
Wire that cannot function with sheath reaped off. It doesn't seem dangerous plugging it with bare hands. Can be obtained at [Tower of Grid].

[Crafting Materials]

710200004.Name: Mysterious Badge
710200004.Description:
Very suspicious Badge. It has an appearance of Edgar, but don't know where it can be used. Chewed it but it's not food. Anyway, it can be obtained at [Best Showtime]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200005.Name: Withered Grass
710200005.Description:
Dried out grass. It was a desperate piece of grass grown among Soul Junks, but it died out because it got all the nutrients stolen. Sadly, not sure where it can be used. Can be obtained at [Concrete Jungle].

[Crafting Materials].

710200006.Name: Mysterious Fluid
710200006.Description:
This is not poison, nor oil. It is mysterious fluid. Seems harmless for the body, but don't drink it. Don't pour it to plants. Can be obtained at [Junk Pool].

[Crafting Materials]

710200007.Name: Dry Molt
710200007.Description:
Very dry molt with no moisture. Seems like a living organism took off it's molt. If I hold it strongly, it seems likely to break. Can be obtained at [The Bigmouth]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200008.Name: Sloppy Cell
710200008.Description:
Sloppy cell looks like jellyfish. It is too big to be called a cell, but we decided to call it a cell since it look like one. It feels strange because it has weird movement, showing signs that it is still alive. Can be obtained at [N102 Shelter].

[Crafting Materials]

710200009.Name: Dry Feather
710200009.Description:
A feather with no gloss. It feels a lot heavier compare to bird feather. Is this really a feather? Can be obtained at [Break Out].

[Crafting Materials].

710200010.Name: Piece of Concrete
710200010.Description:
We can make concrete by solidifying the mixture of cement, sand, and water with an appropriate ratio. The appropriate mixing ratio determines the clear difference between amateur and master. This concrete piece seems like made by amateur. Can be obtained at [Front Line]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200011.Name: Piece of Paper
710200011.Description:
Looks like a A4 paper got torn. There are attached pictures, even letters and numbers. The [Rejected] written on paper makes me sad. Can be obtained at [NED Company].

[Crafting Materials]

710200012.Name: Fur
710200012.Description:
Chunk of Fur, cannot distinguish which animal's fur it is. It is very stiff, tangled complicated with each other. It sometimes have foreign substances on the surface, even reduce appetite. Can be obtained at [Wolf Cry].

[Crafting Materials]

710200013.Name: Faulty Wire
710200013.Description:
Wire with the sheath reaped off. We can reuse it if we twist the wires, but it might be better for mental health to buy a new one. Can be obtained at [Cold Rain]

[Crafting Materials]

710200014.Name: Piece of Cloth
710200014.Description:
Pieces of clothes torn apart. So worn out that we can't even use it for making clothes or even cleaning mop. Perhaps it is better to use it for firewood. Can be obtained at [Flame Breaker].

[Crafting Materials]

710200015.Name: Piece of Metal
710200015.Description:
Piece of metal cutted sharply on edge. Seems very sharp, so you can get cut easily. If you get cutted by trying to hold it with your fingers.. How scary… Can be obtained at [Area 9].

[Crafting Materials]

710200016.Name: Digital Chip
710200016.Description:
Digital Chip seems to be containing important information inside. But it only has dummy datas inside. Cannot delete, unable to format, almost useless. Can only be used for materials. Can be obtained at [Control Base].

[Crafting Materials]

710200017.Name: Energy
710200017.Description:
Chunk mixed with miscellaneous energies. Can be used as a pure energy, but it is literally mixed with miscellaneous energies, so cannot function properly. Can't even use it for charging batteries. But Merchants' Union seems like to buy it. Can be obtained at [Buster Core].

[Crafting Materials]

710200018.Name: Screw
710200018.Description:
A normal screw that is so normal, and so average. Very Normal. Can be easily found wherever you go. Can be obtained at [Cold Revenge].

[Crafting Materials]

710200019.Name: Wet Gunpowder
710200019.Description:
Wet Gunpowder with full of Moisture. A Gunpowder explodes when it is lit, but it is too wet to be lighted on fire. We can use it if we dry it, but it takes too much time and effort. Can be obtained at [Forgotton Armory]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200020.Name: Torn Wire
710200020.Description:
Wire with section worn out. Supporting power seems great, but too short. Can only be used for digging ears picking noses. Can be obtained at [Deep Core]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200021.Name: Floppy Disk
710200021.Description:
Long time ago, a storage used during ancient time. Storage is very small, close to Mega level, but have large volume. I'm wondering how they even used thing like this… If you recognize this... Can be obtained at [Acheron]. 

[Crafting Materials]

710200022.Name: Weathered Rock
710200022.Description:
A stone worn out through years hardship. Feels solemnity, when you think about the stone that went through strong wind and rain. But it is useless. Can be obtained at [Ark Ship].

[Crafting Materials]

710200023.Name: Old Coin
710200023.Description:
Currency used long before Vacuum era. It cannot be used now because the coin is made with various metals, but it is traded among collectors at a high price. Merchants' Unions are purchasing as well.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200024.Name: Old Piggy Bank
710200024.Description:
Piggy Bank with old coins. This old piggy bank has many old coins, with broken areas. It is traded at a high price among collectors since it is less likely to erode because it is stored in a barrel. Merchants' Unions are purchasing as well.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200025.Name: Old Safebox
710200025.Description:
An old safe box, used long before Vacuum era. A safe cannot be opened with other physical ways due to it's durably designed structure. Unable to know what's inside but Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price. What's inside?

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200026.Name: A Pivotal Device
710200026.Description:
A pivotal device made by Edgar. A device that was stuck at the heart of broken doll, and it shines with bright light. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200027.Name: High Purity Slime Sample
710200027.Description:
A container with Soul Junk Slime. It is moving slowly. It has high value for the few researchers who are researching Soul Junk. And it can only be harvested by the power of SoulWorker, and we can feel the movement as if it is alive. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200028.Name: Limited Poison Figure
710200028.Description:
Limited edition Rapid Flame's infamous Vessi, Poison figurines. Molded identically to the spitting image of Vessi and the underground world, gathering cult-like popularity. Creators of figurines unknown. Only few limited edition with different poses are traded at a extremely high price among collectors and fans. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

How can I bully you into liking me?
- Poison -

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200029.Name: Robot Blueprint
710200029.Description:
Robot blueprint created in Ruin Fortress. There are complicated diagrams drawn with the Robot Blueprint made by developers of NED Company. It is sold at a high price to technicians and engineers because it is a Robot Blueprint of NED Company that monopolize latest technology. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price. 

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200030.Name: Twisted Statue
710200030.Description:
Bizarre Twisted Statue.
A Statue brought from Alternate Vacuum,It is strangely twisted different from original appearance. Merchants' Union are purchasing at high price because it looks very similar with the picture of an artist.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200031.Name: Possessed Statue
710200031.Description:
Statue with strange light.
Statue brought from Alternate Vacuum, shines with bizarre blue light when you bring it to dark area. There is a rumor that those who saw the light stare hazily, as if they lost their soul. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200032.Name: Black Quartz
710200032.Description:
Quartz with dark light.
If you look inside of Quartz carefully, which have been alternated by Vacuum, you can see dark light swirling. A lot people wants to aVacuum it because it has similar appearance of Vacuum, but this strange characteristic has made collectors more enthusiastic. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200033.Name: Crimson Quartz
710200033.Description:
Quartz with crimson light.
If you look inside of Quartz carefully, which have been alternated by Vacuum, you can see crimson light swirling. A lot people wants to aVacuum it because it has similar appearance of Vacuum, but this strange characteristic has made collectors more enthusiastic. Merchants' Union are purchasing at a high price.

[For Sale] Obtain a large quantity of Zenny when selling an item.

710200034.Name: Xeno Stone
710200034.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

You receive this special stone as a reward for completing the SFL mission Dimension Trip: Battle of the Rift.
Can be used as a crafting material to obtain special SFL designs.

710200035.Name: Mysterious Fluid
710200035.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>(Sale) Selling this item can get you a large quantity of Zenny.<font color='#9D927B'>

It's not damaging to health. Neither oil or anything else. Literally a puzzling fluid. It seems to be harmless, but you'd better not drink it. Don't use it for watering plants either. available from any Soul Junk.

720100001.Name: Etherite Powder
720100001.Description:
Powder fell out from Etherite Stone. Since it fell out from stone, the power of Ether, which is mixed with impurities, is weak and underutilized. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Rocco Town]. 

[Upgrade Material]

720100002.Name: Etherite Fragment
720100002.Description:
Fragment fell out from Etherite Stone. The fragment itself already has sufficient power, but not as enough as the original power of Ether. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Candus City]. 

[Upgrade Material]

720100003.Name: Low-Grade Etherite
720100003.Description:
It is refined and crystallized with Etherite stone, which is mixed with impurities, but still have sufficient power by boosting power of Ether. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Grace City]. 

[Upgrade Material]

720100004.Name: Mid-Grade Etherite
720100004.Description:
It is refined and crystallized with Etherite stone, and raised purity during refining process. Impurity ratio decreased and the power of Ether got amplified. Can be obtained by disassembling, or by defeating powerful enemies in [Ruin Fortress]. 

[Upgrade Material]

720100005.Name: High-Grade Etherite
720100005.Description:
It is refined and crystallized with Etherite stone, and raised purity during refining process. There are very little impurity mixed.

[Upgrade Material]

720100006.Name: Ultimate Etherite
720100006.Description:
It is Ultimate Etherite contains little ratio of impurities refined by Dr.H, who have an authority about Etherite research. There is movement of light like electric circuit inside of crystal.

[Upgrade Material]

720101001.Name: Weapon Extension
720101001.Description:
Special extension used for Soul weapon Upgrade. A Soul weapon with output above a certain level, activate the firewall automatically, and this is kind of hacking device designed to break through firewall effectively. But the durability of machine itself is very weak, so it gets destroyed regardless of whether it is successful in Upgrade. 

[Upgrade Material: Soul Weapon]

720102001.Name: Gear Extension
720102001.Description:
Special extension used for Gear Upgrade. A Gear with output above certain level, activate the firewall automatically, and this is kind of hacking device designed to break through firewall effectively. But the durability of machine itself is very weak, so it gets destroyed regardless of whether it is successful in Upgrade. 

[Upgrade Material: Gear]

720102011.Name: Life Fibers
720102011.Description:
It seems like an average shiny fiber, but it is the combination of high technology Nano machines. It has capability of changing their own structure and arrangement according to the user's will. It is called Life Fibers, because it has the appearance of fiber, and a living organism. It is used for making equipment for Special SoulWorkers. It reminds me the Quote 'Life Fiber Synchronize!'. Can be obtained at SFL virtual battle program [Steel Graves].

[Crafting Materials]

720102012.Name: Fantastic Metal
720102012.Description:
This absurd substance has a mass in which the energy is compressed to the limit, just like a metal. It can be used for producing various products since it has same usage. It requires excellent skill to use it, but the products created by using Fantastic Metal which deserves to be called the finest. It is used to create custom equipment for Special SoulWorkers. Can be obtained at SFL virtual battle program [Steel Graves].

[Crafting Materials]

720102013.Name: Vacuum Energy
720102013.Description:
Agglomerated Light made of original energy from Vacuum. Since it is radiating with very strong negative wave, it affects your body with harmful effect immediately. It has infinite amount of potential energy because it has exactly same trait of Vacuum. Can be obtained at Alternate Vacuum.

[Crafting Materials]

720102014.Name: Irregular Stone
720102014.Description:
A stone can only be found inside of Twisted Dimension. The appearance is not much different from average stone, but it made many scientists in despair with [Unknown] displayed on component analysis result screen. They even said that [This is not material of this world]. It has very high compatibility with Vacuum energy. Can be obtained at Alternate Vacuum.

[Crafting Materials]

720102015.Name: Light of Merged Dimension
720102015.Description:
[Artifact] fused with an Irregular Stone and Vacuum Energy. Energy Type Unknown. Inconclusive Solidity Status. Few call this microminiature Vacuum, or even called chunk of calamity which should not be existing on this planet. It can cause huge damage, needs caution when dealing with it.

[Crafting Materials]

720102016.Name: Code GK
720102016.Description:
Compilation of encrypted battle data created at Steel Graves. It seems like a simple hieroglyph, but it is core of [Grave Keeper] series production which is essence of Steel Grave. Cannot be used alone, it is used for the purpose for information input for Weapon Core, or Gear Core. 

[Crafting Materials]

720102017.Name: Weapon Core GK
720102017.Description:
Core is overwritten with the information contained in [Code GK] into existing Weapon Core. Appearance is very similar, but the contents are completely different because the information is overwritten with information of GK. It is used for material of [Grave Keeper] Soul Weapon series.

[Crafting Materials: Soul Weapon]

720102018.Name: Gear Core GK
720102018.Description:
Core is overwritten with the information contained in [Code GK] into existing Gear Core. Appearance is very similar, but the contents are completely different because the information is overwritten with information of GK. It is used for material of [Grave Keeper] Gear series.

[Crafting Materials: Gear]

720102019.Name: Weapon Core GK MK.Ⅱ
720102019.Description:
Core is overwritten with the information contained in [Code GK] into existing Weapon Core. Appearance is very similar, but the contents are completely different because the information is overwritten with information of GK. It is used for material of [Grave Keeper MK.II] Soul Weapon series. 

[Crafting Materials: Soul Weapon]

720102020.Name: Gear Core GK MK.Ⅱ
720102020.Description:
Core is overwritten with the information contained in [Code GK] into existing Gear Core. Appearance is very similar, but the contents are completely different because the information is overwritten with information of GK. It is used for material of [Grave Keeper MK.II] Gear series.

720102021.Name: Weapon Core GK MK.Ⅲ
720102021.Description:

720102023.Name: Erosion Stone
720102023.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Tritanium that has been transformed by the Energy of the Alternate Vacuum. Superficially, it resembles standard tritanium, but it absorbs the Energy of the Alternate Vacuum and becomes much harder than normal ore. You can use it to craft much stronger equipment. As the research phase is still not complete, it cannot be used or processed directly.

720102024.Name: Alternate Vacuum Weapon Core
720102024.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Crafting Material: SoulWeapon<font color='#9D927B'>

The main drive of the SoulWeapons. This corrects and amplifies the Soul Energy. The basic functions of a SoulWeapon depend on which Weapon Core is used. This makes it the most important component of the weapon.
A weapon core that carries the Energy of the Alternate Vacuum inside it. Its performance exceeds that of the best of the competition.

720102025.Name: Alternate Vacuum Gear Core
720102025.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Crafting Material: Equipment<font color='#9D927B'>

The main drive of equipment items. This corrects and amplifies the Soul Energy. The basic functions of a piece of equipment depend on which Armor Core is used. This makes it the most important component of a piece of equipment.
An Armor core that carries the Energy of the Alternate Vacuum inside it. Its performance exceeds that of the best of the competition.

720102026.Name: Violet Primitive Spirit
720102026.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special material that can only be collected and processed by SoulWorkers. Also known as Material of the Great Vacuum. Necessary for crafting special SoulWeapons or gear. Depending on the influence of the Great Vacuum, the properties of the material can vary. Therefore there are various types that are specific to zones. You receive it when you defeat Primal.

720102027.Name: Black Primitive Spirit
720102027.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special material that can only be collected and processed by SoulWorkers. Also known as Material of the Great Vacuum. Necessary for crafting special SoulWeapons or gear. Depending on the influence of the Great Vacuum, the properties of the material can vary. Therefore there are various types that are specific to zones. You receive it when you defeat Primal.

720102028.Name: Hollow Leavings
720102028.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Residuum that was created when the Void broke. It's no material item, but you can sense its presence.

720102029.Name: The Hollow Fragment
720102029.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small fragment that reminds you of the form of the Void. Even though you are holding it securely in your hands, you can't feel it.

720102030.Name: [Detective Acad. Woman] Sandals
720102030.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Fashion]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sandals that is worn by Detective Academy woman. Can help us solve mystery cases easily.

720102031.Name: Scars of Sorcery
720102031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Material<font color='#9D927B'>

A result of the collision between Soul Energy and RaphaKumba's madness. It flickers menacingly in five different Colors, conducting huge amounts of Soul Energy and increasing durability depending on success. The more Soul Energy it absorbs, the greater the chances of success. In that case it glows a fiery red.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Can be obtained by dismantling Primacy gear. Otherwise very difficult to find.</font>

720102032.Name: [EV] Ice
720102032.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Event Item<font color='#9D927B'>

Ice cream from the Grutons' grand treasure. As with everything they squirrel away, this ice cream has summery value. You can almost certainly swap it for something nice.

720102033.Name: Dark shaped Fabric
720102033.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A material with no obvious use. The Color of it is so dark that if you look at it for a while it starts absorbing everything bright.

<font color='#FF0000'>As well as the reward you'll get from Yorhaka's quest, Viilor's Battle, you'll also make a Desire Energy fashion item.<font color='#9D927B'>

720102034.Name: Orb of Greed
720102034.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Desire Energy orb flickers to itself with sombre greediness.

<font color='#FF0000'>Use the Sinister Swirlsilk at Yorhaka's to make a Desire Energy fashion item.<font color='#9D927B'>

720102037.Name: Twilight Resource
720102037.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Materials]<font color='#9D927B'>

Material re-produced with collected amorphous energy which have been accumulated during battle with Junk Queen. Human, Soul Junk, and Vessi. This has high usability to use the energy stored in 3 living organism that uses different energy. This usually has blue light but it changes the color of light depends on the injected energy.

720102038.Name: District Brooch Transducer
720102038.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Exchange Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can exchange to Brooch Transmitter from Eo.

720102039.Name: Molten Shard of Desire
720102039.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Materials]<font color='#9D927B'>

Ever since Lunar Nox emerged, an energy cluster appears in few areas of West Cloudream. It is small, and the quality of desire energy which is the base material is not so good. Still, it is an energy that needs to be cautious when dealing with it.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Used for equipment craft.</font>

720102040.Name: Fused Desire Crystal
720102040.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Crystal formed by fusing molten Desire Energy shards. It greatly helps expressing strong desires since it is created from Desire Energy.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Used for crafting equipment.</font>

720102041.Name: Burning Embers
720102041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Crystal formed from desires to viciously burn once more. It is formed of Energy that doesn't seem easy to handle.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Used for crafting equipment.</font>

720102042.Name: Pale Embers
720102042.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Crystal formed from Desire Energy burning to Pale Ashes. It can be easily destroyed, but they say that the strong desires it holds pass on to equipment when it is processed.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Used for crafting equipment.</font>

720102043.Name: Pale Fragment
720102043.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small fragment found after the battle against Flemma.
It's hot enough to cause a burn, but it appears white instead of a flaming red.

720102044.Name: Hardening Catalyst
720102044.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hardening catalyst specially cared by Vessi.
Applying it to any material full of Desire Energy helps it attach to other materials that have similar properties.

720102045.Name: League Raid Coin
720102045.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[League Raid Merchandise]<font color='#9D927B'>

720102046.Name: Refined Stone Upgrade Material

720102047.Name: Violet Glazed Vacuunium
720102047.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Having been born from the affects of the Alternate Vacuum, no research on its substances; countless possibilities lie ahead.

720102060.Name: Fragment of Distorted Justice
720102060.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An Ore has been found in District 8 after the fierce battle against Tenebris. It must handle very carefully as anyone can be obsessed with power just by touching it.

720102061.Name: Essence of Distorted Justice
720102061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Material has been found in District 8 after the fierce battle against Tenebris. It has a unique structure that is different from other materials. It can be deformed in any form during crafting.

720102062.Name: Shard of Corrupted Justice
720102062.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An Ore has transformed under the influence of distorted tenacity to the justice of Tenebris. It has lost all of its light as an ore. However, the power remains in it, waiting for a new owner.

Special Currency issued from SFL, paid to Soulworkers who completed special mission. You can purchase various convenient products offered by SFL. Can be obtained after clearing special mission.

800001001.Name: Anti-Destruction Device
800001001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special device prevents the equipment from destruction when reinforcing equipment above certain point. Prevent self-destruct of equipment by bringing it to yourself when the output of equipment gets bigger abnormally. When used for Anti-Destruction, it consumes 1 for each time regardless of whether the item is destroyed.

800001002.Name: Succession Device
800001002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Succession Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Device is used to inherit the stats of upgraded / refined equipment to other equipment.
It synchronizes the stat value gap between existing and new equipment when transferring stats.

However, some of the equipment's stats may be damaged during the Succession process.

800001003.Name: Upgrade-Protection Memory
800001003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Succession Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Memory Chip can alleviate decreasing upgrade stat value during the Succession process.
It overclocks the Succession Device to boost the performance.

800001004.Name: [EV] [Sealed] Nabi's Another School Slippers
800001004.Description: This Package contains [EV] Nabi's Another School Slippers.

800001501.Name: Anti-Limiter +10
800001501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special Energy that force to raise the maximum output of equipment. The current number of Upgrade attempts is reduced by 10. The maximum output of Equipments with Anti-Limiter will increase, allows to reinforce output more steadily.

800002001.Name: Magic Hammer
800002001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Original term is Anti-Soul Particle Accelerator. It was created for the purpose of smash Anti-Soul(in main body) against the materials by spinning the forward pendulum at a high speed. Object covered up with Anti-Soul will return back to the original substance due to disappearance of Soul Energy which connect each particles.

800002002.Name: Socket Implement Device
800002002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Socket Additional Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A machine that mounts an expansion slot so that [combat auxiliary device: familiar] can be attached to the soul weapon. The law of total soul quantity, which states that [more than a certain amount of souls cannot be fixed at one coordinate], is maintained within a narrow line.

800003001.Name: Trisha's Refinement Support PKG
800003001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[PKG]<font color='#9D927B'>

Refinement Support Package by Trisha for SoulWorkers.

-Included Items
Corrupted Records' Appendix x 20
Energy Converter x 10
10000 BP Box x 3
Ether 50000 Box x 2

800004001.Name: Nano Kit
800004001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Box containing large quantity of Copy Nano Machine inside. Copy Nano Machine perform exceptionally for various equipment repair, because it has characteristic of sticking by copying ingredients of material near by. Big advantage is its mobility.

800004002.Name: Unified TERA Brooch Cube
800004002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item Cube]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tera brooch is inside. Pin it on and feel the power!

800006001.Name: Private Shop Ticket
800006001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Private Shop Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

A permit ticket allows you to open portable shop. According to the rule, only Merchants' Union can open Shop in basecamp, but if you have this ticket, you can open your Private Shop anywhere.

800006002.Name: [Access Pass] Steel Graves
800006002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

Machine with internal program that deletes battle data from Steel Graves held on following day. SFL limits entering into Steel Graves up to 5 times per day, and it is decided based on presence or absence of battle data. Therefore, this allows the  battle data to get deleted, so you can enter Steel Graves freely. For some reason, the durability of machine is very weak, It gets broken after using it once.

800006003.Name: [Access Pass] Last Carnival
800006003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket] Last Carnival<font color='#9D927B'>

Card that verifies the access permit of area with Alternate Vacuum. SoulWorkers who take care of convenience at SFL, need Access Card in order to go into Vacuum.
After entrance, It gets destroyed after using it once, so it is critical to prepare necessary items in advance.

800006007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket] Golden Citadel<font color='#9D927B'>

Golden Vacuum: Card needed to go into Golden Citadel. Reasons are not known, but you can attain them if you defeat Alternate Vacuum Monsters. Perhaps this equipment is made for access only for those who can defeat them…

800006008.Name: [Special Pass] Alternate Vacuum
800006008.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket] Entire Casual Raid<font color='#9D927B'>

800006009.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket] Golden Citadel<font color='#9D927B'>

Golden Vacuum: Special Access Pass that resets number of entry records to Golden Citadel. Since it is special danger zone, even SoulWorkers need to receive special permission.
After entrance, It gets destroyed after using it once, so it is critical to prepare necessary items in advance.

800006010.Name: [Access Pass] Deepest Place in Vacuum
800006010.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Primal Park Raid Pass<font color='#9D927B'>

A ticket that allows you to enter the place where the Primal resides. No one know why it is so, but you can receive the item by defeating the enemies in the Golden Citadel.
Put it another way, you may not enter if you cannot defeat them...

800006011.Name: [Access Pass] The Primal
800006011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Primal Park Entry Reset<font color='#9D927B'>

A special permit that allows you to re-enter the place where the Primal resides after a reset. Even SoulWorkers need a permit to enter this sector, as it is a particularly dangerous place.
Invalidated directly after use. It's advisable to stock up on necessary consumable items before entry.

800006012.Description:

800006013.Name: [Certificate of Attendance] The Primal Hero subjugation operation
800006013.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[The Primal Hero Raid Admission Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

A special training certificate to challenge the variant of Primal that exists much deeper. Only with this certification can you challenge The Primal Hero.
Since the Star Forest League has already classified it as a disaster and issued an evacuation advisory, the number of times it issues an operation certificate to challenge this is very limited.

<font color='#FF0000'>※This item is only available during the

800006015.Name: [Warp Orb] Yorhaka Challenge
800006015.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Warp Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Use the ticket to take part in Viilor's Altar solo ranking.
Catch Yorhaka within the time limit using all your powers and skills.

<font color='#FF0000'>If you leave Viilor's Altar solo ranking, you will be teleported to the Golden Citadel.<font color='#9D927B'>

800006016.Name: [Warp Orb] Abyss Lounge Access Pass
800006016.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Warp Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Move to Ranking Abyss Lounge for 1 person.

Challenge your limit by defeating endless enemies coming at you in a limited amount of time.

800006017.Name: [Continue Reward] Package
800006017.Description:
<font color='#FFBB85'>[Reward for staying connected]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a package paid if you maintain a consistent connection.

-Components-
[Continue Reward] Random Box x 1
Zenith's Request x 1

800006018.Name: [Social Item] Mat [30 minutes]
800006018.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Social Item] Available in District. Sit on the floor and relax. Recovers 5 action points per minute. Usage time: 30 minutes<font color='#9D927B'>

Since ancient times, people have said that the basic act of [resting] is sitting or lying down. You need a floor to sit or lie down, but this floor is usually messy. The point is that you can't sit comfortably. That is why this mat was invented, and as long as you have a mat, you can sit or lie down anywhere. In other words,

800006021.Name: [Access Pass] Stone of the Faith
800006021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Hidden Hideout Raid Pass<font color='#9D927B'>

A stone used to summon RaphaKumba in the Hidden Hideout. It's a copy of the stone Victor made from the raging war god's Tu-ka-nguha stone. Take this stone to the uninhabited island. RaphaKumba will not wait for long.

800006022.Name: [Access Pass] Lunar Fall
800006022.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Entry Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special Access Pass to reset, to enter the space where Junk Queen exist. Since this is special danger zone, even SoulWorker needs special access.

It is important to use needed items in advance, since it gets destroyed after using once.

800006024.Name: [Permit] Violent Sun x 10
800006024.Description:

[Permit] Violent Sun x 10

800006029.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Warp Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Disappear upon use. Can purchase again from the NPC [Corrupted Bookshelf].

800006032.Name: [Butterfly’s Spring Picnic] Photo [1D]
800006032.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[profile picture]<font color='#9D927B'>

A photo taken by Nabi wearing a spring picnic costume.
This is a photo that can be posted on the profile of the Star Forest League, and is attracting great interest from many people with special abilities. A popular item that allows talented players in the Star Forest League to express their own tastes and individuality in the bleak profiles they check every day.
<font color='#3162F5'>Can be used for 1 day<font color='#9D927B'>.

800006039.Name: [Adv. Warp Orb] Arcadia Realm
800006039.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Warp Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This state-of-the-art Warp Orb allows transportation to [Arcadia Realm].
It has permanent use compared with ordinary orbs. Also, this orb is virtually unbreakable by energy overload. However, it requires cooldown time to use again as the Orb consumes Soul Energy that is accumulated inside the user's body.

800009998.Name: Dimension Point
800009998.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Currency]<font color='#9D927B'>

The SFL issues this special currency to SoulWorkers who have carried out special missions. You can use it to buy a number of consumables from the SFL. available after successfully completing special quests.

834000002.Name: Revive Cell
834000002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A heap of super high-performance nano machines. Can restore broken items. Even if you only have a tiny fragment of an item, this can be restored to 100% with full performance. Often used to restore equipment mostly destroyed in unwise Upgradement attempts.

834000003.Name: Anti-Limiter
834000003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special Energy that force to raise the maximum output of equipment. The current number of Upgrade attempts is reduced by 5. The maximum output of Equipments with Anti-Limiter will increase, allows to reinforce output more steadily.

834000004.Name: Brooch Fusion
834000004.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This item lets you create a new brooch by fusing 5x Item for upgrading materials: Brooch. The device's performance is sadly not complete, which is why it's destroyed upon use.

834000005.Name: Socket Implement Device
834000005.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that adds a weapon socket for Battle Aid: Drives to your SoulWeapon. This is how you adhere to a Soul Energy rule that states: ‘Only a certain amount of Soul Energy may be attached in individual coordinates.'

834000006.Name: Brooch Socket Implement
834000006.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Outfits on which you can equip brooches (material upgrade item) are very rare. But the Brooch Puncher allows you to equip brooches on all outfits. The puncher acts as a kind of material converter that perfectly customises the outfit to the brooch. Destroyed after use.

834000007.Name: Sealing Stamp
834000007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

If the Soul Weapon or Gear is passed on to the SoulWorker for a moment, it will be fused and binded with the user and cannot be used by others. However, this Sealing Stamp can forcibly erase fused Soul Energy, allowing others to use Soul weapons or Gears, even if they were binded.
Cannot be used on items that [Binds when picked up] or [destroyed items].

834000008.Name: Tax Free Ticket
834000008.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A ticket that waives the sales fees when selling at the Market. A product of the joint project between the Cloudream Bank Alliance and the Trader Alliance. It's a good idea to only use the ticket if the fees are high.

834000009.Name: Submission Quantity Increase
834000009.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Individuals can only list a limited number of items in the Market. This is because it's operated by human employees. This ticket, however, lets you increase that number. Market employees receive a bonus for the month in which the ticket is used. This amounts to ‘Please turn a blind eye'. Indeed. It's a bribe.

834000010.Name: Submission Period Extension
834000010.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Ticket for extending the list period]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Market only offers a little space which is why the listing period is limited. If items don't sell within a fixed time, they usually go back to the owner. This ticket lets you extend the listing period. As everyone knows, you can bribe one or two folk. They say Market employees receive a bonus for this ticket. So go ahead!

834000011.Name: Low-Grade Brooch Fusion
834000011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This small item lets you create a new brooch by fusing 5x Item for upgrading materials: Brooch. The device only recognizes bottom range brooches.

834000012.Name: Seal Deleter
834000012.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small stamp that lets you reduce the item's previous liberations. Please press on it firmly.
It cannot be used on items where the liberations have already been reduced.

834000013.Name: Restoration Limit Reducer
834000013.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mysterious device that reduces an item's number of previous restorations. They say the device can even turn back time... but that's not confirmed yet.

834000014.Name: League Emblem Change
834000014.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[League Emblem Change] Only for the League Master<font color='#9D927B'>

< ※ Requirements: League Level 2 & League Emblem >
A document that lets you change the Emblem of the League. 
The League Emblem represents a League, so You Have To Decide Carefully.

Can only be used once (Disposable).

834000015.Name: Energy Converter
834000015.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Changes Equipment Effects<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that transforms the energy in SoulWeapons, equipment or Jewelry. You can use it to change the characteristics of the energy in various types of equipment. The more energy in a piece of equipment, the more of these items you need. Note also that the characteristics of the transformed energy are set at random. Be careful.

834000016.Name: Brooch Extractor
834000016.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>(for extracting brooches)<font color='#9D927B'>

A device which makes an equipped brooch give off a strong magnetic field and causes its signal to change.
If you use this chip, you can extract brooches that were originally socketed on an outfit. 
- Warning: The brooch extractor can only extract the equipped brooches from an item in the fashion section.
Extraction from multiple sections requires 1 extractor per section.

834000017.Name: Socket Item Extractor
834000017.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that extracts a socketed soulstone or Familiar from equipment. When extracting the soulstone, the equipment will be surrounding in a thin shell so that the soulstone's energy is not lost.

834000018.Name: Premium Solvent
834000018.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Soulstone Dismantling Item<font color='#9D927B'>

A particularly concentrated solvent that is applied to extract Fragments of the Wise.
If you remove a soulstone using this solvent, you will have the chance to attain additional Fragments of the Wise and even have a small chance of attaining a slumbering soulstone.
<font color='#FF0000'>The likelihood of a slumbering soulstone increases in correspondence to the soulstone rank that is being extracted.<font color='#9D927B'>

834000019.Name: Refined Stone
834000019.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Refiner]
Alters the level of an item from inferior to Ultimate (0%-100%).<font color='#9D927B'>

A special stone, which changes the value of a SoulWorker's gear.
There is no guarantee that this stone will upgrade an item.

834000020.Name: Reinforced Refined Stone
834000020.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Refiner]

<font color='#FFBA85'>[Profile Photo]<font color='#9D927B'>

Special chance to observe this attractive face for <font color='#FF0000'>1 Hour<font color='#9D927B'> 
 -Henry-

898020002.Name: [Toru's 1st of April Event] Photo
898020002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Profile Photo]<font color='#9D927B'>

“It is Already April Fool season. Specially created for this season. Picture of Dandy guy Toru with chest hair as warm as his mind in this cold city. Could you spread the word about my hot chest for about <font color='#FF0000'>1 Hour<font color='#9D927B'> instead of me?
-Toru-

898020003.Name: [Senia's 1st of April Event] Photo
898020003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Profile Photo]<font color='#9D927B'>

“Loot at this newbie, my name is on name lists of this year's April Fool with captain because of Captain. Haha…ha…
This is my specially made picture for April Fool's Day. Can use for about <font color='#FF0000'>1 Hour<font color='#9D927B'>…
-Senia-

898020004.Name: [Martin's 1st of April Event] Photo
898020004.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Profile Photo]<font color='#9D927B'>

Beep-
Hi this is Martin. This is my picture specially made to celebrate April Fool's Day. Not sure where to use and what to do with this, but hope it doesn't make any mess. I don't want any extra work.
Fortunately, this comforts me that this can only be used for <font color='#FF0000'>1 hour<font color='#9D927B'>.
Hope you spend exciting April Fool's Day.
-Voice Message-

898020007.Name: [Zyte's 1st of April Event] Photo
898020007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Profile Photo]<font color='#9D927B'>

Eh? You want to borrow this? Hmm… not sure where you will use this for…
Okay, but only for <font color='#FF0000'>today<font color='#9D927B'> alright? I will take it back later, just so that you know.
-Yomi-

898020008.Name: [Efnel explodes with shame] Photo
898020008.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[profile picture]<font color='#9D927B'>

Another photo taken of Afnel in commemoration of April Fool's Day.
"Poison? What's with that camera? Oh, and you're crouching down... Now, wait a minute, won't you stop taking pictures while walking around at breakneck speeds? It's so scary? Po, pose? Lasers from your eyes? Poison?! Poison! Stop crying...!"
- Afnel in shock and fear -

Put this photo up as a Profile Photo for Starry Forest League; many Supernaturals are being drawn to it. Make sure to flaunt your own charm and personality with this popular item.

898900027.Name: Erwin's new signboard
898900027.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Furniture]<font color='#9D927B'>

Irwin’s newly renovated entrance sign.
After setting it up in your room, you can feel as if Erwin is welcoming you when you come back from your outing. Although you may be surprised at times.

898900029.Name: [EV] Bonus item box
898900029.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Reward Package]<font color='#9D927B'>

Package paid through card flipping.
When opening it, you can get helpful items.

898900030.Name: [Rank] Flemma Challenge
898900030.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Ranking Challenge Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

Using this ticket will allow Player to enter 1-Player Violent Sun Ranking.
Defeat Flemma in as little time as possible!

898900031.Name: [Full Package] Butterfly Romance and Blossom
898900031.Description:
<font color='#FFBB85'>[Costume Package]<font color='#9D927B'>

A package containing everything from [Butterfly's Romance and Blossom] plus an improved Warp Orb.

-Components-
[Romance and Clematis] Veil x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Wedding Dress x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Gloves x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Stocking x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Shoes x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Romantic Clematis x 1
[Romance and Clematis] Flower Rain x 1
[Butterfly Romance and Blossom] Photo x 1
Improved Warp Orb

898900036.Name: [Limited] Anti-Destruction Device
898900036.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Reinforced anti-destruction item]<font color='#9D927B'>

It is a reinforced destruction prevention device that cannot be used because all signal-induced power is discharged. Stores seem to purchase it at a low price for recycling purposes.

898900040.Name: [Nabi's Goddess of Wonderful World] Photo
898900040.Description:

898900044.Name: [Butterfly’s Small and Precious Swordsman] Photo [1D]
898900044.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[profile picture]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a photo of Nabi's deformed character in action in a VR game.
I can’t hold back what I want to say! I think I was born to say famous lines. I feel like I'm becoming more and more of a comedian. Is this guy okay?

<font color='#3162F5'>Can be used for 1 day<font color='#9D927B'>.

898900047.Name: [Violent Sun] Background Film
898900047.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Character selection window background film]<font color='#9D927B'>

A background film shot near Grace City, which was devastated by the Plema.
The area near the ruined Grace City, a reminder that there is nothing left at the end of the war, is added as a selectable background in the character selection window.

898900048.Name: [Dhana's Shining Star on Stage] Photo
898900048.Description:

Put this photo up as a Profile Photo for Starry Forest League; many Supernaturals are being drawn to it.

This is a photo that can be posted on the profile of the Star Forest League, and is attracting great interest from many people with special abilities. 898900052.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Costume Box]<font color='#9D927B'>

A package containing goblin lights for all characters.
When you open it, you can get a goblin fire that matches your character.
