899999999.Name: Information Item
899999999.Description: Double left or right-click on the ‘Use test item' information item to get more detailed info.

901002401.Name: Junk Knight Sample
901002401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cell sample from Junk Knight. You can lose yourself gazing at the deep, dark Color.

901002502.Name: Stained Ribbon
901002502.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The ribbon seems familiar. It's a little messy, which is down to the place it was found. A bad feeling washes over you as you look at the ribbon.

901002951.Name: Beholder's Slime
901002951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Beholder's Secretion. Maybe you can use this secretion – mixed with an anti-venom – to prevent Catherine's transformation into a Soul Junk. After all, they say one poison cancels out another, right?

901003905.Name: Security Key
901003905.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The security key belonging to Venin, Vice Commander of the Rapid Flame's training unit. Looks super secure.

901004555.Name: Drain Claw
901004555.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Obtained from the massive Vessi particle cannon. It looks like they were made for suction.

902000101.Name: Shard of Vacuum
902000101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A crystal carrying the Energy of the Great Vacuum. The crystal shines an ominous scarlet red. Just looking at it gives you a bad feeling.

903000102.Name: Mercenary Contract
903000102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mercenary contract from Ralph taken by Yomi as a deposit. Ralph' personal information is noted down in meticulous detail. Maybe we should show our bad side and register with Ralph' social security number?

903000152.Name: Cell Division
903000152.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cell dividing. A Soul Junk's cells keep on dividing without stopping. The process is unchanged, which is why it's so valuable to research. That's the official line, at least.

903000252.Name: Chris' Perfume
903000252.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Trashbert loves using this perfume. Maybe you can cheer Goldie up a little with this perfume because it reminds him of Trashbert.

903000302.Name: Traces of Clustered Insanity
903000302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Edgar's power flowed into this item, which is why you might see him within it as an illusion. Countless people are faced with fear because of this little item.

903000352.Name: Earthquaker Component
903000352.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Lithos Quaker range. Countless upgrades of the Lithos Quaker technology led to the current Grava Lithos Quaker.

903000353.Name: Splinter Component
903000353.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Shock Splitter range. Countless upgrades of the Shock Splitter technology led to the current Destructor SX.

903000354.Name: War Solver Component
903000354.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Massacrops range. Countless upgrades of the Massacrops technology led to the current Grave Massacrops.

903000355.Name: Devil's Core Component
903000355.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An important component in the Hell Wheel core. The component has stored the Hell Wheel's energy.

903000356.Name: Trans Core Component
903000356.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A component that has stored the energy of Enoch's Blood Nova Infinirings. An empty core was exposed to the Infinirings' energy in order to store it.

903000357.Name: Body Upgrade Component
903000357.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A component of the technology used in the humanoid robots in Ruin Fortress. Made with the help of Janice's alchemy.

903000358.Name: Core Upgrade Component
903000358.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This component has stored both the Blood Nova of a Near SoulWorker as well as the core technologies of the NED Company in its energy. Made with the help of Janice's alchemy.

903000401.Name: Hologram Storage
903000401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sion's energy waves and an error in the Ruin Fortress system created Sion's hologram energy. This energy source forcibly binds the hologram energy.

906000401.Name: Machine Component
906000401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Various machine parts that were absorbed by a Soul Junk. The black sticky stuff is pudding. Paws off!

906000851.Name: E.C.U
906000851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small Cube that records all of the orders to the mannequins. So this is the key to the scary mannequin forces' master plan.

906000951.Name: Flight Jacket
906000951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cool pilot's jacket. It belonged to Gaian, the father of Setsuka and Ryoko. Everyone wants to have it.

906001051.Name: Adv. Nut
906001051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Highly Effective Screw Nut. I wonder what kind of function is hiding behind that term ‘highly effective' they added to the start?

906001201.Name: Sharp Component
906001201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Very sharp parts. Just looking at them gives you chills.

906001251.Name: Adv. Bolt
906001251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Highly Effective Screw. I wonder what kind of function is hiding behind that term ‘highly effective' they added to the start?

906001301.Name: Power Supply
906001301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that generates energy for the mannequins. The underlying principle is unknown, but it seems to be highly effective. Since nothing is known about the principle behind it, the device is called a generator.

906001651.Name: Sack of Fire
906001651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's called Goofball, but it's just an ordinary oil container. How was this massive item able to fit into that body?

906001701.Name: Trigger
906001701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's called Sparky, but it's just a lighter. Lots of mechanisms for moving the mannequins are simpler than you think.

906001951.Name: Firework
906001951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A firework shell still lodged in the hand of the dwarf mannequin. The sight of the dwarf mannequin desperately clutching the firework shell isn't one you'll forget in a hurry.

906002001.Name: Stretched Tongue
906002001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's a bad joke that you're meant to collect these tongues. And what exactly is the idea behind it? It's surprisingly soft.

906002451.Name: Heated Chain
906002451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A chain that was subjected to intense heat and split apart. How do you even transport this hot chain?

906002551.Name: Temptation Stone
906002551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A gigantic crystal that glowed a clear blue and was ordered by Yomi. The mannequins gather in the shine of its light. It would be a shame to leave the stone to Yomi.

906002901.Name: Memory Chip
906002901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece that can be dropped by King Wayangon. It contains an unchanged opinion on Mad Edgar.

906003001.Name: Rocky Slime
906003001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A secretion shaped like a stone. Is it a secretion shaped like a stone or stone shaped like a secretion? That's the real question here. Who am I? What is the Universe?

906003101.Name: Raving Essence
906003101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The essence looks as if it could let out a terrible scream and jump up at any moment. It's all just imagination, but you still can't shake the feeling.

906003201.Name: Large Fragment
906003201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A gigantic piece of a building broken off in the monster crowd. Even a strongman couldn't move this piece.

906003251.Name: Piece of Glass
906003251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of glass from a driverless car. It makes no sense collecting these pieces because you don't know who it belongs to.

906003351.Name: Grass
906003351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A blade of grass that typically grows on coastal roads. This blade of grass was plucked from the back of a monster in the Monster Mob. Maybe you shouldn't chew on the blade of grass.

906003551.Name: Chunk of Concrete
906003551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A lump of cement. It's very sturdy. Really. It's made of cement, after all. What more explanation do you need?

906003701.Name: Alligator Leather
906003701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The skin of a Soul Junk that has taken the form of a gigantic alligator. Whether it's real alligator Leather or not is hard to judge, but it really doesn't look like leather now.

906003901.Name: Poison
906003901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This substance with the characteristics of a poison can be obtained from a special Soul Junk. You should definitely wear gloves when handling this substance. They don't call it poison for nothing.

906003951.Name: Sticky Horn
906003951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It might be shaped like a horn, but it's sticky and soft when you touch it. Can you really call such a thing a horn? Maybe ‘secretion shaped like a horn' would be better?

906004451.Name: Solidified Slime
906004451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It has all the characteristics of a secretion, but touching it shows it's an unknown, hard substance. Soul Junks are truly extraordinary.

906004551.Name: Red Molt
906004551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The carapace of a purple spider. It's hard to imagine how this item should further our quest.

906004701.Name: Proof of Queen
906004701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A gemstone that you get from a female spider. It emits a beautiful light that makes other spiders think you're a seductive female spider. Foresight trumps hindsight.

906004751.Name: Spider's Leg
906004751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A front leg from a male spider. You can clearly tell the leg is made to hold enemies firmly and spear them. This is the last piece of evidence Hel wants.

906004801.Name: Core Fusion
906004801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Proof of cannibalism. Two or more lots of core information have merged into one another. Certain to cause mutations.

906004851.Name: Material X
906004851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A deadly substance secretly developed by the NED Company. Nothing concrete is known about the substance, which is why it's called Material X.

906004951.Name: Rat Furuncle
906004951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment of a gemstone that hangs on the back of a mouse according to Yomi. At first glance, the red shimmer reminds you of a gemstone but shivers run down your spine as soon as you touch it.

906005101.Name: Retina Cell
906005101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An eye cell from Beholder. A good opportunity to find out why the obviously artificially created Beholder has a human organ attached to it.

906005251.Name: Access Card
906005251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

ID that secures access to the NED Company's N-102 Shelter. You have to use the ID to check in every morning or else you'll be marked as absent.

906005351.Name: Magenta Essence
906005351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An essence that shimmers crimson. The Color is totally different to that of other essences. Just the look of it tells you it's stronger than other essences.

906005401.Name: Modified Cell
906005401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something about these Soul Junk cells has been changed. You can't say exactly what.

906005501.Name: Complete Cell
906005501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A perfect Soul Junk cell that was achieved through ongoing Upgradements. At first glance, it doesn't look any different to other cells, but there's no comparing the contents.

906005601.Name: Burstlike Core
906005601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core that could explode at any moment. Leona says that every woman should definitely have something explosive – but this here is not it.

906005651.Name: Black Molt
906005651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The carapace of Bone Crasher, which Zyte ordered. It's flexible yet sturdy. The carapace has an incredible sheen.

906005701.Name: Sloppy Wing
906005701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can't really say if it's a wing or what exactly because it's so flabby. If you spread it out on the ground, you could say it looks like a wing, though.

906005751.Name: Muscular Core
906005751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A gemstone Zyte would like to have. Nobody knows what he wants to do with it. Maybe it's better that way.

906005851.Name: Piece of Cloth
906005851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of Selene's torn nightgown. You get strange thoughts thinking about the fact that Selene wore this nightgown.

906005901.Name: White Molt
906005901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The carapace of a new kind of Adv. Soul Junk. It may not shine but it still stands out.

906006201.Name: Black Feather
906006201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A black feather. Feather or wing. There's hardly any difference. It's that big. Just big.

906006351.Name: Shard of Vacuum Fragment
906006351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A crystal shard that carries the Energy of the Great Vacuum inside it. If you're not careful, you might cut yourself on the sharp edges.

906006601.Name: Mechanic Arm of Black Gauntlet
906006601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This artificial arm demonstrates exactly the same intimidating power as the original from the Vice Captain of the Rapid Flame Vanguard.

906006651.Name: Mechanic Arm of Ultimate Pistol
906006651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The artificial arm of Hex Pugilist, elite of the Firestream Vanguard, possesses incomparable destructive power.

906006751.Name: Piece of Solid Armor
906006751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It probably broke off from Tank Steeleron's Armor. It may only look like plain steel, but not even an Armor-piercing round could pierce it.

906006851.Name: Giant Hammer
906006851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The giant hammer from Hell Inforcer from the Rapid Flame's attack squad. There's a strange device attached to the head of the hammer.

906006951.Name: Discarded Ball
906006951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A baseball that was lodged in the flank of a Steeleron. It looks pretty ragged and has bite marks on it.

906007001.Name: Red Light Goggles
906007001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Goggles worn by Scar. It's unclear if Maxim can do anything with this.

906007151.Name: Poison Figure
906007151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A figure that comes from Lord Pytho's chest. Nobody can say clearly who this obscene yet beautiful figure is modeled on.

906007351.Name: Magical Pad
906007351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A block obtained from defeated pursuers. You don't want to imagine what they want with it.

906007451.Name: Snake Venom
906007451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The poison from Viperess. A graze is enough to lame a man. Our little Sora would absolutely love to put it to use. Does she really belong among medical professionals?

906007551.Name: Potion of Attractiveness
906007551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A magical scent of unknown origin with ‘Love Potion' written on it. It gives everyone the status ‘Charmed' and clouds their vision. Julie thinks it makes her appear mature.

906007651.Name: Potion of Confidence
906007651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Nobody knows where this stuff comes from. For all those who aren't brave enough to declare their feelings. It's supposed to be similar one way or another, but there just has to be a catch somewhere.

906007701.Name: Beast Fang's Mane
906007701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's pretty flexible and sturdy for such a stiff mane. Only handling it is fairly difficult.

906007851.Name: Intensive Garura's Beak
906007851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

As the Argus Gaour found death, she started to tear down all the ends. Careful, it's fragile.

906007901.Name: Armored Garura's Beak
906007901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The beak of an Armor Gaour. Unlike the Argus Gaour, the Armor Gaour beak does not start to break down. It is actually even indestructible.

906008051.Name: Legendary Kukri
906008051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A burning knife used by Redmane. A powerful knife with an unusual shape that was made by Redmane, the trainer of the Gaours.

906008151.Name: Someone's Dog Tag
906008151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Dog tags from the SFL that you get from a Caster. They may be old, but you can still see the name and the service number. ‘Trashbert, 25-11693'

906008251.Name: Remains of Queen Garura
906008251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

After you capture the spirit of Falcon, Queen Gaour's Ashes fall from somewhere. It would be great if this would end the confrontation between the two veterans.

906008351.Name: Electric Cable
906008351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A power cable that is believed to have been used by MinWoo's father. A Wild Sabreclaw was felled with this cable. You can't say exactly why people think it was MinWoo's father.

906008501.Name: Burnt Photo
906008501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This photo shows Lisbee's happy family. Part of the photo was burnt away in the battle with Rageface. What are we supposed to say to Lisbee...?

906008651.Name: Remanis of the Fallen
906008651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The uniform of a citizen from Deaf Town who was sacrificed by Grand Blaze Taifon. Let's take it to Lisbee.

906008751.Name: Scar's Giant Axe
906008751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The giant axe from Scar, who it was thought perished in the fall. This axe is covered in the blood of countless members of the SFL and Lisbee's beloved soul.

906008951.Name: Thick Chain
906008951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A thick iron chain like the one used by Big Buddha. The chain is so thick so it can withstand the weight of the iron.

906009101.Name: Assassin's Creed
906009101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A book that contains all of the actions and guidelines of the Rapid Flame's Killer Squad. It's illegible right now because it's written in an unknown tongue.

906009151.Name: White Mask
906009151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mask worn by Whiteclaw. The mask isn't suitable for the Assassin Squad. It reminds you of a certain hero from the Special Squad.

906009201.Name: Dancing Sword
906009201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A red sword as used by the Shadow Dancer. Although it could be somewhat dangerous for MinWoo, he'll still need it if he's to become a warrior.

906009301.Name: Coffin of Spirit
906009301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The coffin borne by the Nether Collector. You can sense the Soul Energy that hides within it. Let's take it to Haifu.

906009401.Name: Broken Crimson Blade
906009401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The broken blade of Phantom's sword. There's as much blood clinging to this blade as Scar's weapon.

906009451.Name: Unexploded Missile
906009451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Trader Alliance has attached a tripod to it that was provided by the NED Company. It may be small but it's massively effective.

906009501.Name: NED Co. Mercenary's Blood Sample
906009501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The secret of the NED Mercenaries' incredibly power is locked away within this blood sample. Let's take the sample to Sora, even if we don't know exactly what she'll do with it.

906009701.Name: Flamethrower
906009701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An inhuman, deadly weapon that was attached to Megiddon's Rage MK2 for battle. It's just as effective for animals.

906009751.Name: Drone Component
906009751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The machine component from a drone developed to help with work. The NED Company has currently repurposed the drone and deploys it in combat situations.

906009801.Name: Main Punisher Component
906009801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An important component that Uriel needs in order to move. Since only one part of it is built into the body, Uriel stops moving as soon as the part is removed. Let's take it to Zyte.

906009901.Name: Alpha Punisher's A.I Chip
906009901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An AI that was handed all decision-making authority in combat situations by the pilot of Uriel Alpha. SangHoon is supposed to have made this? Yeah, right...

906009951.Name: Raban's Data Chip
906009951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A chip containing information about Raban's physique. Contains information about Near SoulWorker Raban, who was created in a secret NED Company lab.

906010001.Name: Raban's Medicine Bag
906010001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A bag full of medicine which Henry used to control Raban. Henry drops the bag and flees after Raban lost to the SoulWorkers.

906010501.Name: Aina's Photo
906010501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A photo of Ina that Casen protects as much as his own eyes. Where he goes off to with the photo, nobody knows.

906010752.Name: Iron Shield
906010752.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An iron shield worn by a Dominio. It seems only a Dominio can carry this shield.

906010801.Name: Synchronizer
906010801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that allows Destructor SX and Grave Massacrops to move in synchronicity. Makes you want to shout ‘FUUUSION!'.

906010901.Name: Fallen Soldier's Badge
906010901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The members of the SFL wear this insignia. A memento of the fallen soldier. Let's take it to Casen.

906010952.Name: Sanson's Necklace
906010952.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The inside of the pendant on the rocket necklace bears a photo of Ina. The inside of the cover reads: Dearest K. You don't really want to open it any further.

906011001.Name: Individual Power Supply
906011001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An energy source that Destructor SX carries within itself. It looks as though you could use the generator separately with a few clever moves. That's not guaranteed, of course.

906011051.Name: Signal Receiver
906011051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A wave receiver that's attached to a tracker. The received is equipped with a little antenna. Nobody knows precisely what it's good for, but if you can catch stalkers in the act with it, it can't be that bad, right?

906011101.Name: E-Deliver Mainframe
906011101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A part of E-Deliver's body. It's very difficult to collect still intact forms. Is this how kidnappers feel?

906011151.Name: Old Headphone
906011151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Enoch has these old headphones on. Not only was production of this model discontinued, they don't even work. So you should only wear them for the style.

906011201.Name: Automatic Chip
906011201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A chip that allows Maton Uriel and Ato Firelord to move even without human control. The name is totally loveless.

906011301.Name: Piece of Super Abel
906011301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

One of the pieces of Super Abel after he fell apart. Demanding something like that... you feel like a stalker.

906011751.Name: Large Cable
906011751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A long cable used as a Gishin's arm. If you hang Dusty on it, it's bound to look very funny.

906011801.Name: Vaccine Data
906011801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A file about vaccines that can be extracted from Genozidion. This file is really helpful, which you can't say for Genozidion's appearance.

906012101.Name: Suspicious Recorder
906012101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A familiar male voice chants: Ina... Inaaa...aaaaa...! Is it a song or a mantra? You can't say exactly. It could be a prayer from the cyber religion.

906012251.Name: Energy Amplifier
906012251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of the Infinirings used by Near SoulWorker Enoch. Contains a similarly immense energy to Enoch's Upgraded Soul Energy.

906012301.Name: Full-Armed Sieg Proto's Core
906012301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An energy source that allows the Battery Bot to move. With its black and red hull, the energy source looks like a real heart emitting heat.

906012351.Name: Artificial Spirit Cluster
906012351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You get this from the first Near SoulWorker, Sion. Nomaam designed the container. Nomaam's dream looks genuine.

906012401.Name: Words of Riddle
906012401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something enigmatic is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘M'.

906012402.Name: Words of Curiosity
906012402.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something dubious is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘P'.

906012403.Name: Words of Unknown
906012403.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something unknown is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘L'.

906012404.Name: Words of Suspcion
906012404.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something sinister is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘H'.

906012405.Name: Words of Familiarity
906012405.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something confidential is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘E'.

906012501.Name: Piece of Torn Picture
906012501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Torn picture scraps If you put the image back together again, you can find out who the owner of the picture treasures. Let's take it to Trisha.

906012551.Name: Deactivated E-Deliver
906012551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

E-Deliver, who was stopped by a powerful shock. Handle it carefully because it's one of the most crucial items for Yomi's business plans.

906012701.Name: Vault Access Key
906012701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A special key you receive from an Armor Sentry. In order to enter the storage area, an important device was integrated into the Armor Sentry that allows access. Take it to Ian.

906012751.Name: Secret Vault Access Key
906012751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Sentry Code gives you access to an important storage area. You can only find the code on the Sentry commander. I wonder what's inside the secret storage area?

906012801.Name: Deactivated Sentry
906012801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Sentry with a slightly broken camera. To use the Sentry as a guard bot you'll have to go to Yomi's base to get the Sentry working again. But we should just leave that minor detail to Yomi.

906012851.Name: Deactivated Blade Wolf
906012851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A barely damaged Blade Wolf. To use the Blade Wolf as a guard dog you'll have to go to Yomi's base to get it working again, like with the Sentry. Let's take it to Yomi.

906013251.Name: Deactivated Earthquaker
906013251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Of all the many and various robots that form the NED Company's main fighting force, the Lithos Quaker is the most produced. It still remains to be seen if this is a firework or not.

906013301.Name: Ghost's Cable
906013301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cable made from a Gishin's tentacle. This cable is used for espionage and links the computer to other devices.

906013352.Name: Old A.I Data Chip
906013352.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An old AI data store installed in a Maton Uriel. You could view the data store as the Maton Uriel's brain. You feel ill imagining it in a human.

906013401.Name: New A.I Data Chip
906013401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A new AI data store built into Armor Uriel and Firelord. An AI data store that uses the connection between Heavy Uriel and Flame Tamer for combat.

906013452.Name: Damaged A.I Data Chip
906013452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A damaged AI data store installed in a Bellow Bot. The Bellow Bot's data store was specifically attacked. It should be okay even if it's a bit damaged, right?

906013501.Name: Adv. A.I Data Chip
906013501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A highly effective AI data store installed in Deus Ex Machina. Ina's friend was involved in developing this gigantic robot. What shocked her so much that she built this monster of a robot?

906013551.Name: Deactivated War Solver
906013551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Of all the many and various robots that form the NED Company's main fighting force, this is a variation on the Lithos Quaker with a giant shield. A robot that specialises in breaking through enemy lines with sheer power.

906013601.Name: Scissor Blade
906013601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A knife attached to both hands of a Bellow Bot. The knife looks like a pair of scissors, but you can't use it to cut because the blade is missing.

906013751.Name: Illusion Program
906013751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Of all the programs developed for restoration in Cloudream, this one stands out the most. Not only are the program's functions outstanding, but the games supplied with it totally satisfy the user's desires.

906013852.Name: Signal Jammer
906013852.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This emitter was developed as a response to the NED Company's rockets. With a range of 10 km, it makes rockets either self-destruct or guides them to distant locations.

906013901.Name: Yomi's Item Box
906013901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Yomi's stolen bag. Nothing concrete can be said about the contents except that the bag is heavy. Is there a full oil container inside by any chance?

906014001.Name: Red Steel Plate
906014001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An iron plate that's like a glove for the Shock Splitter. It was made extra thick so it can handle many situations. Maybe you can also use it when making a ‘Burning Red MK2'.

906014051.Name: Small Screw
906014051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small screw installed in the joints of a Tracker. The screw is pretty small but the thread groove is even smaller. Do you tighten the screw with a needle?

906014101.Name: Hati's Blade
906014101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A sharp blade attached to Howler's neck. Dust has already collected on the blade because it obviously hasn't been used to attack.

906014151.Name: Blazing Red MK Ⅱ : Zyte Custom
906014151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

With its sharp blades and its striking Color, the ‘Burning Red MK2' made by Zyte makes a much more powerful impression than other robots. We're not used to seeing such great products from Zyte.

906014302.Name: High Strength Drill
906014302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A driller that's attached to the arm of a Shock Splitter. It's got much greater stability than other metals. If you look carefully, you can see something shining on the pointy tip.

906014401.Name: Gatling Gun
906014401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Gatling cannon from the NED Company that's been loaded with a Maton Uriel. It's intriguing and yet terrifying to see what Zyte will do with this weapon.

906014551.Name: Special A.I Data Chip
906014551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A specially designed AI data store that's been fitted with a Dradar Breaker. I wonder what kind of code book Ian's friend has left in here?

906014601.Name: Broken A.I Data Chip
906014601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A broken AI data store that's been installed in the Battery Bot. The data store is already partially damaged. I wonder if it's still readable?

906014651.Name: Dashcam
906014651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A black box that was hidden inside the control room. If you take this box to Betty, she can reconstruct the exact events of the battle.

906014751.Name: Heavy Earthquaker Mainframe
906014751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Grava Lithos Quaker that was caught alive and stunned. Hauling it was a lot more stressful than capturing it alive.

906014801.Name: Shield Program
906014801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The program that enables Near SoulWorker Noah's weapon to generate a shield. It doesn't matter how long you try to understand it, you won't figure it out. So let's give up.

906014851.Name: Thick Winter Clothes
906014851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A thermo suit that's so thick it could probably deflect bullets. The functions are extraordinary but it definitely makes you look fat.

906014901.Name: Music Chip
906014901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A chip containing music files. Illegal copies are the reason why markets are breaking down. So let's all use original products.

906015601.Name: Weird Fragment
906015601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment that you got from the Soul Junk in District 6. It emits a violet light. The very fact that you have it on you gives you an uneasy feeling.

906015701.Name: Hammer Drill
906015701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Splatter Brain drill. It's made of extremely hard metal alloys and much sturdier than a standard drill.

906015901.Name: Arachna Circuit
906015901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The circuit that makes up the Arachna AI. It contains High-Grade technology.

906016001.Name: Cut-throat Propeller
906016001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A propeller from the Air Reaper. It is designed to be extremely mobile and highly efficient.

906016201.Name: Drone Zero Motor
906016201.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The motor that provides the propulsion for Dronimo. It is built from highly High-Grade technology.

906016251.Name: Ghost Zero Motor
906016251.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The motor that provides the propulsion for Gishin-00. It is built from highly High-Grade technology.

906016451.Name: Splinter Circuit
906016451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The circuit that makes up the Shock Splitter AI. It contains High-Grade technology.

906016551.Name: Assault War Drone Head Gear
906016551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Head of the Onslaught Drone. The head consists of special components that ensure that it continues to function even after being separated from the main body.

906016651.Name: Iron Worm Joint Area
906016651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A joint from the Invertebrate. It is made from a memory alloy and is thus extremely expensive.

906017402.Name: Viled Soul
906017402.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Bucker TV longs to possess this stone, which contains the wild soul of the Soul Junk in District 6.

906017451.Name: Broken Viled Soul
906017451.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Allegedly, the defective ValSoul can be reassembled.

906017551.Name: Luminous Reagent
906017551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can find this reagent in Last Carnival|Virtue¤, but its effect is still a mystery.

906017701.Name: Hateful A.I Data Chip
906017701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small, light data chip from Last Carnival|Hate^.

906017951.Name: Malicious Reagent
906017951.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can find this reagent in Junk Hive|Sin¢, but its effect is still a mystery.

906018101.Name: Curing A.I Data Chip
906018101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small, light data chip from Junk Hive|Solace+.

906018351.Name: Apathetic Reagent
906018351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can find this reagent in Bandit Highway|Grace×, but its effect is still a mystery.

906018501.Name: Tormented A.I Data Chip
906018501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small, light data chip from Bandit Highway|Torment¥.

906018601.Name: Luminous Reagent
906018601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can find this reagent in Iron Castle|Virtue¤, but its effect is still a mystery.

906018751.Name: Hateful A.I Data Chip
906018751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A small, light data chip from Iron Castle|Hate^.

906019101.Name: Retirement application 1 Page
906019101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The first page of the form required for soldiers of the SFL to fill out when they want to be released from service.

906019102.Name: Retirement application 2 Page
906019102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The second page of the form required for soldiers of the SFL to fill out when they want to be released from service.

906019401.Name: Overdue List
906019401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A list created by the Cloudream Bank Alliance. It lists all debtors.

906019402.Name: Large Overdue List
906019402.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A list of debtors made by the Cloudream Bank Alliance. This list has the top priority debtors listed on it.

906019701.Name: Luxury Cloudream Type A
906019701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Stay up to date on all the latest fashion in Cloudream.
This magazine is very popular among the fashionista as it was published by a famous designer.

906019702.Name: Luxury Cloudream Type B
906019702.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Stay up to date on all the latest fashion in Cloudream.
This magazine is very popular among the fashionista as it was published by a famous designer.

906020001.Name: N.E.D Damaged Box
906020001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Holds property of the NED Company.
You still can't see what is inside even though the box is so damaged.

906020002.Name: N.E.D Solid Box
906020002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Holds property of the NED Company.
You can't see what's inside because the box is undamaged.

906020301.Name: Bank Clerk's Certificate P.1
906020301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is part of a two-page certificate that employees at Cloudream Bank Alliance require to prove their identity.
This page states the employee's position.

906020302.Name: Offensive SD Brooch x 5
906020302.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Package Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Offensive SD Broach Transmitter x 5

906030000.Name: Illusion Fragment
906030000.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment left behind by Illusion Monsters.

906030001.Name: Immaterial Fragment
906030001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

These parts are just an illusion.

906030002.Name: Transparent Fragment
906030002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This fragment is as clear as the ocean.

906030003.Name: Hell Bringer's Diary
906030003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Notes on life that the Hell Smasher always carries with him.

906030004.Name: Rapid Flame Report I
906030004.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Rapid Flame document obtained during a secret rendezvous.

906030005.Name: Rapid Flame Report II
906030005.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Rapid Flame document obtained during a secret rendezvous.

906030006.Name: Launcher Frame
906030006.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

These parts come from a machine like Codename: Taifon.

906030007.Name: Faded Photograph
906030007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can barely see the image.
The photo shows Tenebris' face, but half of it is torn off.

906030008.Name: Lord's Biography
906030008.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Tenebris' faithful companion Ladi compiled this biography.
A tiny glimmer of hope in your deepest despair.

906030009.Name: Illusion Chunks
906030009.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This lump is made up of countless illusions all mushed together. It's no good for anything in its unprocessed form.

906030010.Name: Illusion Meat
906030010.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A tangible illusion. You can't imagine what you can make with it.

906030011.Name: Illusion Rough Stone
906030011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An as yet unworked stone. It has quiet a pretty design. Maybe that's because it's just an illusion.

906030012.Name: Obtained Illusion
906030012.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The illusions are stored in specially made, tiny bottles to prevent them from getting lost.

906030013.Name: High-Grade Illusion Meat
906030013.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Tender illusion flesh. Better not ask where the meat comes from.

906030014.Name: Obtained Illusion
906030014.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The illusions are stored in specially made, tiny bottles to prevent them from getting lost.

906030015.Name: Dried Dark Mineral
906030015.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Rubbish<font color='#9D927B'>

Declared to be radioactive fallout.

906030016.Name: Sedurin Lab Sample
906030016.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A sample of black blood which Sedurin needs to examine in the lab.

906030017.Name: Hornet Poison
906030017.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A sample of a powerful poison obtained from a Fiery Hornet.

906030018.Name: Collected Samples
906030018.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A sample obtained from Fiery Hornets.

906030019.Name: Bone Fragments
906030019.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Human bones which were used as toys by people ignorant of their origin.

906030020.Name: Injector Parts
906030020.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sample components which are most likely used to inject Desire Energy.

906030021.Name: Muscle Parts of dead body
906030021.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Muscle parts which fell off a casualty.

906030022.Name: Rotted Meat
906030022.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Flesh that has been rotting for some time.

906030023.Name: Decayed Meat
906030023.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Flesh that has decomposed entirely.

906030024.Name: Festered Meat
906030024.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Flesh that has begun to fester.

906030025.Name: Orb with Soul
906030025.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An orb filled with countless souls from the Vacuum.
It's as transparent as an innocent soul.

906030026.Name: Butcher's Mark
906030026.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mark that displays the madness and brutality of the Butcher.

906030027.Name: Orb with Dark Soul
906030027.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An orb filled with countless souls from the Vacuum.
Wicked souls cloud its clarity.

906030028.Name: Golden Mark
906030028.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

The mark of the one with the most might Gold power.
You can get it when you complete Golden Citadel 3 times.

906030029.Name: Empty Soul Orb
906030029.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An orb filled with countless souls from the Void.
Malicious, brutal souls blight its clarity.

906030030.Name: Mark of Greed
906030030.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A mark that symbolises greed and egotism.
Can be purchased from Yomi in Grasscover Camp under the tab Quests.

906030031.Name: Sample From Yomi
906030031.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

Yomi was happy to give it to you. It looks unimportant, but it contains great power.

906030032.Name: Junk Beast's Wing
906030032.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The tips of the Baal Beast's wings are particularly tough, and should lend themselves well to crafting unbreakable textiles.

906030033.Name: Armor Fragment
906030033.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Victor III requires this fragment from Horrorkin's Armor.

906030034.Name: Soul Junk Cell Sample
906030034.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A collective sample comprising of a mixture of Soul Junk cells, which may hold the answer to Soul Junk contamination.

906030035.Name: Soul Junk Blood Sample
906030035.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A blood sample taken from Baal Royale, who was once a Vessi before his contamination.

906030036.Name: Junk Garura's Claw
906030036.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Hard as diamond and suitable for manufacturing Armored objects.

906030037.Name: Sticky Fluid
906030037.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Leona asked you for this. We'd rather not know what she needs it for.

906030038.Name: Bwain's Ring
906030038.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It was forged in ancient, nameless times but never rusts.

906030039.Name: Unidentified Slime
906030039.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It has not yet been identified, classified, analysed, diversified, sorted, grouped... you get the idea.

906030040.Name: N.E.D Identification Card
906030040.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An official certificate identifying its bearer as a NED employee.
In the SFL, it simply prompts an angry snort.

906030041.Name: Amorphous Alloy
906030041.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

To many metal and other unknown elements have fused into a clump here... A name for this is still to be found.

906030042.Name: Mutated Portion
906030042.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Judging by the extent of its mutation, it would appear to have quietly passed its sell-by date. Can be rediscovered in the corresponding museum section, for connoisseurs with taste.

906030043.Name: Broken Mask
906030043.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An explosion has broken it up into many parts. You can see the letters 'E', 'd', 'g' on a few of the fragments.

906030044.Name: Corrupted Piece of Cloth
906030044.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of cloth which seems to have been used to wipe down a patient after taking a remedy. A true rarity for connoisseurs.

906030045.Name: USB
906030045.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The last pieces of data from a baalified patient were able to be transferred to this device before they passed away.

906030046.Name: Haunted Metal
906030046.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's still in its raw form and therefore cannot shine like a refined gem. It's unbeatable in its suitability for use in Armor, however.

906030047.Name: Gold-Plated Icon
906030047.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A whole sentence in gold letters. A trace of Sierra Madre still floats within for certain readers.

906030048.Name: Akasha's Grace
906030048.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Akashic once shed a tear which froze into a shining crystal, which has been preserved for us to this day.

906030049.Name: Hard String
906030049.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This unbreakable material originates from a few line-shaped lifeforms.
Once unravelled, you could easily confuse Duramide with hazardous waste.

906030050.Name: Oil Drum
906030050.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A can half filled with oil.
It's required for the Flame Ox firearm.

906030051.Name: Core Engine
906030051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The CPU engine of the Island Buster.
Whoever is in possession of a Heart Engine has practically got the Island Buster in their pocket.

906030052.Name: Name Tag
906030052.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Tags that differentiate the NED Shield Battalion from the Rebellion Guard.
Yes, they're indispensable.

906030053.Name: Tank Fragments
906030053.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A pair of gloves necessary for operating heavy NED artillery.
They weigh almost as much as the Armor itself.

906030054.Name: Familiar Machine Fragment
906030054.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>


We can't be too precise about its function, but the part somehow seems very familiar to us.

906030055.Name: Familiar Data Chip
906030055.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>


We can't be too precise about its function, but the part somehow seems very familiar to us.

906030056.Name: Unidentified Machine Fragment
906030056.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This part is different from the common parts in Janice and Trisha's arsenal. It originates from Nihill's Guard and is full of exotic components.

906030057.Name: Nihill Kingdom Weapon Fragment
906030057.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece from the weapons used by Nihill's Warriors, the Paladine Decurions. They are a hefty weight on the scales.

906030058.Name: Iris's Christmas fan art poster
906030058.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Furniture]<font color='#9D927B'>

A poster created with an illustration of Iris, who won an excellent prize at the Christmas fan art event.

906030059.Name: Unidentified Fragment
906030059.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Fragment full of questions, has property of Ideal Vacuum.
Let's give it to Leona.

906030060.Name: Jewel of Kraken
906030060.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A shimmering purple stone belonging to Kraken.
May be a clue to the mysterious Soul Junk everyone is looking for. Take it to Victor.

906030061.Name: Stolen Tool
906030061.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Victor requires this tool to build the Microtransmitter. It has been stolen! Without it there's no way to hunt down the Soul Junk…

906030062.Name: Tracing Energy Connector
906030062.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Material<font color='#9D927B'>

A piece of kit required for the Microtransmitter. It conducts electricity. Previously owned by the Vessi.
But does it still work?

906030063.Name: Broadband Transceiver
906030063.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Material<font color='#9D927B'>

Zyte sells this fantastic kit.
It's a necessary component in the Microtransmitter for tracking the Soul Junk.

906030064.Name: Incomplete Energy Connector
906030064.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>Material<font color='#9D927B'>

A measuring device that Victor couldn't complete.
He sent the blueprints to Janice.
Collect all the necessary materials and take them to Janice. She will put it together for you.

906030065.Name: Completed Energy Tracer
906030065.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Victor's Incomplete Energy Counter has been converted and the Microtransmitter is finished! Say hello, Soul Junk!
According to Victor, you simply need to enter the data to track down the creature.

906030066.Name: Desire Energy
906030066.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Desire Energy essence in the body that has been made visible to the human eye. With Trisha's help you can upgrade it with a Fragment of Greed.

Desire Energy Equipment, eh? Desire Energy rings a bell, but I've never heard of this. The SFL would revoke my license on the spot... but the path to Trisha is never taken in vain! Give it here, I'll take care of it.
- Trisha -

906030067.Name: Example of The Supremacy
906030067.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Extracted from those creatures that the humans of this world deem Ultimate. Sarah needs the samples for her Viilor Energy Transmitter, and she needs quite a few. Lots and lots.

906030068.Name: Desire Fragment
906030068.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can strengthen Desire Energy with these fragments Collect lots of Fragments of Greed to upgrade your Desire Energy level.

906030069.Name: Scars of Grand Sorcery
906030069.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A substance with five Colors, that was produced when Soul Energy and RaphaKumba's magic met. It hasn't been purified and it could still be risky to use it. But its potential power is indisputable.

906030070.Name: Desire Loaf
906030070.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A cluster made up of Desire Energy from various different sources.
You'll get a random amount of Fragments of Greed when you use it.

906030071.Name: Wife letter
906030071.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Letter sent by Smith's wife.
It's never been opened.

906030072.Name: Smith's Serial number chain
906030072.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Serial number chain with the name, Smith.
Dog tag doesn't usually get lost because it is important for soldiers…

906030073.Name: Edelweiss Virus Sample
906030073.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sample of Edelweiss virus, which parasitize on S303 Shelter.
This can spread unknown disease, so let's be cautious.

906030074.Name: Deadly Stinger Virus Sample
906030074.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Sample of Deadly Stinger virus, which parasitize on S303 Shelter.
This can spread unknown disease, so let's be cautious.

906030075.Name: Unprocessed Serum
906030075.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Test tube with Surveillant's Serum.
According Warren's research, it can cure the unknown disease which spread everywhere on S303 Shelter.

906030076.Name: Unlucky Pocket
906030076.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Pocket with unpleasing unknown things.
Hand it over without opening it.

906030077.Name: Black Iron
906030077.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Black steel can be obtained from the body of Vessi which became Soul Junk.

906030078.Name: Tricky Code
906030078.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Code written with unrecognizable letters.
Can hand it to Robert.

906030079.Name: Unshaped Statue
906030079.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Ugly Statue.
It is absurd to find Artistry from things like this.

906030080.Name: Fanatics Scripture
906030080.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Original copy of scripture carried by Laymans of Vacuum Fanatics, the cult religion. That is why it was carried by Soul Junks became Vessi.

906030081.Name: Henry's Hair
906030081.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This would've been last pieces of Henry's Hair
Now it is burnt ash.

906030082.Name: Hidden Material for Ceremony
906030082.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Ceremony materials asked by Sang-Hoon.
Materials were found because of Sang-Hoon's request, who don't want robert's experiment to get achieved.

906030083.Name: Material for Ceremony
906030083.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Ceremony materials asked by Robert
Wants to know what this ceremony was created for.
But it shouldn't succeed if consider safety.

906030084.Name: Bishop's Fabulous staff
906030084.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Fancy Staff held by Ascension.
Not sure if this is Bishop's staff.
Bringing it because they asked me to bring something fancy.

906030085.Name: Temptation Fragment
906030085.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Fragment of Temptation Stone picked up from all Dipluce Horizon, to defeat Junk Queen's legion.
Can obtain by defeating Junk Queen, or defeating other powerful bosses of Dipluce Horizon multiple times.

<font color='#FFBA85'>※Obtain certain amount by defeating [Maniac] Difficulty [Anemone] and [Tenebris]. Or can Obtain a large quantity by defeating [Junk Queen] of [Lunar Fall] Raid.<font color='#9D927B'>

906030090.Name: Gold Ore Piece
906030090.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Gold ore fragment that Vacuum Fanatics Senior Executives used to own.
Be cautious since gold ores can be sold at a very high price, making you the major target of thieves.

906030091.Name: Heaven Guide Staff
906030091.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Staff made with unknown materials.
This has a wand shape, but Heaven Guide seems to be used for different purposes.

906030092.Name: Shattered Abyssal Core
906030092.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Piece of a fragment of the yellow core at the center of the Vacuum Abyss.
Only small shards are left after the violent battle.

906030093.Name: Broken Staff of Fate
906030093.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Fragment of a broken staff that Nemesis used to own.
Only small shards are left after the violent battle.

906030094.Name: Retrieved Supplies
906030094.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Supplies that were successfully retrieved.
All sorts of supplies such as food are stored inside the box.

906030095.Name: Energy Cell
906030095.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An energy cell without any label.
There's no way to figure out what kind of energy it holds.

906030096.Name: Crystal Jewel
906030096.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A jewel boasting a bright glow.
It seems like it will be traded at a very high price.

906030097.Name: Worn Fabric
906030097.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The only piece of fabric you could obtain after the fight against Anasyth. It's too little for any use.
It seems like a piece of Anasis' clothes.

906030101.Name: Mixed debris of Last Carnival
906030101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

[Something] which has been combined with irregular stone and Vacuum energy. Can detect similar waves of Alternate Vacuum energy, which can be found in Last Carnival. Needs special caution when dealing with it.

906030102.Name: Mixed debris of Junk Hive
906030102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

[Something] which has been combined with irregular stone and Vacuum energy. Can detect similar waves of Alternate Vacuum energy, which can be found in Junk Hive. Needs special caution when dealing with it.

906030103.Name: Mixed debris of Bandit Highway
906030103.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

[Something] which has been combined with irregular stone and Vacuum energy. Can detect similar waves of Alternate Vacuum energy, which can be found in Bandit Highway. Needs special caution when dealing with it.

906030104.Name: Mixed debris of Iron Castle
906030104.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

[Something] which has been combined with irregular stone and Vacuum energy. Can detect similar waves of Alternate Vacuum energy, which can be found in Iron Castle. Needs special caution when dealing with it.

906030105.Name: Old Family Photo
906030105.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A photo with Joseph's children that allowed him to stay sane while in the Vacuum.
The side of the photo with his children, along with Joseph himself, cannot be seen.
No other photo like this can ever be taken.

906030106.Name: Old Letter
906030106.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This letter is addressed to no one in particular.
Written in scribbly letters at the top of the page is the word [Will].

906030107.Name: Desire Weapon Sample
906030107.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A fragment from weapons Desire Workers use.
This can serve as an important factor when it comes to manufacturing something useful through research if passed on to Sedurin.

906030108.Name: Mysterious Pills
906030108.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Just holding onto it can make one feel sketchy.

906030109.Name: Habitat Study Sample
906030109.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A sample to help with acquiring knowledge of what's going on when being Vacuum-zed.

906030110.Name: Title Exchange Ticket
906030110.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Title Exchange Ticket]<font color='#9D927B'>

This Title Exchange Ticket was created to honor the many SoulWorkers who worked hard for Starry Forest League.
They can be exchanged for Rare Titles to get.

906030111.Name: Unstable Gunpowder
906030111.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Warning! It can EXPLODE even with a small impact.

906030112.Name: Old Baseball
906030112.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is someone's catch ball. A little bit dirty.

906030113.Name: Someone's Notebook
906030113.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Someone's Notebook... The owner may be recognized. However, no one can dare to guess the contents inside.

906030114.Name: Mechanical Armor
906030114.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Mechanical Armor that has been removed from Walking Rampart.

906030115.Name: High-Dose Jelly
906030115.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

High-Dose Jelly-type body fluid extracted from Polluted Soul Junks.

906030116.Name: Photo of Tenebris
906030116.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a picture of Tenebris in battle. It is a bit blur.

906036901.Name: Handset Transmitter
906036901.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Device looks like old transmitter. Despite the appearance, it is attached with the symbol of ST-Lab, which makes it look like that it has better performance.
Currently being sold to collect energy easily by requesting to Merchants' Union from ST-Lab..

Can receive <font color='#5FD546'>[[Repeat] Energy Collection]<font color='#9D927B'> quest, upon using it.

906036902.Name: Violent Sun Mission Receiver
906036902.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Very old equipment in the shape of a transmitter. Because of the S.T Lab symbol, it somehow seems like high-end despite its worn appearance.

906068000.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Warp Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

Can move to the Event Maze [Lonely Christmas].

906068001.Name: [EV] Christmas Socks
906068001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

They are actually hard to wear but perfect for storing something.
Can be exchanged to useful items at Gruton Coin Shop.

906068002.Name: [EV] Happy Snowflake
906068002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Event Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

This is a big snowflake from the sky for Christmas.
Unlike ordinary snowflakes, it does not melt easily and can be kept for a long time.
Can be exchanged to useful items at Gruton Coin Shop.

906068003.Name: [LIMITED] Energy Converter
906068003.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Item]<font color='#9D927B'>

A device that transforms the energy in Soul Weapons, Equipment or Accessory. You can use it to change the characteristics of the energy in various types of equipment. The more energy in a piece of equipment, the more of these items you need. Note also that the characteristics of the transformed energy are set at random. Be careful.

<font color='#FFBA85'>Since it is a mass production form, it can only maintain the effect of the Energy

906068004.Description:

916006801.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The volume in the container is quite low when you consider it was taken from a service station. It'll still get the car moving, though.

916009051.Name: Fallen Soldier's Dog Tag
916009051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The dog tags of a fallen SFL soldier. Dog tags left lying during the battle. Let's take them to Sora.

916011401.Name: Signal Jammer
916011401.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This jammer almost destroyed Trisha's livelihood. It's impossible to shake the feeling of having seen the aerial somewhere before.

916011551.Name: Live USB
916011551.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

At item that lets you force Nomaam to do slave work. You could become a slave driver.

916012001.Name: Remains of Abandoned Robot
916012001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Discarded robots that look like Dusty. A peculiar feeling of seeing the broken robots stacked one on top of the other.

916012051.Name: Deep Core Control
916012051.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A chip containing a program that allows you to control the interior of Deep Core. Only Lucy's trace remains.

916012452.Name: Buried Lab Coat
916012452.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's the same lab coat worn by the NED Company's lab workers. The owners are probably all employees of the NED Company in Ruin Fortress.

916012455.Name: Buried Photo
916012455.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can see the marks of time on this photo. It shows men and women in lab coats and little kids in test suits. One of the faces on the blurry photo belongs to the young Dr Stoph.

916012456.Name: Buried Nametags
916012456.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

White name badges made of plastic with numbers and initials on them. These are probably the names of the children who were used for the Near SoulWorker project.

916012458.Name: Buried USB
916012458.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Despite the fact it was buried, the USB stick still works very well. It's emblazoned with the NED Company logo. The stick contains a file with instructions for activating a robot.

916012459.Name: Piece of Torn Picture
916012459.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can't tell what was in the picture before. There are probably more picture scraps nearby.

916012651.Name: Ruin Fortress Blueprint
916012651.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Blueprint from the early days of the Ruin Fortress. You can clearly see the differences to the Ruin Fortress of today.

916012903.Name: Network Cable Map
916012903.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A map showing the Ruin Fortress cable network. It takes a bit of time to decipher this complicated map. Take it to Betty.

916013701.Name: Lost Access Card
916013701.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Some high-ranking administrator lost this output card. If you treat your things like that something bad is bound to happen. My sympathy to whoever this card belongs to. Let's take the card to Oden.

921000950.Name: A.I Module
921000950.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An AI module installed in an unmanned helicopter to carry out a mission. After the installation, the helicopter starts to carry out its mission as ordered.

921001050.Name: Adv. GPS
921001050.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A GPS that's highly effective. It may be small but it has outstanding signal strength. A true masterpiece and the most used system in Cloudream.

921002850.Name: Antidote
921002850.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An antidote that Victor procured by risking his life. Maybe it can be used to stop Catherine's transformation into a Soul Junk.

921005250.Name: Secret Key
921005250.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A decoder that secures access to the secret room in the NED Company's secret base. You have to have the key to get inside. The key's manufacture is a secret.

926000550.Name: Tritanium Stone
926000550.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Tritanium Stone is the core element necessary for the various SoulWeapons with their varying Soul Energys. It's traded at high prices.

926010101.Name: Broken Core
926010101.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

It's almost impossible to tell how the core originally looked. Maybe it hasn't entirely given up the ghost yet because it's still glowing weakly.

926010102.Name: Shattered Component
926010102.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

I wonder what happened to make the parts look this way? I wonder if it would be cheeky to take these parts for repairs?

926010351.Name: Broken Clock
926010351.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Nobody knows exactly why this clock is broken. This former clock doesn't work at all any more. It's not worth having the clock repaired. So get rid of it.

926010352.Name: Uselesss Metal Dust
926010352.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Metal dust you obtained when the clock was taken apart. Nobody can say exactly what you can do with it. So it's probably just best to sell it or throw it away.

926011450.Name: Upgraded Signal Jammer
926011450.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An improved version of the jammer. This time it really is only for blocking stalkers. Trisha made the jammer after Janice berated her.

926012400.Name: Words of Weirdness
926012400.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Something curious is engraved on this robot chip. If you look more carefully, you can see the letter ‘E'.

931000851.Name: Suspicious Letter of Appeal
931000851.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A plea for mercy from Tommy to be handed to Scral. It's called a plea for mercy but basically it contains Scral's various transgressions so it doesn't differ from a criminal record.

931001301.Name: Proof of Insanity
931001301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

One of Mad Edgar's henchmen wears this terrible looking insignia. You can get around Mad Edgar's strict requirements to some extent when you wear it.

931001501.Name: Aaron's Note
931001501.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A notebook Aaron lent to Miriam. Various well-known proverbs, time spent in couples therapy and the like are all clearly written down in this notebook.

931003001.Name: Complete Antidote
931003001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An improved version of the antidote in which the antidote was mixed with the secretion from Beholder. Unfortunately, nothing can be done about the fact that you have to inject yourself with slime from a Soul Junk.

933000350.Name: Punisher : Janice Custom
933000350.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A Uriel in which Janice has upgraded the core and rig. How cool would it be if you could ride around in it.

933000402.Name: Patch Installtion : RF_JS_00
933000402.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

An installation key that has been improved with hologram energy. Contains a program that allows Nomaam control over pre-installed sectors.

933000409.Name: Patch Master : RF_JS_M
933000409.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A patch master key made from hologram energy. Contains a program that controls access to Control Base and thus allows Nomaam control over the Ruin Fortress.

936000151.Name: Essence of Darkness
936000151.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A jet black lump of energy that summons a Soul Junk from anywhere, they say. Only a SoulWorker can extract and touch this essence.

936000301.Name: Black Slime
936000301.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

A substance made from the fur of the black Wolf Capsid. It's sticky and looks as though it could move by itself.

936001751.Name: Dog Tag
936001751.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

Dog tags worn on the bodies of the soldiers from the SFL. The fact that they're here and deformed gives you a bad feeling.

936008601.Name: Unknown Electric Cable
936008601.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Quest]<font color='#9D927B'>

This cable fell from somewhere when Grand Blaze Taifon was defeated at MinWoo's bidding. Somehow it calls to mind the power cable from MinWoo's father.

943000352.Name: Earthquaker Component
943000352.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Lithos Quaker range. Countless upgrades of the Lithos Quaker technology led to the current Grava Lithos Quaker.

943000353.Name: Splinter Component
943000353.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Shock Splitter range. Countless upgrades of the Shock Splitter technology led to the current Destructor SX.

943000354.Name: War Solver Component
943000354.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A core component of the Massacrops range. Countless upgrades of the Massacrops technology led to the current Grave Massacrops.

943000357.Name: Devil's Core Component
943000357.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

An important component in the Hell Wheel core. The component has stored the Hell Wheel's energy.

943000358.Name: Trans Core Component
943000358.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Crafting Material]<font color='#9D927B'>

A component that has stored the energy of Enoch's Blood Nova Infinirings. An empty core was exposed to the Infinirings' energy in order to store it.

994000001.Name: [EV] New Sanghoe Investment Securities
994000001.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Investment product selection]<font color='#9D927B'>

You can choose and invest in one of the new trading products released by the Merchants Association.
After the investment period ends, the product with the fewest investors is recognized for its scarcity value and can reap the greatest benefit.
The selected product can later be exchanged for rewards, so the more you have, the better.

994000002.Name: [Investment Product] Grooton Capsule with only bangs
994000002.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Merchant Alliance Investment Product]<font color='#9D927B'>

The capsule contains a variety of products, but it doesn't seem like there are many items you actually need.

994000003.Description:

994000004.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Merchant Alliance Investment Product]<font color='#9D927B'>

It is said that when you shake the toy, you can hear a grouton cry.

994000005.Name: [Investment Product] Winter Debt
994000005.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Merchant Alliance Investment Product]<font color='#9D927B'>

A fan manufactured by 'Rumble Stationery', a new merchant association merchants' association.
There is a heating element inside the fan to produce warm air, but if used for a long time, the fan will burn out.

994000006.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Merchant Alliance Investment Product]<font color='#9D927B'>

This watermelon was developed with inspiration from seedless watermelons, and it is said that there are more seeds than juice when chewed.

994000007.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Merchant Alliance Investment Product]<font color='#9D927B'>

'Made by Grooton' is written at the bottom of the product.

Because mining and transportation methods vary from region to region, the return time after mining varies depending on the selected region.
Because the mining request is not an official request, related data cannot be stored at Union Bank.

<font color='#72A0C1'>- Core mining method -
<font color='#9D927B'>① Select one of three mining

994000010.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Mining Report]<font color='#9D927B'>

Although it is an area where mining can be done relatively quickly, there is no chance of making a fortune.

<font color='#72A0C1'>[Maximum number of times you can mine] 4 times
[Mining cooldown] 6 minutes</font>

994000011.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Mining Report]<font color='#9D927B'>

The mining speed is the worst, but if you are really lucky, this is an area where you can aim for a fortune.

<font color='#72A0C1'>[Maximum number of times you can mine] 10 times
[Mining cooldown] 15 minutes</font>

This is the most stable area for mining.

<font color='#72A0C1'>[Maximum number of times you can mine] 6 times
[Mining cooldown] 10 minutes</font>

Since the mining amount is different every time, I get excited every time I open it.

<font color='#0048BA'>※ If you do not use it within 6 minutes, Booker's Hand will take this item.</font>

994000017.Description:
<font color='#FFBA85'>[Etheric Core Box]<font color='#9D927B'>

The Etel Core was lost during transportation and was recovered.
Since the identity of the client is unknown, Bookers Hand is selling it separately.
But no matter how you look at it, it doesn't seem like a reasonable price.
Although ether cores are classified and stored one at a time, it is said that sometimes there are boxes containing two by mistake.

<font color='#FF1919'>※ When used, an ether core is obtained.</font>
